literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 总共纳入了 894 名登革热患者,其中 59 名免疫功能低下。临床表现相似,但不发烧更为常见(10.2% vs 1.1%)。实验室检查结果在就诊时具有可比性,但免疫功能低下患者的血小板计数最低点较低且血小板减少时间较长。重症登革热 在免疫功能低下患者中更为常见(22% vs 4.9%),住院率更高,住院时间更长,死亡率 也更高。 [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014901]
在 1,242 名参与者中,68.7% 的人表示有意为自己的孩子接种 登革热 疫苗。与较低 疫苗接种 意向相关的因素包括 7-11 岁儿童和较低的自我感知家庭收入,而较高的感知蚊子密度、对 疫苗 的有利态度、更强的主观规范、更强的感知行为控制和更好的登革热预防实践与较高的意向相关。 [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014896]

已确定 67 例与旅行相关的致命登革热病例,其中 55 例被归类为确诊/疑似病例,12 例信息有限。在 55 例确诊/疑似病例中,有 22 例报告了居住国和感染源,跨越 14 个流行目的地。确诊/可能死亡病例发生在年龄<1-79岁的患者中;25.5% 为女性,21.8% 为男性,52.7% 的人没有记录性别。在可获得感染状态的情况下,大多数是原发感染 (9/16)。报告的致命症状包括神经、心脏、出血和高炎症并发症。旅行者中与登革热相关的 死亡率 很少见,但可能未被充分认识和报告。 [10.1093/jtm/taag111]
与其他器官相比,半乳糖凝集素 8 在血细胞裂解物中的表达显着更高。分子对接显示半乳糖凝集素 8 和乳糖之间的结合能为 -8.5 kcal/mol,表明具有特异性。蛋白质-蛋白质对接表明 抗病毒药物 对登革热病毒非结构蛋白 NS1 和 NS5 具有潜在活性。 [10.1007/s42485-026-00226-x]

该研究揭示了登革热病毒多次独立传入科特迪瓦,主要来自布基纳法索。具体而言,确定了 2017 年至 2019 年期间有 5 次 DENV-1 引入,以及 2015 年至 2016 年期间有 4 次 DENV-2 引入。DENV-3 显示了两次单独的引入,一次在 2015 年,另一次在 2018 年。还发现了 1977 年左右从印度引入的早期 DENV-1,这表明历史上存在长距离病毒传播。 [10.64898/2026.11.18.767690]

key_findings_en: A total of 894 dengue patients were included, including 59 were immunocompromised. Clinical presentation was similar, although absence of fever was more common (10.2% vs 1.1%). [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014901]
Among 1,242 participants, 68.7% reported an intention to vaccinate their children against dengue fever. [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014896]

Sixty-seven fatal travel-related dengue cases were identified, of which 55 were classified as confirmed/probable and 12 cases had limited information. Of the 55 confirmed/probable cases, 22 reported both country of residence and acquisition, spanning 14 endemic destinations. [10.1093/jtm/taag111]

Galectin-8 showed significantly higher expression in hemocyte lysate compared to other organs. Molecular docking revealed a binding energy of -8.5 kcal/mol between galectin-8 and lactose, suggesting specificity. [10.1007/s42485-026-00226-x]

The study revealed multiple independent introductions of DENV into Ivory Coast, predominantly from Burkina Faso. Specifically, five introductions of DENV-1 between 2017 and 2019 and four introductions of DENV-2 between 2015 and 2016 were identified. [10.64898/2026.11.18.767690]

papers.title: Neurological Manifestations of Dengue in Malaysia: Two New Case Reports and a Review of Published Cases.
papers.abstract: Dengue virus infection is a major public health concern in Malaysia and is typically characterized by a self-limiting febrile illness, although a subset of patients may progress to severe systemic complications. Among these, neurological manifestations are increasingly reported and are believed to result from either the virus's direct neurotropic effects or immune-mediated mechanisms, including molecular mimicry and autoinflammation. This case series aims to describe the spectrum of neurological complications associated with dengue virus infection and to highlight the importance of early recognition and management. We report the clinical features of two new patients with dengue infection who developed neurological manifestations during the course of their illness, together with a review of nine published cases from Malaysia. This case-based review illustrates a diverse range of neurological complications associated with dengue infection, including cerebellitis, encephalopathy, focal cranial neuropathy, Guillain-Barré syndrome and myositis. Most patients developed neurological symptoms within the first week of dengue onset. Management was largely supportive, with selective use of immunotherapy. Outcomes ranged from near complete recovery to residual neurological deficits, emphasizing the variable prognosis associated with these complications. Both patients described in this case series from our centres were confirmed to be infected with the DENV-2 serotype. In conclusion, neurological complications of dengue are clinically significant and require a high degree of clinical suspicion in patients presenting with altered sensorium or neurological deficits. Early recognition and appropriate supportive or immunomodulatory treatment remain crucial in mitigating neurological sequelae.

papers.title: Genomic Epidemiology of Dengue Virus in Ivory Coast Reveals Five Decades of Viral Circulation with Repeated Introductions from Burkina Faso
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue fever is a rapidly emerging mosquito-borne disease in Africa, yet the continent remains critically underrepresented in genomic surveillance efforts. This disparity is especially pronounced in West Africa, despite phylogenetic studies being concentrated in only a few countries, such as Burkina Faso. Within this broader regional gap, researchers have yet to systematically characterize the dengue virus (DENV) lineages circulating in the Ivory Coast. In this study, we present 24 newly sequenced DENV genomes from Ivory Coast, spanning serotypes DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3, collected between 2017 and 2023. Combined with publicly available sequences, we assembled the most comprehensive dataset to date for the country. We performed maximum-likelihood and Bayesian phylogeographic analyses using global background datasets and reconstructed the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue virus circulation in Ivory Coast. Our findings reveal multiple independent introductions of DENV into Ivory Coast, predominantly from neighboring Burkina Faso. We identify five introductions of DENV-1 between 2017 and 2019 and four introductions of DENV-2 between 2015 and 2016. DENV-3 showed two separate introductions, one in 2015 and another in 2018. Notably, we also identified an early DENV-1 introduction from India around 1977, suggesting long-distance historical viral movement likely linked to colonial and post-colonial military presence. These results underscore the need for sustained genomic surveillance to monitor viral evolution and inform regional public health responses aimed at controlling dengue outbreaks in West Africa.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决西非 基因组监测 工作代表性不足的问题,特别是在象牙海岸,登革病毒 (DENV) 谱系尚未得到系统的表征。该研究试图通过分析来自科特迪瓦和邻国布基纳法索的 DENV 基因组 来填补这一知识空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究对 2017 年至 2023 年间收集的来自科特迪瓦的 24 个 DENV 基因组 进行了测序,涵盖血清型 DENV-1、DENV-2 和 DENV-3。将这些序列与公开可用的序列相结合,汇集了该国最全面的数据集。
elements_zh.methods: 使用全球背景数据集进行最大似然和贝叶斯系统发育地理学分析,以重建科特迪瓦 登革病毒 环流的空间和时间动态。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究揭示了登革热病毒多次独立传入科特迪瓦,主要来自布基纳法索。具体而言,确定了 2017 年至 2019 年期间有 5 次 DENV-1 引入,以及 2015 年至 2016 年期间有 4 次 DENV-2 引入。DENV-3 显示了两次单独的引入,一次在 2015 年,另一次在 2018 年。还发现了 1977 年左右从印度引入的早期 DENV-1,这表明历史上存在长距离病毒传播。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调需要持续的 基因组监测 来监测病毒 进化 并为旨在控制西非登革热 进化 的区域公共卫生应对措施提供信息。这项研究提供了迄今为止最全面的科特迪瓦 DENV 数据集,强调了 基因组监测 区域合作的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为科特迪瓦及邻近地区的 监测、诊断 和 治疗 登革热策略提供参考。他们还强调了持续的 进化 对监测病毒 进化 并为公共卫生应对措施提供信息的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到对公开序列的依赖和潜在的抽样偏差的限制。然而,所收集的综合数据集为 DENV 多次传入科特迪瓦提供了强有力的证据。

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Dengue fever is a rapidly emerging mosquito-borne disease in Africa, yet the continent remains critically underrepresented in genomic surveillance efforts. This disparity is especially pronounced in West Africa, despite phylogenetic studies being concentrated in only a few countries, such as Burkina Faso. Within this broader regional gap, researchers have yet to systematically characterize the dengue virus (DENV) lineages circulating in the Ivory Coast. In this study, we present 24 newly sequenced DENV genomes from Ivory Coast, spanning serotypes DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3, collected between 2017 and 2023. Combined with publicly available sequences, we assembled the most comprehensive dataset to date for the country. We performed maximum-likelihood and Bayesian phylogeographic analyses using global background datasets and reconstructed the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue virus circulation in Ivory Coast. Our findings reveal multiple independent introductions of DENV into Ivory Coast, predominantly from neighboring Burkina Faso. We identify five introductions of DENV-1 between 2017 and 2019 and four introductions of DENV-2 between 2015 and 2016. DENV-3 showed two separate introductions, one in 2015 and another in 2018. Notably, we also identified an early DENV-1 introduction from India around 1977, suggesting long-distance historical viral movement likely linked to colonial and post-colonial military presence. These results underscore the need for sustained genomic surveillance to monitor viral evolution and inform regional public health responses aimed at controlling dengue outbreaks in West Africa.

papers.title: Fatal dengue cases in travellers from 1995 to 2025: A targeted review.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease endemic in 136 countries and territories, with over 14 million cases and more than 10,000 deaths reported globally in 2024 alone. International travellers are at risk of infection when visiting endemic regions. While dengue in travellers is well described, dengue-related mortality in this population has not been comprehensively synthesised. We compiled and critically assessed available data on reports of fatal dengue cases among international travellers over a 30-year period. METHODS: A targeted review was conducted to identify dengue-related fatalities in travellers from non-endemic countries acquiring infection in endemic regions between 1995 and November 2025. PubMed searches using terms related to dengue, mortality, and travel were complemented by hand-searching conference proceedings, national and international surveillance reports, publicly accessible national infectious disease databases, media reports, and anecdotal notifications. Cases were classified as confirmed or probable based on diagnostic method and/or inclusion in surveillance systems. Data were extracted, cross-referenced to avoid duplication, and analysed descriptively. RESULTS: Sixty-seven fatal travel-related dengue cases were identified, of which 55 were classified as confirmed/probable and 12 cases had limited information. Of the 55 confirmed/probable cases, 22 reported both country of residence and acquisition, spanning 14 endemic destinations. Confirmed/probable fatal cases occurred among patients aged <1-79 years; 25.5% were female, 21.8% were male, and in 52.7% sex was not documented. Where infection status was available, most were primary infections (9/16). Reported fatal manifestations included neurological, cardiac, haemorrhagic, and hyperinflammatory complications. Diagnostic and reporting heterogeneity was substantial, and surveillance gaps were evident. CONCLUSIONS: Dengue-related mortality among travellers is rare but likely under-recognised and underreported. Strengthened diagnostic capacity and heightened clinical awareness may support earlier recognition and management of severe cases in travellers, while harmonised international reporting systems could improve case ascertainment and contribute to future prevention strategies.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease endemic in 136 countries and territories, with over 14 million cases and more than 10,000 deaths reported globally in 2024 alone. International travellers are at risk of infection when visiting endemic regions. While dengue in travellers is well described, dengue-related mortality in this population has not been comprehensively synthesised. We compiled and critically assessed available data on reports of fatal dengue cases among international travellers over a 30-year period. METHODS: A targeted review was conducted to identify dengue-related fatalities in travellers from non-endemic countries acquiring infection in endemic regions between 1995 and November 2025. PubMed searches using terms related to dengue, mortality, and travel were complemented by hand-searching conference proceedings, national and international surveillance reports, publicly accessible national infectious disease databases, media reports, and anecdotal notifications. Cases were classified as confirmed or probable based on diagnostic method and/or inclusion in surveillance systems. Data were extracted, cross-referenced to avoid duplication, and analysed descriptively. RESULTS: Sixty-seven fatal travel-related dengue cases were identified, of which 55 were classified as confirmed/probable and 12 cases had limited information. Of the 55 confirmed/probable cases, 22 reported both country of residence and acquisition, spanning 14 endemic destinations. Confirmed/probable fatal cases occurred among patients aged <1-79 years; 25.5% were female, 21.8% were male, and in 52.7% sex was not documented. Where infection status was available, most were primary infections (9/16). Reported fatal manifestations included neurological, cardiac, haemorrhagic, and hyperinflammatory complications. Diagnostic and reporting heterogeneity was substantial, and surveillance gaps were evident. CONCLUSIONS: Dengue-related mortality among travellers is rare but likely under-recognised and underreported. Strengthened diagnostic capacity and heightened clinical awareness may support earlier recognition and management of severe cases in travellers, while harmonised international reporting systems could improve case ascertainment and contribute to future prevention strategies.

papers.title: Dengue vaccine implementation in Southeast Asia: a scoping review of program design, uptake, and safety surveillance.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue vaccine programs in Southeast Asia differ in target groups, delivery, financing, eligibility, and safety monitoring, and the evidence is scattered across peer-reviewed and grey literature. OBJECTIVES: To map evidence on dengue vaccine implementation in Southeast Asia, focusing on program design, uptake, and safety surveillance, and to identify practical insights for future vaccination policies, implementation frameworks, and clinical guidelines in the region. DESIGN: Scoping review. SETTING: Southeast Asia. Population Populations eligible for or receiving dengue vaccination. METHODS: The review followed JBI guidance and PRISMA-ScR. We searched PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane, Google Scholar, WPRIM, WHO IRIS, Google, and government and regulatory websites, and checked reference lists, for sources published from 2015 to 2026 on program design, uptake, or safety surveillance. Two reviewers screened records independently. Evidence was mapped by country and concept and synthesized narratively. RESULTS: Database searches were last updated on September 8, 2026, and grey-literature and supplementary searches on November 1, 2026. Of 366 database records and 220 grey-literature links, 33 sources were included; a supplementary search added 12 (total 45). Evidence was found for six countries and none for Brunei, Cambodia, Lao PDR, Myanmar, or Timor-Leste. The Philippines ran a large, publicly funded, school-based CYD-TDV program; Indonesia combined private access with a provincial TAK-003 pilot; Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam relied mainly on private delivery. Safety surveillance was best documented in the Philippines, Malaysia, and Singapore. Uptake data were sparse: fewer than half of the >830,000 Filipino children given CYD-TDV completed three doses before the program was suspended, and the Indonesian pilot reported about 90% coverage. No uptake data were found for private-sector delivery. Nine sources were modeling or economic studies, which inform planning but do not document implementation. CONCLUSION: Dengue vaccine implementation in Southeast Asia varies in delivery, financing, and safety monitoring, and is unevenly documented, especially for uptake. Standardized monitoring and reporting of real-world vaccination programs are needed.

papers.title_zh: 登革热 疫苗 在东南亚的实施:对计划设计、采用和安全性 监测 的范围审查。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue vaccine programs in Southeast Asia differ in target groups, delivery, financing, eligibility, and safety monitoring, and the evidence is scattered across peer-reviewed and grey literature. OBJECTIVES: To map evidence on dengue vaccine implementation in Southeast Asia, focusing on program design, uptake, and safety surveillance, and to identify practical insights for future vaccination policies, implementation frameworks, and clinical guidelines in the region. DESIGN: Scoping review. SETTING: Southeast Asia. Population Populations eligible for or receiving dengue vaccination. METHODS: The review followed JBI guidance and PRISMA-ScR. We searched PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane, Google Scholar, WPRIM, WHO IRIS, Google, and government and regulatory websites, and checked reference lists, for sources published from 2015 to 2026 on program design, uptake, or safety surveillance. Two reviewers screened records independently. Evidence was mapped by country and concept and synthesized narratively. RESULTS: Database searches were last updated on September 8, 2026, and grey-literature and supplementary searches on November 1, 2026. Of 366 database records and 220 grey-literature links, 33 sources were included; a supplementary search added 12 (total 45). Evidence was found for six countries and none for Brunei, Cambodia, Lao PDR, Myanmar, or Timor-Leste. The Philippines ran a large, publicly funded, school-based CYD-TDV program; Indonesia combined private access with a provincial TAK-003 pilot; Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam relied mainly on private delivery. Safety surveillance was best documented in the Philippines, Malaysia, and Singapore. Uptake data were sparse: fewer than half of the >830,000 Filipino children given CYD-TDV completed three doses before the program was suspended, and the Indonesian pilot reported about 90% coverage. No uptake data were found for private-sector delivery. Nine sources were modeling or economic studies, which inform planning but do not document implementation. CONCLUSION: Dengue vaccine implementation in Southeast Asia varies in delivery, financing, and safety monitoring, and is unevenly documented, especially for uptake. Standardized monitoring and reporting of real-world vaccination programs are needed.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:东南亚地区的登革热疫苗接种计划在目标人群、实施方式、资金来源、资格条件和安全监测方面存在差异,相关证据分散在同行评审文献和灰色文献中。目标:绘制东南亚地区登革热疫苗接种计划实施的证据,重点关注计划设计、接种率和安全性,并识别未来该地区疫苗接种政策、实施框架和临床指南的实用见解。设计:综述研究。地点:东南亚。人群:符合或接受登革热疫苗接种的人群。方法:本综述遵循JBI指南和PRISMA-ScR。我们搜索了PubMed、Scopus、Cochrane、Google Scholar、WPRIM、WHO IRIS、Google以及政府和监管网站,收集了2015年至2026年间关于计划设计、接种率或安全性方面的资料。两名评审员独立筛选记录。证据按国家和概念进行映射,并通过叙述性综合进行总结。结果:数据库搜索于2026年9月8日更新,灰色文献和补充搜索于2026年11月1日进行。共筛选出366条数据库记录和220条灰色文献链接,最终纳入33个来源;补充搜索增加了12个(总计45个)。证据涉及六个国家,而文莱、柬埔寨、老挝、缅甸和东帝汶则没有相关证据。菲律宾实施了一个大规模、公共资助的基于学校的CYD-TDV疫苗接种计划;印度尼西亚则结合了私人渠道与省级TAK-003试点计划;马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和越南主要依赖私人渠道进行疫苗接种。安全性方面的证据在菲律宾、马来西亚和新加坡最为充分。接种率数据较为稀少:在菲律宾超过830,000名儿童中接受CYD-TDV疫苗接种的儿童中,不到一半完成了三剂接种,且该计划在暂停前未完成;印尼试点计划报告了约90%的覆盖率。未发现私人渠道接种率的相关数据。九项来源为建模或经济研究,这些研究有助于规划,但并未记录实施情况。结论:东南亚地区登革热疫苗接种计划在实施方式、资金来源和安全监测方面存在差异,且记录不均衡,尤其是在接种率方面。需要对实际疫苗接种计划进行标准化的监测和报告。

papers.title: DYCAST early warning system for dengue virus risk areas, Ribeirão Preto, Brazil
papers.abstract: Dengue is currently the fastest-spreading vector-borne disease, with an estimated 100-400 million infections per year and nearly 6 billion people at risk – more than half the world’s population. However, there is no specific antiviral treatment, thus the primary method for preventing infection is through targeted control of the principal mosquito vector, Aedes aegypti . The objective of this retrospective study is to evaluate the efficacy of forecasting dengue risk using human cases and an adaptation of DYCAST: a biologically based, spatiotemporal clustering model that proved operationally successful as a West Nile virus early warning system. Results demonstrate that DYCAST provided accurate and early detection of high-risk areas for dengue in Ribeirão Preto, Brazil, including a cryptic interepidemic focus of transmission preceding a severe epidemic. Using suspected cases, DYCAST predicted 90.3% (4,237/4,690) of confirmed cases, with a mean lead time of 66.3 days prior to illness onset. High-risk cells had >10× higher relative risk of containing a confirmed case, and sensitivity and specificity were 83.8% and 72.3%. These findings suggest that DYCAST could be utilized in real time to prospectively identify areas at high risk of dengue, for rapid and precise targeting of mosquito mitigation and public education. Implementation using free, open-source software offers a scalable technological strategy for the prevention and control of dengue around the world. This article is part of the theme issue ‘The Dengue Prevention Toolbox: Integrating Biological, Social and Technological Strategies for Sustainable Control’.

papers.title: Parental intention to vaccinate children and adolescents against dengue fever in Vietnam: An analysis using the theory of planned behavior and selected health belief model constructs.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever (DF) is a major public health challenge for which no specific antiviral treatment is currently approved; therefore, prevention is the primary means of control. This study examined parents' intention to vaccinate children and adolescents with the first dengue vaccine approved in Vietnam and the factors associated with this intention. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: A cross-sectional study was conducted from June to October 2025 among parents of children and adolescents aged 4-18 years in five schools in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Data were collected using a self-administered questionnaire based on the Theory of Planned Behavior and selected Health Belief Model constructs and analyzed using multivariable logistic regression. Among 1,242 participants, 68.7% reported an intention to vaccinate their children against DF. Compared with parents of children aged 4-6 years, those with children aged 7-11 years had lower odds of vaccination intention (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 0.27, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.10-0.70). Lower self-perceived household income was associated with reduced intention (aOR = 0.53, 95% CI 0.32-0.85), whereas higher perceived mosquito density around the house (aOR = 1.22, 95% CI 1.05-1.43), favorable attitudes toward the vaccine (aOR = 2.05, 95% CI 1.53-2.75), stronger subjective norms (aOR = 1.32, 95% CI 1.17-1.49), greater perceived behavioral control (aOR = 1.36, 95% CI 1.26-1.47), and better DF prevention practices (aOR = 1.44, 95% CI 1.15-1.80) were independently associated with greater intention to vaccinate. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Parents' intention to vaccinate their children against DF was associated with financial, health-system, and social factors. These findings may inform strategies that address affordability, social support, service accessibility, and trusted health communication, particularly for parents of children aged 7-11 years and those in areas with high mosquito density.

This study examined parents' intention to vaccinate children and adolescents with the first dengue vaccine approved in Vietnam and the factors associated with this intention. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: A cross-sectional study was conducted from June to October 2025 among parents of children and adolescents aged 4-18 years in five schools in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Data were collected using a self-administered questionnaire based on the Theory of Planned Behavior and selected Health Belief Model constructs and analyzed using multivariable logistic regression. Among 1,242 participants, 68.7% reported an intention to vaccinate their children against DF. Compared with parents of children aged 4-6 years, those with children aged 7-11 years had lower odds of vaccination intention (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 0.27, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.10-0.70). Lower self-perceived household income was associated with reduced intention (aOR = 0.53, 95% CI 0.32-0.85), whereas higher perceived mosquito density around the house (aOR = 1.22, 95% CI 1.05-1.43), favorable attitudes toward the vaccine (aOR = 2.05, 95% CI 1.53-2.75), stronger subjective norms (aOR = 1.32, 95% CI 1.17-1.49), greater perceived behavioral control (aOR = 1.36, 95% CI 1.26-1.47), and better DF prevention practices (aOR = 1.44, 95% CI 1.15-1.80) were independently associated with greater intention to vaccinate. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Parents' intention to vaccinate their children against DF was associated with financial, health-system, and social factors. These findings may inform strategies that address affordability, social support, service accessibility, and trusted health communication, particularly for parents of children aged 7-11 years and those in areas with high mosquito density.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解越南家长为孩子接种 登革热 疫苗的意图,解决没有特定 抗病毒药物 抗病毒药物 治疗 的公共卫生挑战,并确定相关因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025 年 6 月至 10 月,对越南胡志明市五所学校的 1,242 名 4 至 18 岁儿童和青少年家长进行了一项横断面研究。
elements_zh.methods: 使用基于计划行为理论和选定的健康信念模型构建的自填问卷收集数据,并使用多变量逻辑回归进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 1,242 名参与者中,68.7% 的人表示有意为自己的孩子接种 登革热 疫苗。与较低 疫苗接种 意向相关的因素包括 7-11 岁儿童和较低的自我感知家庭收入,而较高的感知蚊子密度、对 疫苗 的有利态度、更强的主观规范、更强的感知行为控制和更好的登革热预防实践与较高的意向相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,经济、卫生系统和社会因素显着影响父母为孩子接种 登革热 疫苗的意愿,凸显了有针对性的干预措施的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为解决负担能力、社会支持、服务可及性和可信健康沟通问题的策略提供参考,特别是对于 7-11 岁儿童的父母和蚊子密度高的地区的父母。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的横截面设计限制了建立因果关系的能力,并且样本仅限于越南的特定地区,这可能会影响普遍性。

papers.title: Ambient particulate chemical components and dengue incidence: A 10-year nationwide study in Thailand.
papers.abstract: Dengue remains a major public health concern in tropical regions, and environmental determinants are increasingly recognized as contributors to its transmission dynamics. Thailand experiences both recurrent dengue outbreaks and episodic air pollution; however, the role of particulate chemical components in dengue epidemiology remains unclear. This study examined the association between specific aerosol components and dengue incidence across 77 provinces in Thailand from 2012 to 2021. Dengue surveillance data were obtained from the Ministry of Public Health, and monthly aerosol concentrations were derived from NASA's MERRA-2 system. A Bayesian spatial modelling approach using integrated nested Laplace approximation (INLA) was applied to estimate associations between particulate components, including dust-PM2.5, organic carbon, black carbon, and sulfate, and dengue incidence, adjusting for demographic and temporal factors. A total of 837,616 dengue cases were recorded over the study period. Higher levels of dust-PM2.5 were positively associated with dengue incidence, whereas higher levels of organic carbon, black carbon, and sulfate were inversely associated with dengue incidence. These findings suggest that particulate chemical composition may contribute to spatial variation in dengue incidence, although the underlying mechanisms remain uncertain. Incorporating particulate composition into environmental surveillance systems may improve early warning models for dengue, particularly in rapidly urbanizing regions of Southeast Asia.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the association between ambient particulate chemical components and dengue incidence across Thailand over a 10-year period. It highlights the need to understand environmental factors influencing dengue transmission dynamics, particularly in tropical regions. The research employed a Bayesian spatial modelling approach to analyze the relationship between particulate matter and dengue cases, adjusting for demographic and temporal factors. The results showed that dust-PM2.5 was positively associated with dengue incidence, while organic carbon, black carbon, and sulfate were inversely linked. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热仍然是热带地区的一个主要公共卫生问题,人们越来越认识到环境决定因素是其 传播 动态的影响因素。

papers.title_zh: 环境颗粒化学成分与登革热 发病率:泰国一项为期 10 年的全国性研究。
papers.source_body_en: Dengue remains a major public health concern in tropical regions, and environmental determinants are increasingly recognized as contributors to its transmission dynamics. Thailand experiences both recurrent dengue outbreaks and episodic air pollution; however, the role of particulate chemical components in dengue epidemiology remains unclear. This study examined the association between specific aerosol components and dengue incidence across 77 provinces in Thailand from 2012 to 2021. Dengue surveillance data were obtained from the Ministry of Public Health, and monthly aerosol concentrations were derived from NASA's MERRA-2 system. A Bayesian spatial modelling approach using integrated nested Laplace approximation (INLA) was applied to estimate associations between particulate components, including dust-PM2.5, organic carbon, black carbon, and sulfate, and dengue incidence, adjusting for demographic and temporal factors. A total of 837,616 dengue cases were recorded over the study period. Higher levels of dust-PM2.5 were positively associated with dengue incidence, whereas higher levels of organic carbon, black carbon, and sulfate were inversely associated with dengue incidence. These findings suggest that particulate chemical composition may contribute to spatial variation in dengue incidence, although the underlying mechanisms remain uncertain. Incorporating particulate composition into environmental surveillance systems may improve early warning models for dengue, particularly in rapidly urbanizing regions of Southeast Asia.

papers.title: Risk of severe dengue in immunocompromised adults in Thailand: A multi-centre retrospective cohort study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Case reports suggest severe outcomes in immunocompromised patients, but large cohort comparisons are lacking. We compared dengue outcomes between immunocompromised and non-immunocompromised patients. METHODS: A retrospective multicenter cohort study of patients with laboratory-confirmed dengue infection between January 2023 and June 2024 was conducted. People living with HIV (PLWH) with CD4 < 350 cells/μL, recipients of solid organ transplantation, hematopoietic stem cell transplant within 2 years, active malignancy, splenectomy or asplenia, and conditions requiring immunosuppressive agents were classified as immunocompromised. Severe dengue based on WHO 2009 criteria, hospitalization, length of stay, and 30-day mortality were primary outcomes. FINDINGS: A total of 894 dengue patients were included, including 59 were immunocompromised. Immunocompromised patients were older (median [interquartile range] age 47.0 [30.0-59.0] vs 33.5 [26.0-49.0] years) and had greater comorbidity burden (Charlson index 1 [0-3] vs 0 [0-1]). Clinical presentation was similar, although absence of fever was more common (10.2% vs 1.1%). Laboratory findings were comparable at presentation, but immunocompromised patients had lower nadir platelet counts and prolonged thrombocytopenia. Severe dengue was more frequent in immunocompromised patients (22% vs 4.9%), with higher hospitalization rates, longer stays, and mortality. In multivariable analysis, immunocompromised status (OR 3.43, 95% CI 1.61-7.31) and comorbidity index (OR 1.33, 95% CI 1.16-1.52) were independently associated with severe dengue. INTERPRETATION: This study adds to the current evidence of higher risk of severe dengue outcome in immunocompromised highlighting the need for improved strategies for prevention and treatment in this patient population.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the risk of severe dengue in immunocompromised adults in Thailand through a multi-centre retrospective cohort analysis. It found that immunocompromised patients had a significantly higher risk of severe dengue, with increased hospitalization rates, longer stays, and higher mortality compared to non-immunocompromised individuals. The study highlights the importance of tailored prevention and treatment strategies for immunocompromised patients. However, the retrospective design limits the strength of the evidence, and the findings should be interpreted cautiously due to potential biases. The results contribute to the growing body of evidence on severe dengue outcomes in vulnerable populations, offering insights for public health and clinical practice.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 病例报告 表明免疫功能低下患者的严重后果,但缺乏大规模的 队列研究 比较。我们比较了免疫功能低下和非免疫功能低下患者的登革热结果。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 2023 年 1 月至 2024 年 6 月期间实验室确诊的登革热感染患者进行了一项回顾性多中心 队列研究 研究。免疫功能低下患者年龄较大(中位[四分位距]年龄 47.0 [30.0-59.0] vs 33.5 [26.0-49.0] 岁)并且合并症负担更大(查尔森指数 1 [0-3] vs 0 [0-1])。
elements_zh.methods: CD4<350个细胞/μL的HIV感染者(PLWH)、接受实体器官移植、2年内造血干细胞移植、活动性恶性肿瘤、脾切除或无脾以及需要免疫抑制剂的情况被归类为免疫功能低下。重症登革热 基于 WHO 2009 年标准,住院情况、住院时间和 30 天 死亡率 是主要结局。
elements_zh.main_results: 总共纳入了 894 名登革热患者,其中 59 名免疫功能低下。临床表现相似,但不发烧更为常见(10.2% vs 1.1%)。实验室检查结果在就诊时具有可比性,但免疫功能低下患者的血小板计数最低点较低且血小板减少时间较长。重症登革热 在免疫功能低下患者中更为常见(22% vs 4.9%),住院率更高,住院时间更长,死亡率 也更高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究补充了目前免疫功能低下患者 重症登革热 结果风险较高的证据,强调需要改进该患者群体的预防和 重症登革热 策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要改进免疫功能低下患者的预防策略和 重症登革热 的 重症登革热,这可以为有针对性的公共卫生干预措施和临床管理方案提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是回顾性的,基于现有的医疗记录,这可能会引入偏差并限制建立因果关系的能力。由于该研究的观察性质,证据的强度中等。

papers.title_zh: 泰国免疫功能低下成年人的 重症登革热 风险:一项多中心回顾性 队列研究 研究。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Case reports suggest severe outcomes in immunocompromised patients, but large cohort comparisons are lacking. We compared dengue outcomes between immunocompromised and non-immunocompromised patients. METHODS: A retrospective multicenter cohort study of patients with laboratory-confirmed dengue infection between January 2023 and June 2024 was conducted. People living with HIV (PLWH) with CD4 < 350 cells/μL, recipients of solid organ transplantation, hematopoietic stem cell transplant within 2 years, active malignancy, splenectomy or asplenia, and conditions requiring immunosuppressive agents were classified as immunocompromised. Severe dengue based on WHO 2009 criteria, hospitalization, length of stay, and 30-day mortality were primary outcomes. FINDINGS: A total of 894 dengue patients were included, including 59 were immunocompromised. Immunocompromised patients were older (median [interquartile range] age 47.0 [30.0-59.0] vs 33.5 [26.0-49.0] years) and had greater comorbidity burden (Charlson index 1 [0-3] vs 0 [0-1]). Clinical presentation was similar, although absence of fever was more common (10.2% vs 1.1%). Laboratory findings were comparable at presentation, but immunocompromised patients had lower nadir platelet counts and prolonged thrombocytopenia. Severe dengue was more frequent in immunocompromised patients (22% vs 4.9%), with higher hospitalization rates, longer stays, and mortality. In multivariable analysis, immunocompromised status (OR 3.43, 95% CI 1.61-7.31) and comorbidity index (OR 1.33, 95% CI 1.16-1.52) were independently associated with severe dengue. INTERPRETATION: This study adds to the current evidence of higher risk of severe dengue outcome in immunocompromised highlighting the need for improved strategies for prevention and treatment in this patient population.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 病例报告 表明免疫功能低下患者的严重后果,但缺乏大规模的 队列研究 比较。我们比较了免疫功能低下和非免疫功能低下患者的登革热结果。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 2023 年 1 月至 2024 年 6 月期间实验室确诊的登革热感染患者进行了一项回顾性多中心 队列研究 研究。免疫功能低下患者年龄较大(中位[四分位距]年龄 47.0 [30.0-59.0] vs 33.5 [26.0-49.0] 岁)并且合并症负担更大(查尔森指数 1 [0-3] vs 0 [0-1])。
analysis_zh.methods: CD4<350个细胞/μL的HIV感染者(PLWH)、接受实体器官移植、2年内造血干细胞移植、活动性恶性肿瘤、脾切除或无脾以及需要免疫抑制剂的情况被归类为免疫功能低下。重症登革热 基于 WHO 2009 年标准,住院情况、住院时间和 30 天 死亡率 是主要结局。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总共纳入了 894 名登革热患者,其中 59 名免疫功能低下。临床表现相似,但不发烧更为常见(10.2% vs 1.1%)。实验室检查结果在就诊时具有可比性,但免疫功能低下患者的血小板计数最低点较低且血小板减少时间较长。重症登革热 在免疫功能低下患者中更为常见(22% vs 4.9%),住院率更高,住院时间更长,死亡率 也更高。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究补充了目前免疫功能低下患者 重症登革热 结果风险较高的证据,强调需要改进该患者群体的预防和 重症登革热 策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要改进免疫功能低下患者的预防策略和 重症登革热 的 重症登革热,这可以为有针对性的公共卫生干预措施和临床管理方案提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是回顾性的,基于现有的医疗记录,这可能会引入偏差并限制建立因果关系的能力。由于该研究的观察性质,证据的强度中等。

papers.title: Stochastic dynamics of a multi-stage dengue model with vaccination and saturated incidence rates.
papers.abstract: Complex population movements and inherent disruptive environmental factors render it more challenging to analyse the pathogenic dengue virus. Research on epidemic mathematical frameworks may assist in protecting the economy and public health in addition to predicting the dengue epidemic's development pattern. Influenced by this, we discuss the six-dimensional S h V h I h R h -S v I v dengue stochastic epidemic model. For this stochastic system, we first verify the existence and uniqueness of a positive global solution. Next, we construct the suitable Lyapunov function to analyse the existence and uniqueness of a stationary distribution with ergodic features by Khasminskii's method. To investigate the statistical report for the existing stationary distribution by using a probability density function. This yields, the expression of the probability density function near quasi-endemic equilibrium of log-normal properties is solved by the Fokker-Planck equation. Furthermore, sufficient conditions are derived to eradicate and control the dengue transmission. Subsequently, numerical simulations are executed to validate the mathematical predictions, and the impact of environmental disturbances and key parameters on dengue transmission is taken into account as well.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决复杂的人口流动和环境破坏在分析致病性 登革病毒 时带来的挑战。该研究的重点是开发一个数学模型来理解登革热 传播 动力学。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用六维随机流行病模型(S h V h I h R h -S v I v)来模拟登革热传播。该模型的设计考虑了环境干扰和影响登革热传播的关键参数。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及验证随机系统的全局正解的存在性和唯一性。使用 Khasminskii 的方法构建了合适的 Lyapunov 函数来分析平稳分布。进行数值模拟以验证数学预测。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究证明了具有遍历特征的平稳分布的存在。使用福克-普朗克方程求解接近准地方性平衡的概率密度函数,揭示了对数正态特性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为为理解随机条件下登革热 传播 动力学提供了一个框架。新颖之处在于用 疫苗接种 和饱和 发病率 比率来模拟登革热传播的数学方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更准确的登革热 监测 数学模型和预测提供信息。它们还可能有助于制定在动态环境中控制登革热 传播 的更好策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于数学模拟,不提供经验数据。由于结果基于理论模型和数值验证,因此证据强度中等。

papers.title: Targeting CLK1 by CRISPR tools and pharmacological inhibition modulates the innate immune response and dengue virus replication.
papers.abstract: Alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism known to be altered upon viral infection. These alterations can arise both from direct viral interference with the splicing machinery and from cellular responses such as activation of innate immunity. Here, we investigated splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells, the latter serving as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation. Among the common events, we identified an increased production of non-coding mRNA isoforms from the CLK1 gene, which gives rise to a kinase that phosphorylates splicing factors including SR proteins and spliceosomal components. Consistent with this finding, IFN treatment led to a reduction in CLK1 protein levels. Using stable cell lines with CRISPR/dCas9-mediated modulation of CLK1 expression, we found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its overexpression attenuated it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with the pharmacological inhibitor TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. Altogether, these results identify CLK1 as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression and suggest that its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses and become a target for therapeutic strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore how viral infection and interferon treatment affect splicing changes, as alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism altered during viral infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used cultured cells to investigate splicing changes in dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment, with IFN treatment serving as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed CRISPR/dCas9 tools to modulate CLK1 expression and pharmacological inhibitors to assess the impact of CLK1 kinase activity on immune response genes and DENV replication.
analysis.main_results: The study found that CLK1 gene expression increased during DENV infection and IFN treatment, with IFN treatment leading to a reduction in CLK1 protein levels. Silencing CLK1 enhanced immune response gene induction, while its overexpression attenuated it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that CLK1 acts as a negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression and that its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into potential therapeutic strategies targeting CLK1 to improve antiviral defenses against dengue virus.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to cultured cells, which may not fully represent in vivo conditions, and the evidence is based on experimental modulation rather than direct observation of viral behavior in humans. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment affect splicing changes in cultured cells. The researchers identified increased CLK1 non-coding mRNA isoforms during DENV infection and IFN treatment, with IFN reducing CLK1 protein levels. Using CRISPR/dCas9 and pharmacological inhibitors, they found that CLK1 silencing enhanced immune response gene induction, while its overexpression attenuated it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. These findings suggest CLK1 as a negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression and highlight its potential as a therapeutic target. The study's results are based on experimental modulation in cultured cells, which may not fully reflect in vivo conditions, limiting the evidence strength to moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨病毒感染和干扰素 治疗 如何影响剪接变化,因为选择性剪接是病毒感染过程中被改变的关键调控机制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用培养的细胞来研究 登革病毒(登革病毒)感染和干扰素(IFN) 治疗 对剪接变化的影响,其中 IFN 治疗 作为病毒独立的先天免疫激活模型。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用 CRISPR/dCas9 工具调节 CLK1 表达,并使用药物抑制剂评估 CLK1 激酶活性对 免疫应答 基因和登革病毒复制的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,在登革病毒感染和 IFN 治疗 激活过程中,CLK1 基因表达均增加,但 IFN 治疗 导致 CLK1 蛋白水平下降。沉默 CLK1 增强了 免疫应答 基因的诱导,而其过表达则抑制了该诱导。使用 TG003 抑制 CLK1 激酶活性进一步增强了干扰素诱导的基因表达,并减少了登革病毒的复制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明 CLK1 在干扰素刺激基因表达中起负调控作用,其抑制可能有助于增强 抗病毒药物 防御能力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为针对 CLK1 的潜在治疗策略提供了见解,以增强 抗病毒药物 对登革病毒的防御能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于培养细胞,可能无法完全代表体内情况,且证据基于实验性调节而非直接观察病毒在人体中的行为。证据强度为中等。

papers.title_zh: 通过 CRISPR 工具和药理抑制来靶向 CLK1 可调节先天的 免疫应答 和 登革病毒 复制。
papers.source_body_en: Alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism known to be altered upon viral infection. These alterations can arise both from direct viral interference with the splicing machinery and from cellular responses such as activation of innate immunity. papers.abstract_zh: 选择性剪接是已知在病毒感染时发生改变的关键调节机制。这些改变可能来自病毒对剪接机制的直接干扰,也可能来自细胞反应,例如先天免疫的激活。在这里,我们研究了培养细胞中 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染和干扰素 (IFN) 治疗 之间共享的剪接变化,后者作为病毒依赖性先天免疫激活的模型。在常见事件中,我们发现 CLK1 基因非编码 mRNA 亚型的产量增加,从而产生一种磷酸化剪接因子(包括 SR 蛋白和剪接体成分)的激酶。与这一发现一致,IFN 治疗 导致 CLK1 蛋白水平降低。使用具有 CRISPR/dCas9 介导的 CLK1 表达调节的稳定细胞系,我们发现沉默 CLK1 增强了 免疫应答 基因的诱导,而其过度表达则减弱了这种诱导。用药理学抑制剂 TG003 抑制 CLK1 激酶活性,进一步增强 IFN 诱导的基因表达并减少 DENV 复制。总而言之,这些结果确定 CLK1 是 IFN 刺激的基因表达的前病毒负调节因子,并表明其抑制可以增强 抗病毒药物 防御并成为治疗策略的目标。

papers.title: Bifurcation analysis and optimal control of a Dengue fever model with saturated nonlinear incidence and dual time delays
papers.abstract: Dengue fever remains a serious public health challenge, and mathematical models offer a valuable lens for understanding its dynamics and guiding control efforts. This study develops and analyses a seven-compartment deterministic model that links human and mosquito populations through coupled transmission pathways. The model incorporates several features not previously combined in the dengue literature: a saturated incidence function that captures crowding effects in both transmission directions, two biologically distinct incubation delays representing the time the virus spends in humans and in mosquitoes separately, gradual loss of temporary immunity after recovery, and a three-component optimal control framework. The threshold quantity governing outbreak potential is derived and estimated at approximately 2.37 under baseline conditions. When this threshold falls to or below one, the disease-free equilibrium is shown to be globally asymptotically stable; when it exceeds one, a unique endemic equilibrium emerges; its local asymptotic stability is established analytically for the full DDE model, and global stability is proved for the limiting ODE case (no delays, no saturation, no waning immunity). A notable finding is that the system can sustain endemic transmission even when the threshold is driven below one, provided that the saturation constant satisfies α > α † and the waning immunity rate δ h > 0 act together—a result with direct implications for eradication strategies. Analysis of the incubation delay reveals that beyond a critical value of roughly 9.4 days, the system transitions into sustained oscillations, offering a mechanistic explanation for the seasonal cycles commonly observed in Southeast Asian dengue data. Sensitivity analysis highlights mosquito mortality as the most influential parameter. Optimal control solutions, derived analytically, point to combined intervention strategies as substantially more effective than single-measure approaches. Numerical simulations validate all theoretical results.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a mathematical model of dengue fever that incorporates a saturated nonlinear incidence function, dual time delays for human and mosquito incubation, and waning immunity. The model derives a threshold quantity for outbreak potential, estimated at 2.37 under baseline conditions. It demonstrates that disease-free equilibrium is globally stable when the threshold is below one, while an endemic equilibrium emerges when it exceeds one. The model also reveals that sustained oscillations can occur beyond a critical incubation delay of 9.4 days, potentially explaining seasonal dengue patterns. The findings suggest that combined intervention strategies are more effective than single measures for disease control. Sensitivity analysis identifies mosquito mortality as the most influential parameter, and numerical simulations confirm the theoretical results. The study contributes to understanding dengue dynamics and informs public health strategies for control and eradication.

papers.title: Adult Immunogenicity and Descriptive Safety of TAK-003 Dengue Vaccination: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Background: Adult TAK-003 data differ by formulation, baseline dengue status, coadministration, and outcome definition. Objective: To synthesize adult immunogenicity and safety of the licensed two-dose final formulation of TAK-003. Methods: We searched PubMed, Scopus, CENTRAL-derived records, registries, regulatory sources, and citations to the final search update. Screening, extraction, appraisal, and analysis used a reproducible computational workflow without independent duplicate verification. Seropositivity and 270-day serious adverse event (SAE) risk were modeled with binomial-normal logit models; comparative reactogenicity used random-effects risk ratios with modified Hartung-Knapp intervals. Certainty was graded by outcome, and a sensitivity analysis added the single-arm DEN307 cohort. Results: Of 1,090 records, 606 unique records (553 publications and 53 registry records) were screened; 473 publications were excluded and 80 were retrieved. Five trials supplied quantitative outcomes. Among 620 baseline-seronegative adults, pooled seropositivity about 30 days after dose 2 was 98.7% for DENV-1 (95% CI 95.8–99.6), 99.0% for DENV-2 (97.9–99.6), 96.9% for DENV-3 (95.2–98.0), and 98.4% for DENV-4 (97.0–99.1). With DEN307 added, estimates were 98.8%, 99.2%, 97.1%, and 98.5% (752 participants per serotype). Across four cohorts, 29/1,468 participants had an SAE through day 270 (pooled risk 2.0%, 95% CI 1.4–2.8). Pain and headache estimates, each from two studies, were highly imprecise. Conclusion: Final-formulation TAK-003 gave high short-term seropositivity in selected adult trial populations. The SAE risk was uncontrolled and does not establish comparative safety. Certainty was low or very low, and inference is limited by study size, surrogate outcomes, and uncontrolled safety data.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to synthesize the immunogenicity and safety of the licensed two-dose final formulation of TAK-003 in adults. The review included 5 trials with quantitative outcomes, focusing on seropositivity and serious adverse events (SAEs). Among baseline-seronegative adults, pooled seropositivity was high for all four dengue serotypes, with estimates ranging from 96.9% to 99.0%. However, the SAE risk was uncontrolled, and the certainty of evidence was low or very low due to study size, surrogate outcomes, and lack of safety data control. Pain and headache estimates were imprecise. The findings suggest that TAK-003 has strong immunogenicity in selected adult populations but highlight the need for further research to address safety concerns and improve precision in reactogenicity assessments.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 成人 TAK-003 数据因配方、基线登革热状态、共同给药和结果定义而异。合成获得许可的 TAK-003 两剂量最终制剂的成人免疫原性和安全性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 我们检索了 PubMed、Scopus、CENTRAL 衍生记录、注册、监管来源和最终检索更新的引用。筛选、提取、评估和分析使用可重复的计算工作流程,无需独立的重复验证。使用二项正态 Logit 模型对血清阳性率和 270 天严重不良事件 (SAE) 风险进行建模;比较反应原性使用随机效应风险比和修正的 Hartung-Knapp 区间。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在 620 名基线血清阴性成人中,第 2 剂给药后约 30 天,DENV-1 的汇总血清阳性率为 98.7%(95% CI 95.8-99.6),DENV-2 为 99.0%(97.9-99.6),DENV-3 为 96.9%(95.2-98.0),DENV-4 为 98.4% (97.0–99.1)。添加 DEN307 后,估计值为 98.8%、99.2%、97.1% 和 98.5%(每种血清型 752 名参与者)。最终制剂 TAK-003 在选定的成人试验人群中显示出较高的短期血清阳性率。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 确定性很低或非常低,并且推断受到研究规模、替代结果和不受控制的安全性数据的限制。在四个 队列研究 中,29/1,468 名参与者在第 270 天出现 SAE(合并风险 2.0%,95% CI 1.4–2.8)。两项研究对疼痛和头痛的估计都非常不精确。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: SAE 风险不受控制,无法建立相对安全性。

papers.title: Diagnostic accuracy of the AST-to-Platelet Ratio Index (APRI) for severe or complicated dengue: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Background This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of APRI for identifying severe or complicated dengue, according to the target-condition definitions used in the included studies. A separate sensitivity analysis was restricted to studies comparing severe with non-severe dengue. The review also examined methodological limitations affecting the interpretation and potential clinical applicability of the findings. Objective To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of the aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ratio index for identifying severe or complicated dengue. Methods Seven electronic databases were searched from inception to March 13, 2026. Eligible studies evaluated the index among patients with laboratory-confirmed dengue. The review followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses of Diagnostic Test Accuracy Studies guidance. Study-level sensitivity and specificity were calculated from extracted or reconstructed two-by-two data. Pooled estimates were obtained using a frequentist bivariate random-effects Reitsma model fitted by restricted maximum likelihood estimation. Heterogeneity, threshold effects and sensitivity analyses were assessed. Results Eight studies were included in the qualitative synthesis, of which six comprising 948 participants were quantitatively pooled. Pooled sensitivity was 0.75 (95% confidence interval: 0.66–0.82), and pooled specificity was 0.80 (95% confidence interval: 0.76–0.84). The positive likelihood ratio was 3.76, the negative likelihood ratio was 0.32 and the diagnostic odds ratio was 12.42. The area under the summary receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.841. Leave-one-out analyses produced similar estimates. Restriction to four studies comparing severe with non-severe dengue yielded a sensitivity of 0.73, specificity of 0.79 and area under the curve of 0.821. Conclusion APRI demonstrated moderate diagnostic accuracy for the heterogeneous target condition of severe or complicated dengue. These pooled estimates should not be interpreted as applying exclusively to strictly defined severe dengue. Variation in target-condition definitions and the wide range of retrospectively selected APRI thresholds limit clinical applicability, while retrospective threshold selection may overestimate diagnostic performance. Prospective validation is required before routine use alongside clinical assessment and serial laboratory monitoring.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 这项系统评价和荟萃分析旨在根据纳入研究中使用的目标条件定义,评估 APRI 识别严重或复杂登革热的诊断准确性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 从开始到 2026 年 3 月 13 日,检索了七个电子数据库。审查遵循诊断测试准确性研究的系统审查和元分析的首选报告项目指南。使用通过限制最大似然估计拟合的频率论双变量随机效应 Reitsma 模型获得汇总估计值。评估了异质性、阈值效应和敏感性分析。单独的敏感性分析仅限于比较严重与非 重症登革热 的研究。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 定性综合中纳入了 8 项研究,其中 6 项研究(948 名参与者)被定量汇总。汇总敏感性为 0.75(95% 置信区间:0.66–0.82),汇总特异性为 0.80(95% 置信区间:0.76–0.84)。阳性似然比为3.76,阴性似然比为0.32,诊断优势比为12.42。汇总受试者工作特征曲线下面积为 0.841。留一法分析产生了类似的估计。该综述还研究了影响研究结果的解释和潜在临床适用性的方法学局限性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 目标条件定义的变化和回顾性选择的 APRI 阈值范围广泛限制了临床适用性,而回顾性阈值选择可能会高估诊断性能。汇总估计值不应被解释为专门适用于严格定义的 重症登革热。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 在常规使用之前需要进行前瞻性验证以及临床评估和连续实验室监测。

papers.title: Reticulon-3 at the Interface of Hepatitis C and Dengue Virus Infection: Extracellular Vesicle-Mediated Transfer and Emerging Antiviral Vulnerabilities
papers.abstract: Positive-sense RNA viruses are commonly classified by genome organization, entry route, tissue tropism, and clinical syndrome, but these categories do not explain how viruses construct protected replication niches or route infectious material between cells. The endoplasmic reticulum (ER) provides a shared platform for viral translation, replication-organelle formation, membrane curvature, lipid remodeling, innate immune regulation, and vesicular trafficking. Within this framework, reticulon-3 (RTN3) has emerged as a candidate regulator linking ER-based RNA-virus replication to the generation of infectious extracellular-vesicle cargo. Hepatitis C virus (HCV) and dengue virus (DENV) provide complementary experimental settings for evaluating this model despite their distinct transmission routes, tissue tropisms, disease courses, and immune pathophysiology. HCV most clearly demonstrates that exosome-enriched fractions can transfer replication-competent viral RNA with defined host cofactors, whereas DENV provides an acute infection model for examining related transfer phenotypes. Both viruses nevertheless replicate within remodeled ER membranes and can transfer infection-competent material in a vesicle-associated form. Functional perturbation studies implicate RTN3 in the output of infection-associated vesicle preparations, but do not yet establish direct recognition of viral RNA or its incorporation into endosomal intraluminal vesicles. RTN3 can also restrict HCV replication through NS4B interactions, suggesting that its effects vary by endpoint and may reflect distinct functions at different stages of infection. Related membrane-remodeling and vesicle-associated processes in Zika virus, West Nile virus, enteroviruses, SARS-CoV-2, and hepatitis A virus illustrate broader exploitation of host membrane organization, but replication-membrane phenotypes and vesicle-associated dissemination in these systems do not establish an RTN3-dependent infectious EV pathway. In selected models, EV-enriched preparations contain protected viral cargo and transfer biological activity to recipient cells; neither particle enrichment nor infectivity alone resolves the carrier’s identity. Advances in isolation and characterization, including density-gradient or size-exclusion separation, immunoaffinity selection, particle and marker profiling, membrane-protection assays, and recipient-cell infectivity testing, now permit more rigorous identification of defined vesicle populations, protected cargo, and biological activity. Nevertheless, RTN3 should not be considered a universal RNA-virus dependency, nor should extracellular-vesicle release be assumed to generate uniformly infectious populations. Instead, HCV and DENV support functional involvement of RTN3 in vesicle-associated output, while the molecular connection between ER organization and selective cargo enclosure remains unresolved. Defining these shared and virus-specific dependencies may reveal host–virus interfaces suitable for broad-spectrum or resistance-resilient intervention, provided that infection-selective reliance, a measurable therapeutic window, and preservation of essential host-cell functions can be demonstrated.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore how viruses construct protected replication niches and transfer infectious material between cells, highlighting the limitations of current classification systems based on genome organization, entry route, tissue tropism, and clinical syndrome.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study utilized Hepatitis C virus (HCV) and dengue virus (DENV) as complementary models to evaluate the role of reticulon-3 (RTN3) in viral replication and extracellular-vesicle-mediated transfer, despite their distinct transmission routes, tissue tropisms, and disease courses.
analysis.methods: The research employed advanced isolation and characterization techniques, including density-gradient or size-exclusion separation, immunoaffinity selection, particle and marker profiling, membrane-protection assays, and recipient-cell infectivity testing to identify defined vesicle populations, protected cargo, and biological activity.
analysis.main_results: HCV and DENV both replicate within remodeled ER membranes and can transfer infection-competent material in a vesicle-associated form, but the molecular connection between ER organization and selective cargo enclosure remains unresolved.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that RTN3 plays a functional role in vesicle-associated output for HCV and DENV, but its involvement is not universal across all RNA viruses, and the precise mechanism of cargo selection is not yet established.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that understanding RTN3's role in viral replication and dissemination could inform the development of broad-spectrum antiviral interventions targeting host-virus interactions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges that RTN3 is not a universal RNA-virus dependency, and extracellular-vesicle release does not guarantee uniformly infectious populations, indicating the need for further research to confirm these mechanisms.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of reticulon-3 (RTN3) in the replication and dissemination of dengue virus (DENV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV). It highlights the limitations of current classification systems for RNA viruses and explores how these viruses utilize the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) for replication and vesicle-mediated transfer. The research employs advanced techniques to isolate and characterize extracellular vesicles, revealing that both DENV and HCV can transfer infectious material through vesicles, but the molecular mechanisms linking ER organization to selective cargo enclosure remain unclear. The study suggests that RTN3 may play a functional role in this process for DENV and HCV, though its involvement is not universal. These findings could inform the development of antiviral strategies targeting host-virus interactions, but the evidence is limited by the unresolved mechanisms and the lack of direct confirmation of RTN3's role in viral RNA recognition and incorporation. The study's results are based on abstract-only evidence, and the confidence in these findings is moderate due to the absence of detailed experimental data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探索病毒如何构建受保护的复制生态位并在细胞之间转移感染物质,强调当前基于 基因组 组织、进入途径、组织向性和临床综合征的分类系统的局限性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和 登革病毒 (DENV) 作为补充模型来评估 reticulon-3 (RTN3) 在病毒复制和细胞外囊泡介导的转移中的作用,尽管它们具有不同的 传播 途径、组织向性和疾病过程。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用了先进的分离和表征技术,包括密度梯度或尺寸排阻分离、免疫亲和选择、颗粒和标记物分析、膜保护测定和受体细胞感染性测试,以鉴定确定的囊泡群体、受保护的货物和生物活性。
elements_zh.main_results: HCV和DENV都在重塑的内质网膜内复制,并且可以以囊泡相关形式转移具有感染能力的物质,但内质网组织和选择性货物外壳之间的分子联系仍未解决。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,RTN3 在 HCV 和 DENV 的囊泡相关输出中发挥功能性作用,但它的参与并不普遍存在于所有 RNA 病毒中,并且货物选择的精确机制尚未建立。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,了解RTN3在病毒复制和传播中的作用可以为针对宿主-病毒相互作用的广谱抗病毒药物干预措施的开发提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认RTN3不是一种普遍的RNA病毒依赖性,并且细胞外囊泡的释放并不能保证均匀的感染群体,这表明需要进一步的研究来证实这些机制。

papers.abstract_zh: 正义RNA病毒通常按基因组组织、进入途径、组织向性和临床综合征进行分类,但这些分类并不能解释病毒如何构建受保护的复制生态位或在细胞之间传递感染物质。内质网(ER)为病毒翻译、复制细胞器形成、膜曲率、脂质重塑、先天免疫调节和囊泡运输提供了一个共享平台。在此框架内,reticulon-3 (RTN3) 已成为将基于内质网的 RNA 病毒复制与感染性细胞外囊泡货物的生成联系起来的候选调节因子。丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和 登革病毒 (DENV) 为评估该模型提供了互补的实验设置,尽管它们具有不同的 传播 途径、组织向性、疾病过程和免疫病理生理学。HCV 最清楚地表明,富含外泌体的组分可以转移具有定义的 宿主 辅因子的具有复制能力的病毒 RNA,而 DENV 提供了用于检查相关转移表型的急性感染模型。然而,这两种病毒都在重塑的内质网膜内复制,并且可以以囊泡相关的形式转移具有感染能力的物质。功能扰动研究表明 RTN3 参与感染相关囊泡制剂的输出,但尚未建立对病毒 RNA 或其掺入内体腔内囊泡的直接识别。RTN3 还可以通过 NS4B 相互作用限制 HCV 复制,这表明其作用因终点而异,并且可能反映感染不同阶段的不同功能。寨卡病毒、西尼罗河病毒、肠道病毒、SARS-CoV-2和甲型肝炎病毒中相关的膜重塑和囊泡相关过程说明了 宿主 膜组织的更广泛利用,但这些系统中的复制膜表型和囊泡相关传播并没有建立依赖于 RTN3 的传染性 EV 途径。在选定的模型中,富含EV的制剂含有受保护的病毒货物并将生物活性转移至受体细胞;单独的颗粒富集和感染性都无法解析载体的身份。分离和表征方面的进步,包括密度梯度或尺寸排阻分离、免疫亲和选择、颗粒和标记物分析、膜保护测定和受体细胞感染性测试,现在允许更严格地鉴定确定的囊泡群体、受保护的货物和生物活性。然而,RTN3 不应被视为普遍的 RNA 病毒依赖性,也不应假设细胞外囊泡释放会产生一致的感染群体。相反,HCV 和 DENV 支持 RTN3 在囊泡相关输出中的功能参与,而 ER 组织和选择性货物外壳之间的分子联系仍未解决。定义这些共享的和病毒特异性的依赖性可能会揭示适合广谱或耐药性干预的宿主-病毒界面,前提是可以证明感染选择性依赖性、可测量的治疗窗以及基本宿主-细胞功能的保留。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探索病毒如何构建受保护的复制生态位并在细胞之间转移感染物质,强调当前基于 基因组 组织、进入途径、组织向性和临床综合征的分类系统的局限性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和 登革病毒 (DENV) 作为补充模型来评估 reticulon-3 (RTN3) 在病毒复制和细胞外囊泡介导的转移中的作用,尽管它们具有不同的 传播 途径、组织向性和疾病过程。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究采用了先进的分离和表征技术,包括密度梯度或尺寸排阻分离、免疫亲和选择、颗粒和标记物分析、膜保护测定和受体细胞感染性测试,以鉴定确定的囊泡群体、受保护的货物和生物活性。
analysis_zh.main_results: HCV和DENV都在重塑的内质网膜内复制,并且可以以囊泡相关形式转移具有感染能力的物质,但内质网组织和选择性货物外壳之间的分子联系仍未解决。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,RTN3 在 HCV 和 DENV 的囊泡相关输出中发挥功能性作用,但它的参与并不普遍存在于所有 RNA 病毒中,并且货物选择的精确机制尚未建立。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,了解RTN3在病毒复制和传播中的作用可以为针对宿主-病毒相互作用的广谱抗病毒药物干预措施的开发提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认RTN3不是一种普遍的RNA病毒依赖性,并且细胞外囊泡的释放并不能保证均匀的感染群体,这表明需要进一步的研究来证实这些机制。

papers.full_text: Abstract Dengue fever has transitioned from an occasional imported infection to a growing domestic public health concern in Iran. This systematic literature review, conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 guidelines (with acknowledged deviations), analyzed 46 peer-reviewed studies published between 2020 and 2026. A limited, exploratory meta-analysis of seroprevalence estimates from a subset of comparable studies (five estimates from three primary studies, of which only three were directly observed seroprevalence measurements) yielded a pooled national estimate of 3.96% [95% CI: 1.20–6.72], with substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 98.5%, p < 0.01). This quantitative synthesis is presented primarily for illustrative purposes to visualize geographic patterns; the narrative synthesis remains the primary contribution of this review. The critical outbreak in Sistan and Baluchestan Province in 2024, involving 1,057 confirmed cases (80.7% locally transmitted), suggests a threat of endemic establishment rather than having reached endemicity. Publication bias analyses (funnel plot asymmetry; Egger’s test: p = 0.028) suggested potential underrepresentation of low-prevalence regions, but these findings are unreliable with few studies and should be interpreted with extreme caution. The review identifies critical gaps in surveillance infrastructure, molecular diagnostic capacity, and healthcare system preparedness. Key recommendations include implementing integrated surveillance systems, adopting genomic epidemiology, and enhancing regional collaboration. Without immediate and coordinated action, Iran faces an imminent risk of transitioning to endemic dengue transmission. Data availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract Dengue fever has transitioned from an occasional imported infection to a growing domestic public health concern in Iran. This systematic literature review, conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 guidelines (with acknowledged deviations), analyzed 46 peer-reviewed studies published between 2020 and 2026. A limited, exploratory meta-analysis of seroprevalence estimates from a subset of comparable studies (five estimates from three primary studies, of which only three were directly observed seroprevalence measurements) yielded a pooled national estimate of 3.96% [95% CI: 1.20–6.72], with substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 98.5%, p < 0.01). This quantitative synthesis is presented primarily for illustrative purposes to visualize geographic patterns; the narrative synthesis remains the primary contribution of this review. The critical outbreak in Sistan and Baluchestan Province in 2024, involving 1,057 confirmed cases (80.7% locally transmitted), suggests a threat of endemic establishment rather than having reached endemicity. Publication bias analyses (funnel plot asymmetry; Egger’s test: p = 0.028) suggested potential underrepresentation of low-prevalence regions, but these findings are unreliable with few studies and should be interpreted with extreme caution. The review identifies critical gaps in surveillance infrastructure, molecular diagnostic capacity, and healthcare system preparedness. Key recommendations include implementing integrated surveillance systems, adopting genomic epidemiology, and enhancing regional collaboration. Without immediate and coordinated action, Iran faces an imminent risk of transitioning to endemic dengue transmission. Data availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. analysis.summary_en: This systematic literature review examines the growing public health concern of dengue fever in Iran, focusing on its epidemiology, vectors, diagnostics, and challenges. The review analyzed 46 studies published between 2020 and 2026, with a meta-analysis of seroprevalence estimates showing a pooled national estimate of 3.96% [95% CI: 1.20–6.72], though substantial heterogeneity was noted. A critical outbreak in 2024, with 80.7% locally transmitted cases, indicates a potential shift toward endemicity. The review highlights gaps in surveillance, diagnostics, and healthcare preparedness, and recommends integrated systems, genomic epidemiology, and regional collaboration. Publication bias analyses suggest caution in interpreting findings due to limited data. Immediate action is needed to prevent the transition to endemic dengue transmission in Iran.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 登革热 已从偶尔的输入性感染转变为伊朗日益严重的国内公共卫生问题。该审查重点关注伊朗的 流行病学、媒介、诊断以及与 登革病毒 相关的公共卫生挑战。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项系统文献综述根据 PRISMA 2020 指南(承认存在偏差)进行,分析了 2020 年至 2026 年间发表的 46 项同行评审研究。对来自可比研究子集的 血清流行率 估计值进行有限的探索性荟萃分析(来自三项主要研究的五项估计值,其中只有三项是直接观察到的 血清流行率 测量值)得出的全国汇总估计值为 3.96% [95% CI:1.20–6.72],具有显着的异质性(I2 = 98.5%,p < 0.01)。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 2024 年锡斯坦和俾路支斯坦省出现了严重的 暴发,涉及 1,057 例确诊病例(80.7% 为本地传播),这表明存在流行病形成的威胁,而不是已达到流行病。该审查确定了 监测 基础设施、分子诊断能力和医疗保健系统准备方面的关键差距。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 发表偏倚分析(漏斗图不对称性;Egger 检验:p = 0.028)表明低 患病率 区域的代表性可能不足,但这些研究结果并不可靠,研究很少,应极其谨慎地解释。该审查还强调需要有关 登革病毒 传播 动态和 媒介 行为的更全面的数据。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 主要建议包括实施综合 监测 系统、采用基因组 流行病学 以及加强区域合作。如果不立即采取协调一致的行动,伊朗将面临着转变为地方性登革热 传播 的迫在眉睫的风险。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 登革热 已从偶尔的输入性感染转变为伊朗日益严重的国内公共卫生问题。该审查重点关注伊朗的 流行病学、媒介、诊断以及与 登革病毒 相关的公共卫生挑战。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项系统文献综述根据 PRISMA 2020 指南(承认存在偏差)进行,分析了 2020 年至 2026 年间发表的 46 项同行评审研究。对来自可比研究子集的 血清流行率 估计值进行有限的探索性荟萃分析(来自三项主要研究的五项估计值,其中只有三项是直接观察到的 血清流行率 测量值)得出的全国汇总估计值为 3.96% [95% CI:1.20–6.72],具有显着的异质性(I2 = 98.5%,p < 0.01)。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 2024 年锡斯坦和俾路支斯坦省出现了严重的 暴发,涉及 1,057 例确诊病例(80.7% 为本地传播),这表明存在流行病形成的威胁,而不是已达到流行病。该审查确定了 监测 基础设施、分子诊断能力和医疗保健系统准备方面的关键差距。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 发表偏倚分析(漏斗图不对称性;Egger 检验:p = 0.028)表明低 患病率 区域的代表性可能不足,但这些研究结果并不可靠,研究很少,应极其谨慎地解释。该审查还强调需要有关 登革病毒 传播 动态和 媒介 行为的更全面的数据。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 主要建议包括实施综合 监测 系统、采用基因组 流行病学 以及加强区域合作。如果不立即采取协调一致的行动,伊朗将面临着转变为地方性登革热 传播 的迫在眉睫的风险。

papers.title: Persistent Wolbachia-mediated dengue virus blocking in Aedes aegypti five years after deployment in New Caledonia
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Wolbachia infection reduces dengue virus (DENV) transmission by Aedes aegypti , but the temporal dynamics underlying this effect remain incompletely characterized in field-relevant mosquito populations. Here, we compare DENV vector competence and viral replication kinetics between Wolbachia -infected Ae. aegypti from Noumea and a Wolbachia -free population from Ouvea, New Caledonia. Methods Female mosquitoes were orally infected with DENV-2 and sampled at 3, 7, 14, 21, 28, and 35 days post-infection (dpi). Infection, dissemination, and transmission were assessed, and viral titers were quantified in the abdomen, head-thorax, and saliva. Vector competence endpoints were analyzed using logistic regression, while viral titers were analyzed using linear models. The extrinsic incubation period (EIP) was estimated from transmission kinetics. Results Across all time points, DENV infection, dissemination, and transmission were markedly reduced in Wolbachia -infected mosquitoes from Noumea compared with Wolbachia -free population from Ouvea, with infection detected in 10.1% versus 86.7% of mosquitoes, dissemination in 3.4% versus 75.8%, and transmission in 1.7% versus 31.5%, respectively. After adjustment for dpi, the odds ratio of infection, dissemination, and transmission were strongly reduced in Noumea. The population effect on infection varied significantly over time, whereas no population × dpi interaction was detected for dissemination or transmission. The estimated EIP 25 and EIP 50 were delayed in Noumea compared with Ouvea, reaching 23.9 and 24.5 days, respectively, versus 14.4 and 17.6 days in Ouvea. Viral titers were also lower in Noumea, with significant population × dpi interactions in the abdomen and head-thorax. No significant interaction was detected in saliva, although comparisons were limited by the very low number of virus-positive Noumea mosquitoes at several time points. Conclusions Wolbachia infection strongly reduced DENV vector competence in the Noumea population five years after field release, with reduced vector competence and reduced viral titers. These findings demonstrate sustained functional pathogen blocking even after long period in field conditions and support the continued effectiveness of Wolbachia -based dengue control.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study compared DENV vector competence and viral replication kinetics between Wolbachia-infected Ae. aegypti from Noumea and a Wolbachia-free population from Ouvea, New Caledonia, over a period of five years post-field release.
analysis.methods: Female mosquitoes were orally infected with DENV-2 and sampled at various time points post-infection. Infection, dissemination, and transmission were assessed, and viral titers were quantified in different body parts using logistic regression and linear models. The extrinsic incubation period (EIP) was estimated from transmission kinetics.
analysis.main_results: Across all time points, DENV infection, dissemination, and transmission were significantly reduced in Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes from Noumea compared to the Wolbachia-free population from Ouvea. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate sustained functional pathogen blocking of DENV in the Noumea population five years after field release, supporting the continued effectiveness of Wolbachia-based dengue control.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results have implications for the long-term effectiveness of Wolbachia-based dengue control strategies, indicating that the reduction in DENV transmission persists over extended periods in field conditions.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究比较了沃尔巴克氏体感染的伊蚊之间的 DENV 媒介 能力和病毒复制动力学。来自努美阿的埃及伊蚊和来自新喀里多尼亚乌韦亚的无沃尔巴克氏体种群,在野外释放后的五年内。

elements_zh.main_results: 在所有时间点上,与来自乌韦亚的无沃尔巴克氏体蚊群相比,努美阿感染沃尔巴克氏体的蚊子中的 DENV 感染、传播和 传播 均显着减少。努美阿的感染、传播和 传播 的比值比大幅降低。努美阿人口的 EIP 也被推迟。努美阿人群的病毒滴度较低,腹部和头胸部存在显着的人群× dpi 相互作用。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解新喀里多尼亚野外释放五年后,沃尔巴克氏体介导的 登革病毒 (DENV) 阻断埃及伊蚊种群的时间动态,解决沃尔巴克氏体对 DENV 传播 的不完全表征的影响。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究比较了沃尔巴克氏体感染的伊蚊之间的 DENV 媒介 能力和病毒复制动力学。来自努美阿的埃及伊蚊和来自新喀里多尼亚乌韦亚的无沃尔巴克氏体种群,在野外释放后的五年内。
analysis_zh.methods: 雌性蚊子经口感染 DENV-2,并在感染后的不同时间点取样。对感染、传播和 传播 进行了评估,并使用逻辑回归和线性模型对不同身体部位的病毒滴度进行了定量。根据 传播 动力学估计外源潜伏期 (EIP)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在所有时间点上,与来自乌韦亚的无沃尔巴克氏体蚊群相比,努美阿感染沃尔巴克氏体的蚊子中的 DENV 感染、传播和 传播 均显着减少。努美阿的感染、传播和 传播 的比值比大幅降低。努美阿人口的 EIP 也被推迟。努美阿人群的病毒滴度较低,腹部和头胸部存在显着的人群× dpi 相互作用。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,在野外释放五年后,努美阿种群中的登革热病毒持续发挥功能性病原体阻断作用,支持基于沃尔巴克氏体的登革热控制的持续有效性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对基于沃尔巴克氏体的登革热控制策略的长期有效性具有影响,表明 DENV 传播 的减少在野外条件下持续较长时间。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究设计的局限性包括潜在的混杂因素以及需要更大的样本量来确认人口对感染随时间的影响。由于该研究的观察性质以及努美阿种群在几个时间点病毒呈阳性的蚊子数量有限,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Antiviral activity of Clinacanthus siamensis Bremek ethanolic extract against dengue virus serotype 2 infection
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) infection causes dengue fever and can progress to severe, life-threatening diseases. Currently, no specific antiviral therapy is available, and although vaccines exist, their variable efficacy across DENV serotypes raises safety concerns. Therefore, the identification of effective antiviral agents remains critical for reducing disease severity and limiting viral transmission. This study evaluated the antiviral activity of the Thai medicinal herb Clinacanthus siamensis against DENV infection. An ethanolic extract of C. siamensis was evaluated using in vitro DENV infection assays and demonstrated significant antiviral activity, with an IC50 value of 19.32 μg/mL. The inhibitory mechanism of the extract was evaluated across multiple stages of the viral life cycle using time-of-addition experiments, including pre-treatment, co-treatment, and post-infection conditions, in which the virus was exposed to the extract before, during, and after viral entry, respectively. The pre-treatment condition demonstrated the highest level of inhibition, with the extract reducing viral protein levels to 92.79 ± 7.74%, 60.30 ± 9.79%, and 12.52 ± 10.18% at concentrations of 15.625, 31.25, and 62.5 μg/mL, respectively. These findings suggest that the extract exerts its antiviral activity predominantly at an early stage of infection. This observation was further supported by virus-binding assays, which demonstrated that pretreatment of viral particles with the extract impaired their subsequent ability to bind to host cells, suggesting a direct effect on viral particles that may contribute to reduced viral infectivity. In addition, the bioactive constituents of the extract were characterized using LC–MS/MS analysis, which identified two compounds with reported antiviral activity, including isoferulic acid and luteolin, that may contribute to the observed anti-DENV effects. These findings demonstrate that C. siamensis possesses potent anti-DENV activity by reducing viral infectivity at an early stage of infection and highlights the potential of C. siamensis for future development as an affordable therapeutic candidate against DENV​ infection.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染会导致 登革热,并可能发展为严重的危及生命的疾病。目前,尚无特定的 抗病毒药物 疗法可用,尽管 疫苗 存在,但其在 DENV 血清型中的不同疗效引起了安全性担忧。因此,鉴定有效的 抗病毒药物 药物对于降低疾病严重程度和限制病毒 抗病毒药物 仍然至关重要。本研究评估了泰国药草 Clinacanthus siamensis 对抗 DENV 感染的 抗病毒药物 活性。使用体外 DENV 感染测定评估 C. siamensis 的乙醇提取物,并显示出显着的 抗病毒药物 活性,IC50 值为 19.32 μg/mL。使用添加时间实验在病毒生命周期的多个阶段评估提取物的抑制机制,包括预治疗、共治疗和感染后条件,其中病毒分别在病毒进入之前、期间和之后接触提取物。治疗 前条件表现出最高水平的抑制,提取物在浓度为 15.625、31.25 和 62.5 μg/mL 时,将病毒蛋白水平分别降低至 92.79 ± 7.74%、60.30 ± 9.79% 和 12.52 ± 10.18%。这些发现表明,提取物主要在感染的早期阶段发挥其 抗病毒药物 活性。这一观察结果得到了病毒结合测定的进一步支持,病毒结合测定表明,用提取物预处理病毒颗粒会损害其随后与 宿主 细胞结合的能力,这表明对病毒颗粒的直接影响可能有助于降低病毒感染性。此外,使用 LC-MS/MS 分析对提取物的生物活性成分进行了表征,确定了两种具有报道的 抗病毒药物 活性的化合物,包括异阿魏酸和木犀草素,这可能有助于观察到的抗 DENV 作用。这些研究结果表明,暹罗念珠菌通过降低感染早期的病毒感染性而具有有效的抗登革热病毒活性,并强调了暹罗念珠菌作为一种负担得起的针对登革热病毒感染的治疗候选药物的未来发展潜力。

papers.title: Evolutionary History and Genetic Diversity of the Four Dengue Virus Serotypes in Mexico from 1980 to 2021
papers.abstract: Dengue is the most significant arboviral disease worldwide and is caused by dengue virus (DENV), which comprises four antigenically distinct serotypes (DENV-1–4) further classified into multiple genotypes and lineages. Mexico is a hyperendemic region where the co-circulation of all four serotypes contributes to recurrent epidemic outbreaks. This study aimed to characterize the evolutionary dynamics, genetic diversity, and geographic distribution of DENV in Mexico. Sequences representing the four serotypes were retrieved from GenBank and analyzed using phylogenetic and population genetic approaches to identify circulating genotypes and lineages, lineage replacement patterns, and genetic differentiation. Multiple DENV lineages were found to have circulated in Mexico over time, with evidence of repeated introductions, persistence, and lineage replacement. The geographic distribution of the analyzed sequences suggests an important role for the southeastern and Gulf–Caribbean region, particularly Tabasco, Yucatán, Veracruz, and Quintana Roo, in the introduction and subsequent dispersal of DENV toward central, Pacific, and northern Mexico. These findings highlight the dynamic evolutionary history of DENV in Mexico and support the integration of systematic genomic surveillance with epidemiological monitoring to improve the detection of changes in circulating viral lineages and strengthen regional dengue preparedness and control strategies.
