This study aimed to characterize the evolutionary dynamics, genetic diversity, and geographic distribution of DENV in Mexico. Sequences representing the four serotypes were retrieved from GenBank and analyzed using phylogenetic and population genetic approaches to identify circulating genotypes and lineages, lineage replacement patterns, and genetic differentiation. Multiple DENV lineages were found to have circulated in Mexico over time, with evidence of repeated introductions, persistence, and lineage replacement. The geographic distribution of the analyzed sequences suggests an important role for the southeastern and Gulf–Caribbean region, particularly Tabasco, Yucatán, Veracruz, and Quintana Roo, in the introduction and subsequent dispersal of DENV toward central, Pacific, and northern Mexico. These findings highlight the dynamic evolutionary history of DENV in Mexico and support the integration of systematic genomic surveillance with epidemiological monitoring to improve the detection of changes in circulating viral lineages and strengthen regional dengue preparedness and control strategies.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究旨在描述墨西哥 DENV 的进化动态、遗传多样性和地理分布。
elements_zh.methods: 从 GenBank 检索代表四种血清型的序列,并使用系统发育和群体遗传学方法进行分析,以确定循环基因型和谱系、谱系替换模式和遗传分化。
elements_zh.main_results: 人们发现,随着时间的推移,多个登革热病毒谱系在墨西哥传播,有反复引入、持续存在和谱系更替的证据。分析序列的地理分布表明,东南部和海湾加勒比地区,特别是塔巴斯科州、尤卡坦州、韦拉克鲁斯州和金塔纳罗奥州,在登革热病毒向墨西哥​​中部、太平洋和北部的引入和随后扩散中发挥着重要作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突出了墨西哥登革热病毒的动态进化历史,并支持将系统性 基因组监测 与流行病学监测相结合,以改进对循环病毒谱系变化的检测,并加强区域登革热防范和控制策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要持续的 监测 和控制策略来解决墨西哥 DENV 循环的动态性质。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到对 GenBank 中可用序列的依赖以及可能丢失数据的限制。然而,由于对多个 DENV 谱系的综合分析,这些发现被认为具有很高的证据强度。

papers.title: Effect of Carica papaya Leaf Extract on Platelet Count in Dengue-Induced Thrombocytopenia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.abstract: Dengue fever remains a prime public health trouble in tropical regions and is regularly related to thrombocytopenia. Carica papaya leaf extract (CPLE) has been broadly used as a conventional medicine to increase platelet counts in dengue sufferers. Numerous studies have analyzed the ability of Carica papaya leaves, which have verified effective as a therapy for thrombocytopenia. This systematic overview changed into performed according with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) Guidelines. The Cochrane Risk of Bias tool (RoB 2.0) and the ROBINS-I tool (Risk of Bias in Non-randomized Studies of Interventions) have been used to evaluate bias, and Rstudio became used for statistical analysis. Carica papaya leaf extract confirmed a significant increase in platelet count compared to the control (SMD = 0.40; 95% CI: 0.18–0.63; p = 0.0003). Subgroup analysis by way of day confirmed that the impact was no longer extensive on days 2 and 4, however giant on days 3 (SMD = 0.46; 95% CI: 0.04–0.87) and 5 (SMD = 0.63; 95% CI: 0.14–1.13), without a significant differences among the assessment times. Inside the adult populace (29 studies; n = 4,133), the intervention had a sizable effect (SMD = 0.52; 95% CI: 0.31–0.73; p < 0.0001) with an increasing effect from day 3 to 5. Within the pediatric population (7 research; n = 1,260), the intervention impact numerous over time, with a non-sizable effect on day 2, a large effect on day 3 (SMD = 0.54; 95% CI: 0.31–0.77), and day 5 (SMD = 1.21; 95% CI: 0.96–1.45), and a considerable difference among evaluation days (p < 0.0001). Carica papaya leaf extract adjunctive therapy effectively increases platelets in dengue patients with thrombocytopenia in the adult population, but not significantly in children.

Carica papaya leaf extract (CPLE) has been broadly used as a conventional medicine to increase platelet counts in dengue sufferers. Numerous studies have analyzed the ability of Carica papaya leaves, which have verified effective as a therapy for thrombocytopenia. This systematic overview changed into performed according with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) Guidelines. The Cochrane Risk of Bias tool (RoB 2.0) and the ROBINS-I tool (Risk of Bias in Non-randomized Studies of Interventions) have been used to evaluate bias, and Rstudio became used for statistical analysis. Carica papaya leaf extract confirmed a significant increase in platelet count compared to the control (SMD = 0.40; 95% CI: 0.18–0.63; p = 0.0003). Subgroup analysis by way of day confirmed that the impact was no longer extensive on days 2 and 4, however giant on days 3 (SMD = 0.46; 95% CI: 0.04–0.87) and 5 (SMD = 0.63; 95% CI: 0.14–1.13), without a significant differences among the assessment times. Inside the adult populace (29 studies; n = 4,133), the intervention had a sizable effect (SMD = 0.52; 95% CI: 0.31–0.73; p < 0.0001) with an increasing effect from day 3 to 5. Within the pediatric population (7 research; n = 1,260), the intervention impact numerous over time, with a non-sizable effect on day 2, a large effect on day 3 (SMD = 0.54; 95% CI: 0.31–0.77), and day 5 (SMD = 1.21; 95% CI: 0.96–1.45), and a considerable difference among evaluation days (p < 0.0001). Carica papaya leaf extract adjunctive therapy effectively increases platelets in dengue patients with thrombocytopenia in the adult population, but not significantly in children.

analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 按日进行的亚组分析证实,第 2 天和第 4 天的影响并不广泛,但在第 3 天(SMD = 0.46;95% CI:0.04–0.87)和第 5 天(SMD = 0.63;95% CI:0.14–1.13)显着,评估时间之间没有显着差异。在成年人群中(29 项研究;n = 4,133),干预具有显着效果(SMD = 0.52;95% CI:0.31–0.73;p < 0.0001),并且从第 3 天到第 5 天效果逐渐增强。在儿科人群中(7 项研究;n = 1,260),干预效果随时间变化,第 2 天效果不显着,第 1 天效果显着。第 3 天(SMD = 0.54;95% CI:0.31–0.77)和第 5 天(SMD = 1.21;95% CI:0.96–1.45),并且评估日之间存在显着差异(p < 0.0001)。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 番木瓜叶提取物辅助治疗可有效增加成人血小板减少症登革热患者的血小板,但在儿童中效果不显着。

papers.title: Discordant RT-PCR Detection of Imported DENV-1 Infection: Diagnostic Challenges and Clinical Implications
papers.abstract: Background and Objectives: Dengue virus (DENV) diagnosis during the acute phase relies mainly on nucleic-acid amplification tests, whose sensitivity can be affected by viral sequence variation, specimen timing, and viral load. Case Presentation: We describe a 30-year-old woman who returned to Italy from Indonesia with acute fever, headache, myalgia, retro-orbital pain, presyncope, and vomiting. Initial molecular and serological tests for DENV were negative. Because clinical suspicion remained high, RT-PCR was repeated the following day using a commercial assay targeting a different genomic region. The second assay was positive, whereas the first remained negative; repeat serology later demonstrated DENV IgM and IgG seroconversion. Sequence-independent amplification followed by Illumina sequencing yielded a near-complete DENV-1 genome. Nextclade placed the sequence within lineage 1I_K.3 among predominantly Asian strains. Because the oligonucleotide sequences of the negative commercial assay are proprietary, a specific primer/probe mismatch could not be demonstrated. Nevertheless, repeated assay discordance in the presence of sequence-confirmed viremia supports target-dependent loss of analytical sensitivity. Conclusions: This observation emphasizes the need to interpret negative DENV RT-PCR results in relation to illness timing and epidemiological context and, when suspicion persists, to use complementary or orthogonal diagnostic approaches.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the diagnostic challenges of dengue virus (DENV) detection during the acute phase, particularly the variability in sensitivity of nucleic-acid amplification tests.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A 30-year-old woman returning to Italy from Indonesia with symptoms of acute fever and headache was the case study. The study involved molecular and serological tests for DENV.
analysis.methods: RT-PCR was performed twice using different commercial assays targeting different genomic regions. Sequence-independent amplification followed by Illumina sequencing was used to confirm the DENV-1 genome.
analysis.main_results: The first RT-PCR assay was negative, but the second was positive. Repeat serology confirmed DENV IgM and IgG seroconversion. The sequence was placed within lineage 1I_K.3 among predominantly Asian strains.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The discordant results highlight the need to interpret negative DENV RT-PCR results in relation to illness timing and epidemiological context, and to use complementary or orthogonal diagnostic approaches when suspicion persists.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the importance of considering the timing of specimen collection and the use of multiple diagnostic methods to improve the accuracy of DENV diagnosis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study design limitations include the use of proprietary commercial assays, which could not be directly compared for mismatches. The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size and the focus on a single case.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes a case where initial RT-PCR tests for DENV-1 were negative but a second test was positive, highlighting the need for careful interpretation of negative results and the use of multiple diagnostic methods.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景和目的:登革病毒 (DENV) 急性期的诊断主要依靠核酸扩增检测,其敏感性可能受到病毒序列变异、标本时间和病毒载量的影响。病例介绍:我们描述了一名 30 岁女性,她从印度尼西亚返回意大利,出现急性发烧、头痛、肌痛、眼眶后疼痛、先兆晕厥和呕吐。DENV 的初步分子和血清学检测结果呈阴性。由于临床怀疑仍然很高,因此第二天使用针对不同基因组区域的商业测定法重复了 RT-PCR。第二次检测呈阳性,而第一次检测仍呈阴性;重复 血清学 后来证明了 DENV IgM 和 IgG 血清转换。独立于序列的扩增和 Illumina 测序产生了近乎完整的 DENV-1 基因组。Nextclade 将序列置于主要为亚洲菌株的谱系 1I_K.3 内。由于阴性商业检测的寡核苷酸序列是专有的,因此无法证明特定的引物/探针不匹配。然而,在序列确认的病毒血症存在的情况下重复测定的不一致支持了分析灵敏度的靶标依赖性损失。结论:这一观察强调需要根据发病时间和流行病学背景来解释阴性 DENV RT-PCR 结果,并且当怀疑持续存在时,需要使用补充或正交诊断方法。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决急性期 登革病毒 (DENV) 检测的诊断挑战,特别是核酸扩增测试敏感性的变异性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 案例研究是一名从印度尼西亚返回意大利的 30 岁女性,她出现急性发烧和头痛症状。该研究涉及登革病毒的分子和血清学测试。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用针对不同基因组区域的不同商业化验进行两次 RT-PCR。使用独立于序列的扩增和随后的 Illumina 测序来确认 DENV-1 基因组。
analysis_zh.main_results: 第一次 RT-PCR 检测呈阴性,但第二次呈阳性。重复 血清学 确认 DENV IgM 和 IgG 血清转换。该序列位于主要亚洲菌株中的谱系 1I_K.3 内。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 不一致的结果凸显了需要根据发病时间和流行病学背景来解释阴性 DENV RT-PCR 结果,并在怀疑持续存在时使用补充或正交诊断方法。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了考虑标本采集时机和使用多种诊断方法以提高 DENV 诊断 准确性的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究设计的局限性包括使用专有的商业化验,无法直接比较不匹配情况。由于样本量较小且集中于单个案例,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Serum Cortisol and Lipid Profile as Predictors of Dengue Severity in Children: A Prospective Observational Study
papers.abstract: Introduction: Early prediction of severe dengue in children continues to be difficult, even with World Health Organisation (WHO) warning signs. Alterations in stress hormones and lipid metabolism have been associated with dengue severity; however, prospective paediatric data are limited. Serum cortisol and lipid profile are routinely available laboratory parameters and may provide additional information regarding disease severity. Aim: To evaluate the significance of serum cortisol and lipid profile in forecasting the advancement to severe dengue in children. Materials and Methods: This prospective observational study was conducted in the Department of Paediatrics, SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Kattankulathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, over two years (July 2024-July 2026). A total of 90 dengue NS1 or IgM ELISA-positive children aged between 0-14 years with warning signs and presenting between days 3 and 7 of illness were enrolled after informed consent. Serum cortisol and fasting lipid profile were measured at enrolment, and the day of illness at sampling was recorded. Children were classified according to subsequent progression to severe dengue. Categorical variables were compared using the Chisquare test and continuous variables using the independentsamples t-test; p-value <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: In the present study, 15 out of 90 (16.67%) children progressed to severe dengue. Boys constituted 57/90 (63.33%) of the cohort, and the largest age group was 1-5 years (32/90; 35.56%). Fluid accumulation, mucosal bleeding, lethargy, and significant liver enlargement were significantly associated with progression to severe dengue. Severe dengue was also associated with higher total leucocyte count and serum urea, lower serum sodium and bicarbonate, and prolonged prothrombin time. Mean serum cortisol was higher in children who progressed to severe dengue than in those who did not (18.74±6.14 vs 15.46±4.48 μg/dL; p-value =0.017). Mean triglyceride levels were also higher (220.07±141.71 vs 162.97±62.69 mg/dL; p-value =0.014), whereas mean total cholesterol levels were lower (99.67±23.70 vs 122.01±26.71 mg/dL; p-value =0.003). Very Low-Density Lipoprotein (VLDL), Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C), and High-Density Lipoprotein (HDL) levels did not differ significantly between groups. Conclusion: High levels of cortisol and triglycerides with low levels of total cholesterol at the time of admission are strongly linked to the development of severe dengue.
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF CLINICAL AND DIAGNOSTIC RESEARCH

Serum cortisol and lipid profile are routinely available laboratory parameters and may provide additional information regarding disease severity.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This prospective observational study was conducted in the Department of Paediatrics, SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Kattankulathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, over two years (July 2024-July 2026). A total of 90 dengue NS1 or IgM ELISA-positive children aged between 0-14 years with warning signs and presenting between days 3 and 7 of illness were enrolled after informed consent.
analysis_en.methods: Serum cortisol and fasting lipid profile were measured at enrolment, and the day of illness at sampling was recorded. Categorical variables were compared using the Chisquare test and continuous variables using the independent-samples t-test; p-value <0.05 was considered statistically significant.
analysis_en.main_results: In the present study, 15 out of 90 (16.67%) children progressed to severe dengue. Fluid accumulation, mucosal bleeding, lethargy, and significant liver enlargement were significantly associated with progression to severe dengue. Severe dengue was also associated with higher total leucocyte count and serum urea, lower serum sodium and bicarbonate, and prolonged prothrombin time. Mean serum cortisol was higher in children who progressed to severe dengue than in those who did not (18.74±6.14 vs 15.46±4.48 μg/dL; p-value =0.017). Mean triglyceride levels were also higher (220.07±141.71 vs 162.97±62.69 mg/dL; p-value =0.014), whereas mean total cholesterol levels were lower (99.67±23.70 vs 122.01±26.71 mg/dL; p-value =0.003).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: High levels of cortisol and triglycerides with low levels of total cholesterol at the time of admission are strongly linked to the development of severe dengue.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings may inform the development of non-invasive biomarkers for early identification of children at risk of severe dengue, aiding in targeted clinical management and resource allocation.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its observational design and potential confounding factors, but the evidence is moderate in strength due to the use of statistical tests and a defined cohort.

papers.title_zh: 儿童登革热严重程度的预测:血清皮质醇和脂质谱作为预测因子的前瞻性观察性研究
papers.source_body_en: Introduction: Early prediction of severe dengue in children continues to be difficult, even with World Health Organisation (WHO) warning signs. Alterations in stress hormones and lipid metabolism have been associated with dengue severity; however, prospective paediatric data are limited. Serum cortisol and lipid profile are routinely available laboratory parameters and may provide additional information regarding disease severity. Aim: To evaluate the significance of serum cortisol and lipid profile in forecasting the advancement to severe dengue in children. Materials and Methods: This prospective observational study was conducted in the Department of Paediatrics, SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Kattankulathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, over two years (July 2024-July 2026). A total of 90 dengue NS1 or IgM ELISA-positive children aged between 0-14 years with warning signs and presenting between days 3 and 7 of illness were enrolled after informed consent. Serum cortisol and fasting lipid profile were measured at enrolment, and the day of illness at sampling was recorded. Children were classified according to subsequent progression to severe dengue. Categorical variables were compared using the Chisquare test and continuous variables using the independentsamples t-test; p-value <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: In the present study, 15 out of 90 (16.67%) children progressed to severe dengue. Boys constituted 57/90 (63.33%) of the cohort, and the largest age group was 1-5 years (32/90; 35.56%). Fluid accumulation, mucosal bleeding, lethargy, and significant liver enlargement were significantly associated with progression to severe dengue. Severe dengue was also associated with higher total leucocyte count and serum urea, lower serum sodium and bicarbonate, and prolonged prothrombin time. Mean serum cortisol was higher in children who progressed to severe dengue than in those who did not (18.74±6.14 vs 15.46±4.48 μg/dL; p-value =0.017). Mean triglyceride levels were also higher (220.07±141.71 vs 162.97±62.69 mg/dL; p-value =0.014), whereas mean total cholesterol levels were lower (99.67±23.70 vs 122.01±26.71 mg/dL; p-value =0.003). Very Low-Density Lipoprotein (VLDL), Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C), and High-Density Lipoprotein (HDL) levels did not differ significantly between groups. Conclusion: High levels of cortisol and triglycerides with low levels of total cholesterol at the time of admission are strongly linked to the development of severe dengue.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言:即使有世界卫生组织(WHO)的警告信号,儿童登革热严重程度的早期预测仍然困难。压力激素和脂质代谢的变化与登革热严重程度有关,但前瞻性儿科数据有限。血清皮质醇和脂质谱是常规的实验室参数,可能提供有关疾病严重程度的额外信息。目的:评估血清皮质醇和脂质谱在预测儿童发展为登革热严重程度中的意义。材料与方法:本前瞻性观察性研究在印度泰米尔纳德邦金奈卡坦库拉特的SRM医学院医院和研究中心儿科部门进行,为期两年(2024年7月至2026年7月)。在获得知情同意后,共纳入了90名登革热NS1或IgM ELISA阳性、年龄在0-14岁之间、出现警告信号且在发病第3至第7天就诊的儿童。在入组时测量了血清皮质醇和空腹脂质谱,并记录了采样时的发病天数。根据后续发展为登革热严重程度对儿童进行分类。分类变量采用卡方检验,连续变量采用独立样本t检验;p值<0.05被认为具有统计学意义。结果:在本研究中,90名儿童中有15名(16.67%)发展为登革热严重程度。发展为登革热严重程度的儿童中,男孩占57/90(63.33%),最大年龄组为1-5岁(32/90;35.56%)。液体积聚、黏膜出血、嗜睡和显著肝脏肿大与发展为登革热严重程度显著相关。登革热严重程度还与较高的总白细胞计数和血清尿素、较低的血清钠和碳酸氢盐水平以及延长的凝血酶原时间有关。发展为登革热严重程度的儿童其血清皮质醇水平平均较高(18.74±6.14 vs 15.46±4.48 μg/dL;p值=0.017)。甘油三酯水平也较高(220.07±141.71 vs 162.97±62.69 mg/dL;p值=0.014),而总胆固醇水平较低(99.67±23.70 vs 122.01±26.71 mg/dL;p值=0.003)。极低密度脂蛋白(VLDL)、低密度脂蛋白胆固醇(LDL-C)和高密度脂蛋白(HDL)水平在两组之间没有显著差异。结论:入院时皮质醇和甘油三酯水平高而总胆固醇水平低,与登革热严重程度的发展有强烈关联。

papers.title: Profil Pasien Anak Dengan Demam Berdarah Dengue di RSUP Prof. Dr. R. D. Kandou Periode Januari 2023–Desember 2024
papers.abstract: Abstract: Dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) is a major health problem among children in Indonesia due to its high incidence and mortality rates. This study aimed to describe the clinical and laboratory profiles of pediatric patients with DHF at Prof. Kandou General Hospital from January 2023 to December 2024. This was a retrospective and descriptive study using patient medical records from 2023 to 2024. The results showed that most cases occurred in 2024, with the largest age group being 6–12 years old and predominantly male. The majority of patients were from Manado City and in good nutritional status. Common clinical manifestations were fever, abdominal pain, fluid accumulation, and shock. Laboratory findings showed leukopenia (45% of patients), increased hematocrit (53.9%), and severe thrombocytopenia (66.3%). Grade 3 DHF was the most common category (64.1%). Most patients were declared recovered, but mortality still reached 2.9%. In conclusion, dengue hemorrhagic fever cases in children most commonly occur in school-aged children. Manifestations of fever, gastrointestinal symptoms, plasma leakage, and shock dominate the clinical findings. Severe thrombocytopenia is the most common laboratory finding, and there are more cases of secondary infection. Despite the high recovery rate, the mortality rate that is still found emphasizes the urgency of early detection and optimal management during the critical phase. Keywords: dengue hemorrhagic fever; children; patient profile Abstrak: Demam berdarah dengue (DBD) merupakan masalah kesehatan utama pada anak di Indonesia karena tingginya angka kejadian dan mortalitas. Penelitian ini bertujuan menggambarkan profil klinis dan laboratorium pasien anak dengan DBD di RSUP Prof. Kandou periode Januari 2023–Desember 2024. Jenis penelitian ialah deskriptif retrospektif menggunakan data sekunder rekam medik pasien tahun 2023–2024. Hasil penelitian mendapatkan sebagian besar kasus terjadi pada tahun 2024, dengan kelompok usia terbanyak 6–12 tahun dan dominasi jenis kelamin laki-laki. Mayoritas pasien berasal dari Kota Manado dan memiliki status gizi baik. Manifestasi klinis yang umum dijumpai ialah demam, nyeri perut, akumulasi cairan, serta syok. Secara laboratorium, leukopenia ditemukan pada 45%, peningkatan hematokrit pada 53,9%, dan trombositopenia berat pada 66,3% pasien. Kategori terbanyak ialah DBD derajat 3 merupakan kategori terbanyak (64,1%). Sebagian besar pasien dinyatakan sembuh, namun mortalitas masih mencapai 2,9%. Simpulan penelitian ini kasus DBD pada anak paling banyak terjadi pada anak usia sekolah. Manifestasi demam, gastrointestinal, kebocoran plasma, dan syok mendominasi temuan klinis. Trombositopenia berat merupakan temuan laboratorium tersering dan lebih banyak kasus infeksi sekunder. Meskipun kesembuhan tinggi, mortalitas yang masih ditemukan menegaskan urgensi deteksi dini dan penanganan optimal pada fase kritis. Kata kunci: demam berdarah dengue; anak; profil pasien

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to describe the clinical and laboratory profiles of pediatric patients with dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) at Prof. Kandou General Hospital during the period January 2023–December 2024.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a retrospective and descriptive study using patient medical records from 2023 to 2024. The majority of patients were from Manado City and in good nutritional status.
analysis.methods: This study used patient medical records as data sources. It was a retrospective and descriptive study design.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that most cases occurred in 2024, with the largest age group being 6–12 years old and predominantly male. Laboratory findings showed leukopenia (45% of patients), increased hematocrit (53.9%), and severe thrombocytopenia (66.3%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that dengue hemorrhagic fever cases in children most commonly occur in school-aged children, and severe thrombocytopenia is the most common laboratory finding, with more cases of secondary infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the importance of early detection and optimal management during the critical phase of dengue hemorrhagic fever in children, particularly in school-aged groups.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on medical records, which may introduce bias or missing data. Despite the high recovery rate, the mortality rate of 2.9% highlights the need for further research and improved management strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes the clinical and laboratory profiles of pediatric patients with dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) at Prof. Dr. R. D. Kandou General Hospital from January 2023 to December 2024. It is a retrospective descriptive study using patient medical records. The results indicate that most cases occurred in 2024, predominantly in male children aged 6–12 years. Laboratory findings revealed leukopenia in 45% of patients, increased hematocrit in 53.9%, and severe thrombocytopenia in 66.3%. The most common DHF category was Grade 3 (64.1%), and the mortality rate was 2.9%. The authors concluded that DHF cases in children are most common in school-aged children, with severe thrombocytopenia being the most frequent laboratory finding and a higher prevalence of secondary infections. The study highlights the importance of early detection and optimal management during critical phases of the disease. However, the reliance on medical records may introduce limitations in data accuracy and completeness.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述 2023 年 1 月至 2024 年 12 月期间关藤教授综合医院登革出血热 (DHF) 儿科患者的临床和实验室概况。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项回顾性和描述性研究,使用了 2023 年至 2024 年患者的病历。大多数患者来自万鸦老市,营养状况良好。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究使用患者病历作为数据源。这是一项回顾性和描述性研究设计。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果显示,大多数病例发生在2024年,最大的年龄组为6-12岁,且以男性为主。实验室检查结果显示白细胞减少(45%的患者)、血细胞比容增加(53.9%)和严重的血小板减少(66.3%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,儿童登革出血热病例最常见于学龄儿童,最常见的实验室检查结果是严重的血小板减少,继发感染的病例较多。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了在儿童登革出血热关键阶段早期发现和最佳管理的重要性,特别是在学龄群体中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于医疗记录,这可能会引入偏差或缺失数据。尽管回收率很高,但 2.9% 的 死亡率 比率凸显了进一步研究和改进管理策略的必要性。

Laboratory findings showed leukopenia (45% of patients), increased hematocrit (53.9%), and severe thrombocytopenia (66.3%). Grade 3 DHF was the most common category (64.1%). Most patients were declared recovered, but mortality still reached 2.9%. In conclusion, dengue hemorrhagic fever cases in children most commonly occur in school-aged children. Manifestations of fever, gastrointestinal symptoms, plasma leakage, and shock dominate the clinical findings. Severe thrombocytopenia is the most common laboratory finding, and there are more cases of secondary infection. Despite the high recovery rate, the mortality rate that is still found emphasizes the urgency of early detection and optimal management during the critical phase. Penelitian ini bertujuan menggambarkan profil klinis dan laboratorium pasien anak dengan DBD di RSUP Prof. Kandou periode Januari 2023–Desember 2024. Jenis penelitian ialah deskriptif retrospektif menggunakan data sekunder rekam medik pasien tahun 2023–2024. Hasil penelitian mendapatkan sebagian besar kasus terjadi pada tahun 2024, dengan kelompok usia terbanyak 6–12 tahun dan dominasi jenis kelamin laki-laki. Mayoritas pasien berasal dari Kota Manado dan memiliki status gizi baik. Manifestasi klinis yang umum dijumpai ialah demam, nyeri perut, akumulasi cairan, serta syok. Secara laboratorium, leukopenia ditemukan pada 45%, peningkatan hematokrit pada 53,9%, dan trombositopenia berat pada 66,3% pasien. Kategori terbanyak ialah DBD derajat 3 merupakan kategori terbanyak (64,1%). Sebagian besar pasien dinyatakan sembuh, namun mortalitas masih mencapai 2,9%. Simpulan penelitian ini kasus DBD pada anak paling banyak terjadi pada anak usia sekolah. Manifestasi demam, gastrointestinal, kebocoran plasma, dan syok mendominasi temuan klinis. Trombositopenia berat merupakan temuan laboratorium tersering dan lebih banyak kasus infeksi sekunder. Meskipun kesembuhan tinggi, mortalitas yang masih ditemukan menegaskan urgensi deteksi dini dan penanganan optimal pada fase kritis. Kata kunci: demam berdarah dengue; anak; profil pasien

papers.title: Integrating community participation with a weighted dengue risk-stratification framework for commune-level prioritization in Ba Ria-Vung Tau Province, Vietnam
papers.abstract: Dengue prevention programs require transparent commune-level prioritization when epidemiological, entomological, and operational information must be combined. We implemented a stakeholder-informed weighted dengue risk-stratification framework in 72 communes, wards, and towns in Ba Ria-Vung Tau Province, Vietnam. Community participatory action research (CPAR) provided the participatory implementation approach, whereas the quantitative procedure was a deterministic additive score implemented in MS Access. The January 2022 score, based on information available through 2021, was temporally evaluated against observed 2022 incidence. After source-data quality control and application of the preceding five-year mean as the historical baseline, the January 2022 classification comprised 12 high-priority and 60 intermediate-priority units; the January 2023 classification comprised 34 intermediate-priority and 38 low-priority units. The 2022 score was inversely associated with absolute 2022 incidence (Spearman rho = -0.304, p = 0.009), with poor discrimination for upper-quartile absolute incidence (AUC = 0.335). High-priority units showed a larger relative increase from their 2016–2020 mean than intermediate-priority units (median 5.36-fold vs. 2.23-fold; p = 0.001), with an exploratory AUC of 0.711 for upper-quartile relative rebound. Classifications were sensitive to cut-offs and one-level uncertainty in ordinal inputs. The framework should be interpreted as a transparent local prioritization tool rather than a probabilistic prediction model. Prospective multi-year and external validation, assessor-reliability evaluation, and dengue-specific recalibration are required before broader use.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop a transparent commune-level prioritization framework for dengue prevention programs by integrating epidemiological, entomological, and operational data. The framework was implemented in 72 communes, wards, and towns in Ba Ria-Vung Tau Province, Vietnam, using a deterministic additive score in MS Access. The January 2022 score was evaluated against observed 2022 incidence, revealing an inverse association with absolute incidence (Spearman rho = -0.304, p = 0.009) and poor discrimination for upper-quartile absolute incidence (AUC = 0.335). The framework was described as a transparent local prioritization tool rather than a probabilistic prediction model. However, the study noted that classifications were sensitive to cut-offs and uncertainty in ordinal inputs, and emphasized the need for prospective multi-year validation, assessor-reliability evaluation, and dengue-specific recalibration before broader use.

papers.title: Spontaneous Splenic Rupture During the Recovery Phase of Severe Dengue Fever: Perioperative Anaesthetic Management of an Emergency Splenectomy
papers.abstract: Spontaneous splenic rupture is a rare but life-threatening complication of dengue fever and is most commonly reported during the critical phase. We describe an unusual case occurring during the recovery phase in a 35-year-old previously healthy man with severe dengue who initially improved with rising platelet counts before developing sudden left upper quadrant pain, hypotension, tachycardia, and anaemia. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography confirmed splenic rupture with haemoperitoneum, and emergency splenectomy was performed under general anaesthesia. Rotational thromboelastometry-guided transfusion supported targeted blood product therapy. Histopathology confirmed splenic rupture with extensive intraparenchymal haemorrhage and capsular disruption. The patient recovered well and was discharged in a stable condition. This case highlights the need to consider splenic rupture even during the recovery phase of dengue fever and the importance of early diagnosis, prompt surgery, and meticulous perioperative management.

papers.title: A standardized mosquito-to-mouse transmission assay with spatially defined bite areas
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne viruses initiate infection in the skin, where interactions between viral particles, host cells, and mosquito saliva can influence early infection and subsequent viral dissemination. Investigating these events requires methods that link mosquito exposure to the precise site of inoculation. However, identifying individual bite sites during subsequent tissue collection remains a practical challenge in mosquito-to-mouse transmission models. Here, we describe a standardized mosquito-to-mouse transmission assay that facilitates the localization of mosquito bite sites and targeted tissue sampling. The method combines a custom 3D-printed feeding device, individual mosquito exposure, and perforated adhesive tape to define the biting area and mark identified bite sites for subsequent collection. We demonstrate the application of this protocol using West Nile virus (WNV) and Dengue virus (DENV)-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes with C57BL/6J mice and A129 Ifnar1-/- mice, respectively. All infected mosquitoes successfully blood-fed within 20 min of exposure. After three infected-mosquito bites, mice developed clinical signs from approximately day 6 post-bite, with mortality occurring between days 8 and 10 for WNV, while disease onset occurred at 4 days post bite and most of the mice recovered by day 10 for DENV. To investigate early WNV viral kinetics in skin, WNV genomic RNA was quantified in biopsies collected at marked bite sites and the draining inguinal lymph nodes. Viral RNA was detected in both tissues as early as 1 h post-bite, and RNA levels increased significantly at 24 h post-bite. This protocol provides a practical approach for identifying mosquito bite sites and investigating early tissue-level events following vector-mediated transmission. With appropriate validation, the protocol can be adapted to other vector pathogen host systems and downstream analyses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a method for investigating early tissue-level events following vector-mediated transmission of dengue virus, as mosquito-borne viruses initiate infection in the skin where interactions between viral particles, host cells, and mosquito saliva can influence early infection and subsequent viral dissemination.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study describes a standardized mosquito-to-mouse transmission assay using Aedes aegypti mosquitoes infected with Dengue virus (DENV) and C57BL/6J mice, with the protocol demonstrated using DENV-1 and DENV-2 in separate experiments.
analysis.methods: The method combines a custom 3D-printed feeding device, individual mosquito exposure, and perforated adhesive tape to define the biting area and mark identified bite sites for subsequent collection.
analysis.main_results: Viral RNA was detected in both tissues as early as 1 h post-bite, and RNA levels increased significantly at 24 h post-bite.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: This protocol provides a practical approach for identifying mosquito bite sites and investigating early tissue-level events following vector-mediated transmission of dengue virus.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer a methodological advancement for studying dengue virus transmission dynamics and early infection processes, which can inform future research on dengue pathogenesis and intervention strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report limitations or evidence strength for the study.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a standardized mosquito-to-mouse transmission assay designed to investigate early tissue-level events during dengue virus transmission. The method uses a 3D-printed feeding device, individual mosquito exposure, and perforated adhesive tape to define and mark biting areas. The protocol was demonstrated using Dengue virus (DENV)-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and C57BL/6J mice. Viral RNA was detected in both bite site biopsies and draining inguinal lymph nodes as early as 1 hour post-bite, with significant increases observed at 24 hours post-bite. The study highlights the utility of this method for understanding dengue virus dissemination and its potential adaptation for other vector-pathogen systems. The evidence is based on a single experiment with DENV, and no limitations are reported.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究描述了使用感染 登革病毒 (DENV) 的埃及伊蚊和 C57BL/6J 小鼠进行的标准化蚊对小鼠 传播 测定,并在单独的实验中使用 DENV-1 和 DENV-2 演示了该方案。
elements_zh.methods: 该方法结合了定制的 3D 打印喂食装置、个体蚊子暴露和穿孔胶带来定义叮咬区域并标记已识别的叮咬部位以供后续收集。
elements_zh.main_results: 早在被咬后 1 小时,两种组织中就检测到病毒 RNA,并且在被咬后 24 小时,RNA 水平显着增加。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该协议提供了一种实用方法,用于识别蚊子叮咬部位并调查 媒介 介导的 登革病毒 的 传播 后的早期组织水平事件。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为研究 登革病毒 传播 动力学和早期感染过程提供了方法学上的进步,可以为未来登革热 发病机制 和干预策略的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据并未报告研究的局限性或证据强度。

papers.title: Stakeholder digital readiness for AI-driven dengue surveillance and reporting system
papers.abstract: Background As the public health sector moves towards digital health transformation, artificial intelligence offers opportunities to improve disease surveillance, early disease detection and strengthen reporting systems. However, the adoption of these technologies depends on stakeholder knowledge, readiness, and practices. Therefore, this study assesses stakeholders’ awareness, preventative practices, digital access, and readiness for dengue surveillance in Kingston, Jamaica. Methods The study employed a cross-sectional quantitative mixed-mode survey. The questionnaire comprised of multiple choice and open-ended questions with 397 participants and 391 eligible data registrations. Participants were recruited through online channels and in-person paper-based questionnaires administered at healthcare facilities across Kingston. Quantitative data was analyzed descriptively on SPSS Version 30 with Pearson Chi-square tests and a p -value of ≤ 0.05, while qualitative components were thematically analyzed. Findings Results reveal that 72.1% of the participants reported having high readiness, 10.2% reported moderate digital readiness and 17.6% reported low readiness. 96.4% of the study participants expressed willingness to adopt AI-driven digital health tools. Yet only 31.1% of the participants who answered the question indicated high confidence, while 50.4% of the study respondents indicated neutral confidence in using digital health tools. The most desired AI feature is patient engagement chatbots at 86.3%. Digital readiness was significantly correlated to elevated level of education, primary role in healthcare, age group, residence and prior use of digital health tools. The frequently reported concerns were privacy of information and trust in the system. Conclusion Study participants exhibited strong digital infrastructure readiness and substantial adoption willingness to AI-driven eHealth solutions. Nonetheless, the stakeholders expressed concerns about data privacy and trust in the systems. This study contributes to vector-borne disease surveillance literature while demonstrating the importance of integrating community-based knowledge and technology readiness in public health technology design and adoption. This study may assist in the co-design and development of an AI-enabled digital dengue surveillance eHealth system relevant to the Kingston context. Future research should focus on education and training of all stakeholders to improve their capability in navigating the digital health landscape. Additionally, the ethical use of generative AI in digital health can be explored.

papers.title: Malaria and Dengue Co-infection in Pregnancy Causing Severe Thrombocytopenia: A Case Report Highlighting Diagnostic and Management Challenges Due to Overlapping Clinical Features
papers.abstract: Background: Malaria and dengue are mosquito-borne infections that pose significant health risks during pregnancy and may adversely affect maternal and fetal outcomes. Their overlapping clinical manifestations can complicate diagnosis and delay appropriate management, particularly when both infections occur concurrently. Aim: This case report aims to highlight the rarity of malaria and dengue coinfection in pregnancy and the importance of extensive targeted testing and prompt maternal optimisation to minimise adverse obstetric outcomes. Case Presentation: A 22-year-old primigravida at 37 weeks and 4 days of gestation was referred after presenting with five days of headache, fever, vomiting and diarrhoea. Testing identified Plasmodium vivax malaria, and her initial platelet count was 18,000/μL. At the receiving hospital, dengue-specific IgM and IgG antibodies were positive, the platelet count was 40,000/μL, and ultrasound showed oligohydramnios with an amniotic fluid index of 4.14 cm. She was admitted to a high-dependency unit for close monitoring, clinical stabilisation and delivery planning. Management included intravenous crystalloid fluids, eight units of platelets, one unit of fresh frozen plasma and chloroquine. Following improvement in the platelet count to 60,000/μL on the third day, labour was induced using misoprostol and a transcervical Foley balloon and augmented with oxytocin. She delivered a live male infant vaginally, weighing 2,860 g, without reported immediate maternal or neonatal complications. Estimated blood loss was 225 mL. On the seventh day of admission, the platelet count had risen to 128,000/μL and the malaria smear was negative. She was discharged on the twelfth day. Conclusion: Pregnant women diagnosed with either infection who exhibit severe symptoms should be extensively investigated for coinfection, and prompt treatment should be initiated to optimise maternal and fetal outcomes.

papers.title: Impact of a point-of-care rapid diagnostic test on the dengue diagnostic cascade in an emergency department in a non-endemic setting: A before-after study (RaDDEO).
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Timely recognition of dengue is increasingly important in non-endemic regions, where imported viremic cases may trigger local transmission. We evaluated whether introducing a combined point-of-care rapid diagnostic test (RDT; NS1/IgM/IgG) shortened the time to dengue diagnosis in an emergency department; secondarily, we (a) assessed its impact on length of stay, admission and notification, (b) reconstructed the diagnostic cascade to identify excessive time lapses and missed opportunities, and (c) evaluated its diagnostic performance. METHODS: Single-center retrospective before-after study in Montpellier University Hospital, southern France. Adults undergoing dengue testing were compared between pre-RDT (10/2022-07/2024) and post-RDT (08/2024-05/2026) periods. The primary endpoint was the time from arrival to availability of the diagnostic result. RDT performance was assessed against the clinical diagnosis. RESULTS: Among 88 patients (36 pre-, 52 post-RDT), 28 had dengue, all of them returning travelers, and 57% had sought healthcare before ED presentation. After RDT implementation, time to diagnosis decreased from 24.3 to 2.5 h (median gain 19.6 h, 95%CI 13.9-44.8; p < 0.001). The most time-consuming step was laboratory turnaround (median 25.6 h). While no significant differences were observed in terms of length of stay, hospital admission, and mandatory notification, the study was underpowered to assess these outcomes. RDT sensitivity was 100% and specificity 70.3%; all false positives were antibody bands, primarily in patients with imported malaria. CONCLUSION: The RDT shortened time to diagnosis by 20 h without missing any cases of acute dengue. However, it did not accelerate downstream clinical or public-health processes, highlighting a need to raise frontline clinician awareness in view of ensuring timely notification.

papers.title_zh: 非流行环境中急诊科的登革热快速诊断测试对登革热诊断级联的影响:前后研究 (RaDDEO)。
papers.source_body_en: OBJECTIVE: Timely recognition of dengue is increasingly important in non-endemic regions, where imported viremic cases may trigger local transmission. We evaluated whether introducing a combined point-of-care rapid diagnostic test (RDT; NS1/IgM/IgG) shortened the time to dengue diagnosis in an emergency department; secondarily, we (a) assessed its impact on length of stay, admission and notification, (b) reconstructed the diagnostic cascade to identify excessive time lapses and missed opportunities, and (c) evaluated its diagnostic performance. METHODS: Single-center retrospective before-after study in Montpellier University Hospital, southern France. Adults undergoing dengue testing were compared between pre-RDT (10/2022-07/2024) and post-RDT (08/2024-05/2026) periods. The primary endpoint was the time from arrival to availability of the diagnostic result. RDT performance was assessed against the clinical diagnosis. RESULTS: Among 88 patients (36 pre-, 52 post-RDT), 28 had dengue, all of them returning travelers, and 57% had sought healthcare before ED presentation. After RDT implementation, time to diagnosis decreased from 24.3 to 2.5 h (median gain 19.6 h, 95%CI 13.9-44.8; p < 0.001). The most time-consuming step was laboratory turnaround (median 25.6 h). While no significant differences were observed in terms of length of stay, hospital admission, and mandatory notification, the study was underpowered to assess these outcomes. RDT sensitivity was 100% and specificity 70.3%; all false positives were antibody bands, primarily in patients with imported malaria. CONCLUSION: The RDT shortened time to diagnosis by 20 h without missing any cases of acute dengue. However, it did not accelerate downstream clinical or public-health processes, highlighting a need to raise frontline clinician awareness in view of ensuring timely notification.

papers.title: A Retrospective Study of Dengue among Paediatric Patients Admitted to New Amsterdam Regional Hospital, Guyana, from January to December 2025
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue is an important cause of paediatric hospitalisation in tropical regions, but facility-specific descriptions of admitted children in Guyana remain limited. Objective: To describe the demographic characteristics, clinical presentations, serological findings, severity categories and duration of hospitalisation among paediatric patients with dengue at New Amsterdam Regional Hospital, Guyana, during 2025. Methods: A hospital-based retrospective review examined the medical records of children admitted between January and December 2025. Available demographic, clinical, diagnostic and hospital-stay information was summarised descriptively. Results: The study included 120 patients. Children aged 3–5 years accounted for 60 admissions (50.0%), and 80 patients (66.7%) were female. Fever was recorded in all patients (120; 100%), followed by vomiting (81; 67.5%) and rash (78; 65.0%). IgM positivity was recorded in 106 patients (88.3%), NS1 antigen positivity in 71 (59.2%) and IgG positivity in 40 (33.3%). Based on the reported severity classification, 36 patients (30.0%) had dengue without warning signs, 69 (57.5%) had dengue with warning signs and 15 (12.5%) had severe dengue. Hospital stays ranged from 1 to 7 days, with a median of 4 days. Conclusion: The findings describe the clinical and demographic distribution of paediatric dengue admissions at this regional hospital and indicate that warning signs were common among admitted patients. The results may support local clinical review and planning, although they do not establish population-level incidence or causal relationships.

papers.title_zh: 2025 年 1 月至 12 月圭亚那新阿姆斯特丹地区医院收治的儿科患者登革热的回顾性研究
papers.source_body_en: Background: Dengue is an important cause of paediatric hospitalisation in tropical regions, but facility-specific descriptions of admitted children in Guyana remain limited. Objective: To describe the demographic characteristics, clinical presentations, serological findings, severity categories and duration of hospitalisation among paediatric patients with dengue at New Amsterdam Regional Hospital, Guyana, during 2025. Methods: A hospital-based retrospective review examined the medical records of children admitted between January and December 2025. Available demographic, clinical, diagnostic and hospital-stay information was summarised descriptively. Results: The study included 120 patients. Children aged 3–5 years accounted for 60 admissions (50.0%), and 80 patients (66.7%) were female. Fever was recorded in all patients (120; 100%), followed by vomiting (81; 67.5%) and rash (78; 65.0%). IgM positivity was recorded in 106 patients (88.3%), NS1 antigen positivity in 71 (59.2%) and IgG positivity in 40 (33.3%). Based on the reported severity classification, 36 patients (30.0%) had dengue without warning signs, 69 (57.5%) had dengue with warning signs and 15 (12.5%) had severe dengue. Hospital stays ranged from 1 to 7 days, with a median of 4 days. Conclusion: The findings describe the clinical and demographic distribution of paediatric dengue admissions at this regional hospital and indicate that warning signs were common among admitted patients. The results may support local clinical review and planning, although they do not establish population-level incidence or causal relationships.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革热是热带地区儿童住院的重要原因之一,但圭亚那新阿姆斯特丹地区医院收治的儿童的具体情况描述仍较为有限。目的:描述2025年在圭亚那新阿姆斯特丹地区医院因登革热住院的儿科患者的年龄分布、临床表现、血清学结果、严重程度分类及住院时长。方法:本研究为基于医院的回顾性分析,审查了2025年1月至12月期间住院儿童的医疗记录。总结了可用的年龄、临床、诊断及住院信息。结果:研究共纳入120名患者。3-5岁儿童占60例(50.0%),80名患者(66.7%)为女性。所有患者均记录有发热(120;100%),呕吐(81;67.5%)和皮疹(78;65.0%)。IgM阳性结果在106名患者中被记录(88.3%),NS1抗原阳性在71名患者中被记录(59.2%),IgG阳性在40名患者中被记录(33.3%)。根据报告的严重程度分类,36名患者(30.0%)为无预警迹象的登革热,69名患者(57.5%)为有预警迹象的登革热,15名患者(12.5%)为重症登革热。住院时间范围为1至7天,中位数为4天。结论:研究结果描述了该地区医院儿科登革热住院的临床和年龄分布情况,并表明预警迹象在住院患者中较为常见。这些结果可能支持当地的临床评估和规划,尽管它们并未建立人群水平的发病率或因果关系。

papers.full_text: Abstract In this study, we propose a new machine learning model to identify dengue fever patients. Specifically, we convert actual medical records into text data using Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology and extract features from this data. Subsequently, we generate high-dimensional features using unsupervised learning and construct a training dataset. Using this training data, we adopted seven types of Deep Neural Networks (DNN), FT-Transformer, and ResNet as base models. Additionally, we performed ensemble learning (stacking) by using Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, DNN, and FT-Transformer as meta-models, and compared and verified each stacking model. To evaluate the performance of the models, we used precision, recall, F1 score, and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) as the main indicators, and conducted hyperparameter optimization using Optuna to evaluate and verify the models from multiple perspectives. Comparing the performance of the 9 base models, DNN2 shows the highest accuracy, while FT-Transformer shows the highest recall. papers.title: Aedes larval breeding sites in public places and their spatial overlay with reported dengue cases in Pedurungan, Semarang, Indonesia
papers.abstract: Public places may serve as dengue transmission sites, but larval surveys in Semarang have mostly targeted houses. This descriptive cross-sectional study describes Aedes larval breeding sites in public places in Pedurungan sub-district and overlays them with reported dengue cases. In March–May 2024, 97 of 690 public places were surveyed with the single-larva method; sites near reported cases were prioritised, so the sample is not representative. House-based indices were adapted to public places (HI, CI, BI, LFI; density figure, DF). Sixty-three dengue cases reported from January 2023 to February 2024, before the larval survey, were mapped in a descriptive GIS overlay. Thirty public places (30.93%) and 75 of 389 containers (19.28%) were larva-positive. Buckets contributed most positive containers (70 of 75), whereas bathtubs had the highest positivity (25.00%). Among sampled positive containers, 92% of larvae identified were Aedes aegypti and 8% Aedes albopictus. Eight urban villages had high, two medium and one low mean DF; Penggaron Kidul was not assessed. Reported cumulative incidence over 14 months was 0.34, 0.38 and 0.19 per 1,000 in the high, medium and low categories, with no clear graded pattern. No association is established; control in public places should be complemented by residential surveillance.

The results showed that 30.93% of public places and 19.28% of containers were larva-positive, with buckets and bathtubs being the most common breeding sites. Among the larvae identified, 92% were Aedes aegypti and 8% were Aedes albopictus. The study found no clear graded pattern in cumulative incidence across different categories of public places. The findings suggest that public places should be integrated into dengue surveillance strategies, as they may play a significant role in mosquito breeding and transmission. However, the study's non-representative sample and lack of clear patterns limit the strength of the evidence, which is considered moderate.

papers.title_zh: 印度尼西亚三宝垄 Pedurungan 公共场所的伊蚊幼虫繁殖地及其与报告的登革热病例的空间重叠
papers.source_body_en: Public places may serve as dengue transmission sites, but larval surveys in Semarang have mostly targeted houses. This descriptive cross-sectional study describes Aedes larval breeding sites in public places in Pedurungan sub-district and overlays them with reported dengue cases. In March–May 2024, 97 of 690 public places were surveyed with the single-larva method; sites near reported cases were prioritised, so the sample is not representative. House-based indices were adapted to public places (HI, CI, BI, LFI; density figure, DF). Sixty-three dengue cases reported from January 2023 to February 2024, before the larval survey, were mapped in a descriptive GIS overlay. Thirty public places (30.93%) and 75 of 389 containers (19.28%) were larva-positive. Buckets contributed most positive containers (70 of 75), whereas bathtubs had the highest positivity (25.00%). Among sampled positive containers, 92% of larvae identified were Aedes aegypti and 8% Aedes albopictus. Eight urban villages had high, two medium and one low mean DF; Penggaron Kidul was not assessed. Reported cumulative incidence over 14 months was 0.34, 0.38 and 0.19 per 1,000 in the high, medium and low categories, with no clear graded pattern. No association is established; control in public places should be complemented by residential surveillance.

papers.title: A study of the global properties and optimal control of dengue disease transmission model
papers.abstract: In this work, we formulate a nonlinear system of differential equations that models the transmission dynamics of dengue fever. The model exhibits the classical threshold behavior. We prove that when the basic reproduction number is less than one, the disease-free equilibrium is locally and globally asymptotically stable and when the basic reproduction number is greater than one the endemic equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable under certain conditions. The stability of equilibria is derived through the use of Lyapunov stability theory and LaSalle's invariance principle. In addition we formulate an optimal control problem involving preventive measures, the investment in vaccination of susceptible humans and the investment related to insecticide treatment. Numerical simulations are provided to illustrate the theoretical results.
papers.journal: Analele Universității din Oradea fascicola Matematica

The study provides a framework for understanding disease transmission but is limited to mathematical analysis without empirical validation. The findings have implications for public health strategies aimed at reducing dengue burden through targeted interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解登革热疾病 传播 的整体特性,并探索其预防和管理的最佳控制策略。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及制定一个数学模型来表示 登革热 的 传播 动态,重点关注疾病的整体特性和最佳控制措施的应用。
elements_zh.methods: 利用李亚普诺夫稳定性理论和拉萨尔不变原理对模型进行分析,以确定无病平衡和地方病平衡的稳定性,并制定最优控制问题来评估预防措施。
elements_zh.main_results: 该模型表现出经典的阈值行为,当基本再生数小于 1 时,无病平衡局部和全局渐近稳定;当基本再生数在一定条件下超过 1 时,地方性平衡全局渐近稳定。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为理解登革热 传播 动态的理论框架,并提出了涉及 疫苗接种 和杀虫剂 治疗 的最佳控制策略,作为疾病管理的新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为制定针对性干预措施(例如 疫苗接种 计划和使用杀虫剂来控制登革热 传播 和减轻疾病负担)提供了理论基础。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于数学模型,不涉及经验数据,这限制了其对现实场景的适用性。证据是理论上的,来自数学分析。

papers.full_text: Abstract The expression of galectin-8 in various organs and its characterization through in silico analysis with possible anti-viral activity were carried out from the grubs of Oryctes rhinoceros. Galectin-8 amplification, sequencing, and amino acid prediction, along with molecular analysis, revealed functional domains specific to galectins in several other insect species. Further, quantification of galectin-8 transcripts revealed significantly higher expression levels in hemocyte lysate than in any other organ. The glycan lactose, which specifically inhibited galectin activity, was used as a ligand in molecular docking, yielding a binding energy of -8.5 kcal/mol and revealing lactose’s specificity for galectin-8. MD simulations performed to assess binding stability revealed an interaction between galectin-8 and lactose. The protein-protein docking between galectin-8 and the dengue viral non-structural proteins NS1 and NS5 suggested the probable antiviral activity of galectin-8. Data availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. Abstract The expression of galectin-8 in various organs and its characterization through in silico analysis with possible anti-viral activity were carried out from the grubs of Oryctes rhinoceros. Galectin-8 amplification, sequencing, and amino acid prediction, along with molecular analysis, revealed functional domains specific to galectins in several other insect species. Further, quantification of galectin-8 transcripts revealed significantly higher expression levels in hemocyte lysate than in any other organ. The glycan lactose, which specifically inhibited galectin activity, was used as a ligand in molecular docking, yielding a binding energy of -8.5 kcal/mol and revealing lactose’s specificity for galectin-8. MD simulations performed to assess binding stability revealed an interaction between galectin-8 and lactose. The protein-protein docking between galectin-8 and the dengue viral non-structural proteins NS1 and NS5 suggested the probable antiviral activity of galectin-8. papers.title_original: Molecular characterization and in silico analyses of galectin-8 from Oryctes rhinoceros and its possible antiviral activity against the dengue virus

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to characterize galectin-8 from Oryctes rhinoceros and explore its potential antiviral activity against dengue virus. The research addressed the need for understanding host-virus interactions and potential antiviral mechanisms in dengue infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved molecular characterization of galectin-8 from Oryctes rhinoceros grubs, focusing on its expression and functional domains. No specific human or animal population was studied.
analysis.methods: Galectin-8 was amplified, sequenced, and analyzed for amino acid prediction and molecular domains. The protein’s interaction with lactose and dengue viral non-structural proteins was assessed through molecular docking and simulations.
analysis.main_results: Galectin-8 showed significantly higher expression in hemocyte lysate compared to other organs. Molecular docking revealed a binding energy of -8.5 kcal/mol between galectin-8 and lactose, suggesting specificity. Protein-protein docking suggested potential antiviral activity against dengue viral non-structural proteins NS1 and NS5.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study provided novel insights into the functional domains of galectin-8 and its potential antiviral activity against dengue virus, highlighting its specificity for lactose and its interaction with dengue viral proteins.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings could inform future studies on galectin-8’s role in dengue infection and potentially lead to new antiviral strategies. The specificity of galectin-8 for lactose suggests a potential therapeutic target.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s limitations include the absence of experimental data and the use of in silico methods, which may not fully reflect in vivo interactions. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on computational methods.

analysis.summary_en: This study characterized galectin-8 from Oryctes rhinoceros and found it to have potential antiviral activity against dengue virus through in silico analyses. The protein showed high specificity for lactose and interacted with dengue viral non-structural proteins, suggesting a possible therapeutic target.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在表征来自 Oryctes rhinoceros 的半乳糖凝集素 8,并探讨其针对 抗病毒药物 的潜在 抗病毒药物 活性。该研究解决了了解 宿主 与病毒相互作用以及登革热感染中潜在的 抗病毒药物 机制的需要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及来自 Oryctes rhinoceros grubs 的半乳糖凝集素 8 的分子表征,重点关注其表达和功能域。没有研究特定的人类或动物群体。
elements_zh.methods: Galectin-8 被扩增、测序并分析氨基酸预测和分子结构域。通过分子对接和模拟评估了该蛋白质与乳糖和登革热病毒非结构蛋白的相互作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 与其他器官相比,半乳糖凝集素 8 在血细胞裂解物中的表达显着更高。分子对接显示半乳糖凝集素 8 和乳糖之间的结合能为 -8.5 kcal/mol,表明具有特异性。蛋白质-蛋白质对接表明 抗病毒药物 对登革热病毒非结构蛋白 NS1 和 NS5 具有潜在活性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究为半乳糖凝集素 8 的功能域及其针对 抗病毒药物 的潜在 抗病毒药物 活性提供了新的见解,强调了其对乳糖的特异性及其与登革热病毒蛋白的相互作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为未来关于半乳糖凝集素 8 在登革热感染中的作用的研究提供信息,并可能导致新的 抗病毒药物 策略。Galectin-8 对乳糖的特异性表明了其潜在的治疗靶点。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括缺乏实验数据和使用计算机方法,这可能无法完全反映体内相互作用。由于依赖计算方法,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Dominó da dengue: jogo educativo como estratégia de educação em saúde no Conhecendo a Unipampa
papers.abstract: A dengue constitui um importante problema de saúde pública, cuja prevenção envolve a participação da comunidade, a Educação em Saúde e a identificação de fatores ambientais que favorecem a proliferação do mosquito Aedes aegypti. Nesse contexto, estratégias educativas e lúdicas podem aproximar os conhecimentos em saúde do cotidiano de crianças e adolescentes. Objetiva-se relatar a experiência de elaboração e utilização do jogo educativo “Dominó da Dengue” em uma atividade com estudantes da educação básica. Trata-se de um relato de experiência acerca de uma ação desenvolvida por acadêmicos da Universidade Federal do Pampa (UNIPAMPA), incluindo discentes vinculados ao Programa de Educação pelo Trabalho para a Saúde (PET-Saúde) Clima, durante o evento “Conhecendo a UNIPAMPA”, em Uruguaiana/RS. Participaram aproximadamente 30 estudantes de escolas visitantes, conforme estimativa dos responsáveis pela atividade, sem registro do quantitativo exato. O jogo foi elaborado com base na dinâmica tradicional do dominó, adaptada para abordar o mosquito vetor, a transmissão, os principais sinais e sintomas da dengue e as medidas de prevenção, incluindo a identificação e a eliminação de criadouros. Durante a atividade, os estudantes responderam às questões apresentadas nas peças e discutiram os conteúdos com os acadêmicos mediadores. Ao término, preencheram um instrumento elaborado pelos autores para registrar suas percepções sobre o jogo e a experiência vivenciada. A aplicação do recurso proporcionou situações de interação entre os estudantes e os mediadores, nas quais os conteúdos sobre dengue foram abordados por meio de perguntas, respostas e diálogo. A experiência articulou ludicidade e Educação em Saúde e promoveu a aproximação entre a universidade e a comunidade escolar. O preenchimento do instrumento possibilitou o registro das percepções dos participantes, constituindo uma fonte de informações para subsidiar o aprimoramento do recurso e de futuras atividades. Entretanto, a ausência de registro exato do número de participantes e de avaliação específica da aprendizagem limita as conclusões sobre os efeitos educativos do jogo. Conclui-se que o “Dominó da Dengue” constituiu um recurso para mediar a abordagem participativa da temática no contexto da atividade realizada. A experiência oferece subsídios para novas ações com a comunidade escolar, sendo necessárias avaliações sistemáticas para verificar sua contribuição para a aprendizagem e para as práticas de prevenção.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents the experience of developing and using an educational game called "Dominó da Dengue" to teach students about dengue, its transmission, symptoms, and prevention. The game was created by academics from the Universidade Federal do Pampa (UNIPAMPA) during the "Conhecendo a UNIPAMPA" event in Uruguaiana/RS, involving approximately 30 students from visiting schools. The game was based on traditional domino dynamics, adapted to include information about the Aedes aegypti mosquito and dengue prevention measures. The activity facilitated interaction between students and mediators, allowing for discussion and dialogue on dengue-related topics. The game was seen as a tool to promote participatory learning and bridge the gap between academia and the school community. However, the lack of exact participant numbers and specific learning assessments limits the conclusions about the game's educational effects. The study highlights the potential of such games to enhance health education and community engagement in dengue prevention.

papers.title: A tetravalent mRNA-LNP dengue vaccine incorporating antigen engineering confers broad protective immunity
papers.abstract: The increasing global incidence of dengue highlights the urgent need for safe and broadly protective vaccines. Dengue virus (DENV) vaccination requires balanced immunity against four antigenically distinct serotypes while minimizing the risk of antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). Here, we developed a tetravalent mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) vaccine incorporating an N8R substitution in the DENV envelope (E) protein and formulated with a novel ionizable lipid, AS-CL-28. Optimization of serotype-specific mRNA-LNP composition identified a 4:1:4:4 formulation (DENV1:DENV2:DENV3:DENV4) that reduced DENV2 immunodominance and improved the balance of neutralizing antibody responses across all four serotypes. Incorporation of the N8R substitution provided additional protective benefits against multiple DENV serotypes in passive protection models. Together, these findings provide a framework for developing next-generation tetravalent DENV mRNA vaccines that improve immune balance and protective efficacy while supporting future flavivirus vaccine design.

Dengue virus (DENV) vaccination requires balanced immunity against four antigenically distinct serotypes while minimizing the risk of antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). Here, we developed a tetravalent mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) vaccine incorporating an N8R substitution in the DENV envelope (E) protein and formulated with a novel ionizable lipid, AS-CL-28. Optimization of serotype-specific mRNA-LNP composition identified a 4:1:4:4 formulation (DENV1:DENV2:DENV3:DENV4) that reduced DENV2 immunodominance and improved the balance of neutralizing antibody responses across all four serotypes. Incorporation of the N8R substitution provided additional protective benefits against multiple DENV serotypes in passive protection models. Together, these findings provide a framework for developing next-generation tetravalent DENV mRNA vaccines that improve immune balance and protective efficacy while supporting future flavivirus vaccine design.
papers.abstract_zh: 全球登革热 疫苗 的增加凸显了对安全且具有广泛保护性的 疫苗 的迫切需求。登革病毒 (DENV) 疫苗接种 需要针对四种抗原不同血清型的平衡免疫力,同时最大限度地降低 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE) 的风险。在这里,我们开发了一种四价 mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒 (mRNA-LNP) 疫苗,在 DENV 包膜 (E) 蛋白中加入 N8R 取代,并用新型可电离脂质 AS-CL-28 配制。血清型特异性 mRNA-LNP 组成的优化确定了 4:1:4:4 配方 (DENV1:DENV2:DENV3:DENV4),可降低 DENV2 免疫优势并改善所有四种血清型中和抗体反应的平衡。N8R 替代的结合为被动保护模型中的多种 DENV 血清型提供了额外的保护作用。总之,这些发现为开发下一代四价 DENV mRNA 疫苗 提供了一个框架,可改善免疫平衡和保护功效,同时支持未来的黄病毒 疫苗 设计。

papers.title: Stochastic Dengue Endemicity under Lévy Jump Fluctuations
papers.abstract: Dengue resurgence poses major public-health challenges. Because transmission is affected by environmental and random fluctuations, realistic models are needed. We propose a stochastic dengue model, with a susceptible infectious recovered structure for humans and a susceptible infectious structure for mosquitoes, incorporating white noise and Levy jumps. We establish the existence and uniqueness of a global positive solution, prove moment and almost sure exponential stability of the disease-free equilibrium, derive sufficient conditions for persistence in mean, and illustrate the results numerically. The analysis clarifies how random fluctuations affect dengue transmission and its long-term variability.

papers.title: Serotype-dependent fusion loop and pr antibody profiles in primary dengue virus infections
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue viruses (DENV1-4) are a leading cause of arboviral disease worldwide. The envelope (E) and premembrane (prM) proteins are major antibody targets; within E, the conserved fusion loop (FL) is an immunodominant cross-reactive epitope. Antibodies to pr and FL have been linked to antibody-dependent enhancement, yet their contribution to the cross-reactive response in polyclonal serum remains undefined. Here using recombinant antigens and a multiplexed serological assay with sera from the Nicaraguan Pediatric Dengue Cohort Study, we show that anti-pr responses are serotype-dependent in magnitude yet broadly cross-reactive among DENV1–4, with very limited ZIKV recognition. All primary DENV infections generated FL-reactive antibodies, but the E-FL fraction varied by infecting serotype and detection antigen, revealing asymmetric serotype-dependent shaping of cross-reactive responses. Interestingly, the greater the magnitude of cross-reactive E binding, the lower the proportion of FL-sensitive binding. These findings show that primary infection imprints serotype-specific patterns on cross-reactive antibody landscapes to dengue and Zika viruses that may influence subsequent infection outcomes.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用尼加拉瓜儿童登革热 队列研究 研究的血清,采用重组抗原的多重血清学测定来研究原发性 队列研究 感染中的抗体反应。
elements_zh.methods: 使用多重血清学测定,使用针对 登革病毒 1-4 的融合环 (FL) 和 prM 蛋白的重组抗原来测量抗体反应。
elements_zh.main_results: 抗 pr 反应的强度取决于血清型,但在 DENV1-4 之间广泛存在交叉反应,对寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 的识别非常有限。原发性 DENV 感染产生 FL 反应性抗体,但 E-FL 部分因感染血清型和检测抗原而异,揭示了交叉反应反应的不对称血清型依赖性形状。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,初次感染会在登革热和寨卡病毒的交叉反应抗体格局上留下血清型特异性模式,这可能会影响随后的感染结果。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对于理解交叉反应抗体在 登革病毒 感染中的作用具有重要意义,并可能为未来 疫苗 开发和血清学诊断的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到单一 队列研究 的使用以及对原发感染的关注的限制,这可能无法完全代表更广泛的人群。由于该研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Impacto epidemiológico del dengue y del chikungunya en zonas urbanas: revisión sistemática
papers.abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios. Resultados: la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013 y produjo brotes urbanos explosivos, con manifestaciones articulares persistentes. La urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus y la resistencia a insecticidas favorecieron la transmisión. Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado. Conclusión: ambas arbovirosis son una carga creciente para las ciudades tropicales y subtropicales y exigen vigilancia y control sostenidos.

analysis.research_question_and_background: El estudio buscaba sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya, con el objetivo de abordar la creciente carga de enfermedad en zonas urbanas tropicales y subtropicales.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Se realizó una revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en bases de datos como PubMed y SciELO, considerando estudios publicados entre 2012 y 2025; se incluyeron 15 estudios que abordaron el impacto de estos virus en diferentes regiones.
analysis.methods: La revisión sistemática se llevó a cabo en PubMed y SciELO, seleccionando estudios publicados entre 2012 y 2025. Se incluyeron 15 estudios que analizaron el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya.
analysis.main_results: Los resultados mostraron que la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y una alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013, causando brotes urbanos explosivos y manifestaciones articulares persistentes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Los autores interpretaron que la urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus, así como la resistencia a insecticidas, han favorecido la transmisión de ambos virus. Esta revisión destacó la necesidad de nuevas vacunas y estrategias de control vectorial integrado.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Los hallazgos pueden informar estrategias de vigilancia y control sostenido en ciudades tropicales y subtropicales, donde el dengue y el chikungunya representan una carga epidemiológica significativa.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: La evidencia se basa en una revisión sistemática abstracto, lo que limita la profundidad de los análisis. Sin embargo, el estudio proporciona una síntesis generalizada de la literatura disponible, lo que justifica una confianza moderada en los hallazgos.

analysis.summary_en: Este estudio realiza una revisión sistemática para sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. Se analizaron 15 estudios publicados entre 2012 y 2025, encontrando que la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con una alta carga en América Latina. Por otro lado, el chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013, causando brotes explosivos y manifestaciones articulares persistentes. Los autores destacaron que factores como la urbanización, la presencia de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus, así como la resistencia a insecticidas, han favorecido la transmisión de ambos virus. Las implicaciones científicas y de salud pública incluyen la necesidad de nuevas vacunas y estrategias de control vectorial integrado. Aunque la evidencia se basa en una revisión abstracta, los hallazgos ofrecen una visión generalizada de la literatura disponible, lo que justifica una confianza moderada en los resultados.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在证明登革热和基孔肯雅热对城市流行病学的影响,并以热带和亚热带城市地区的流行病学为对象。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 以 PubMed 和 SciELO 数据为基础,对 2012 年至 2025 年公共研究进行了系统的修订;其中包括 15 个针对不同地区的病毒影响的研究。
elements_zh.methods: La revisión sistemática se llevó a cabo en PubMed y SciELO,seleccionando estudios entre entre 2012 y 2025. Se 包括 15 个对登革热和基孔肯雅热流行病影响进行分析的研究。
elements_zh.main_results: 1990 年世界登革热疫情的结果是,地区市场和拉丁美洲的其他地区存在差异。基孔肯雅热在 2013 年美洲地区扩展,导致城市爆炸和关节持续表现。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释了城市化、埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊的扩张,以抵抗杀虫剂,并有利于传播安博斯病毒。我们对新的真空需求和矢量集成控制策略进行了修订。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 热带和亚热带城市的警戒和控制、登革热和基孔肯雅热的信息通报对流行病学意义重大。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据是对抽象系统的修订,限制了分析的深刻性。禁运,该研究的目的是对文学的综合性进行研究,以确保其公正性和公正性。

papers.abstract: This study examines the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in forecasting dengue and influenza and its contribution to laboratory supply management. A literature review was conducted, with a mixed-methods approach and descriptive design, based on scientific articles, official documents and public databases. It is concluded that AI has potential to support laboratory management, provided that its forecasts are validated.

papers.title: Multi-sectoral intervention against Aedes aegypti in Dengue outbreak management in Pontianak, West Kalimantan, Indonesia
papers.abstract: Dengue fever is a viral infection that is transmitted through the Aedes aegypti mosquito and is prevalent in tropical and subtropical areas. Pontianak, as the provincial capital of West Kalimantan, Indonesia, is an endemic place for dengue fever. Dengue fever has become a significant burden on public health, especially in a developing country like Indonesia. Besides being influenced by population growth and increasing mobility, dengue fever is now notably worsened by climate change and environmental degradation. Generally, dengue fever management mainly focuses on eliminating the vector: Aedes aegypti mosquito, to end the virus transmission. However, multi-sectoral intervention is also crucial to complement the health intervention in the community, making synergies among stakeholders in addressing Dengue fever. Hence, the responsibility to stop the Dengue outbreak is not only the role of the health sector, but also for the corporations, policymakers, research and educational institutions, and the government.

papers.source_body_en: Dengue fever is a viral infection that is transmitted through the Aedes aegypti mosquito and is prevalent in tropical and subtropical areas. Pontianak, as the provincial capital of West Kalimantan, Indonesia, is an endemic place for dengue fever. Dengue fever has become a significant burden on public health, especially in a developing country like Indonesia. Besides being influenced by population growth and increasing mobility, dengue fever is now notably worsened by climate change and environmental degradation. Generally, dengue fever management mainly focuses on eliminating the vector: Aedes aegypti mosquito, to end the virus transmission. However, multi-sectoral intervention is also crucial to complement the health intervention in the community, making synergies among stakeholders in addressing Dengue fever. Hence, the responsibility to stop the Dengue outbreak is not only the role of the health sector, but also for the corporations, policymakers, research and educational institutions, and the government.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热 是一种通过埃及伊蚊传播的病毒感染,在热带和亚热带地区流行。坤甸作为印度尼西亚西加里曼丹省的省会,是登革热的流行地。登革热 已成为公共卫生的重大负担,特别是在印度尼西亚这样的发展中国家。除了受到人口增长和流动性增加的影响外,登革热 现在还受到气候变化和环境退化的影响。一般来说,登革热管理主要集中在消灭媒介:埃及伊蚊,以消灭病毒传播。然而,多部门干预对于补充社区健康干预也至关重要,使利益相关者在解决 登革热 问题上发挥协同作用。因此,阻止登革热 暴发 不仅是卫生部门的责任,也是企业、政策制定者、研究和教育机构以及政府的责任。
