papers.title: DEXTRAN ADMINISTRATION AND ACUTE KIDNEY INJURY IN PEDIATRIC DENGUE SHOCK SYNDROME: A MULTICENTER PROPENSITY SCORE-MATCHED COHORT STUDY
papers.abstract: Background: Acute kidney injury (AKI) complicates up to 10% of dengue virus infections, with the risk increasing with disease severity. Dextran-40, recommended as first-line colloid therapy for dengue shock syndrome (DSS) in Thailand's national guidelines, has theoretical nephrotoxic potential; however, evidence regarding its association with AKI in children with DSS remains limited. Methods: This multicenter observational cohort study included children under 15 years diagnosed with DSS and admitted to six hospitals in Thailand between January 2012 and December 2024. Patients with refractory shock requiring inotropes within the first hour, bleeding complications, or AKI prior to fluid resuscitation were excluded. AKI was defined according to the KDIGO criteria. Propensity score matching was performed to balance baseline covariates between dextran-40 recipients and comparators. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors associated with AKI. Results: Of 650 patients assessed, 604 were included in the cohort, and 592 were included in the final propensity score–matched cohort, with post matching absolute standardized mean differences 60 minutes after initiation of fluid resuscitation was independently associated with increased odds of AKI in both the primary and severity-adjusted models, a finding that persisted in the subgroup of patients receiving dextran-40 specifically for shock. A higher cumulative dextran-40 dose was associated with increased odds of AKI in the primary model, but this association was attenuated after adjustment for disease severity. Conclusion: Dextran-40 administration was not independently associated with AKI; instead, delayed administration (>60 minutes after fluid resuscitation initiation) and disease severity, particularly refractory shock and DHF grade IV, were the key potentially modifiable and non-modifiable predictors of AKI risk, respectively. These findings support continued use of dextran-40 as colloid therapy in pediatric DSS while emphasizing the importance of timely administration to minimize AKI risk.

Dengue virus infections, particularly severe dengue, pose a significant public health problem due to their potential to cause AKI, necessitating further investigation into risk factors.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This multicenter observational cohort study included children under 15 years diagnosed with dengue shock syndrome (DSS) and admitted to six hospitals in Thailand between January 2012 and December 2024. Patients with refractory shock requiring inotropes within the first hour, bleeding complications, or AKI prior to fluid resuscitation were excluded.
analysis.methods: AKI was defined according to the KDIGO criteria. Propensity score matching was performed to balance baseline covariates between dextran-40 recipients and comparators. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were conducted to identify factors associated with AKI.
analysis.main_results: Of 650 patients assessed, 604 were included in the cohort, and 592 were included in the final propensity score–matched cohort. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that delayed administration of dextran-40 and disease severity, rather than the administration itself, are key predictors of AKI risk. This finding highlights the importance of timely intervention in managing dengue shock syndrome.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform clinical practice by supporting the continued use of dextran-40 as colloid therapy in pediatric dengue shock syndrome while emphasizing the need for timely administration to reduce AKI risk.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is observational and relies on propensity score matching, which may not fully eliminate confounding. The evidence is moderate due to the limitations in controlling for all potential confounding factors.

analysis.summary_en: This multicenter observational cohort study investigated the association between dextran-40 administration and acute kidney injury (AKI) in children with dengue shock syndrome (DSS). The study found that delayed administration of dextran-40 (>60 minutes after fluid resuscitation initiation) and disease severity, particularly refractory shock and DHF grade IV, were independently associated with increased AKI risk. These findings support the continued use of dextran-40 as colloid therapy in pediatric DSS while highlighting the importance of timely administration to minimize AKI risk. The study's observational design and use of propensity score matching limit the strength of the evidence, which is considered moderate. The results contribute to understanding the risk factors for AKI in severe dengue cases and may inform clinical guidelines for managing DSS in children.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Acute kidney injury (AKI) complicates up to 10% of dengue virus infections, with the risk increasing with disease severity. Dengue virus infections, particularly severe dengue, pose a significant public health problem due to their potential to cause AKI, necessitating further investigation into risk factors.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This multicenter observational cohort study included children under 15 years diagnosed with dengue shock syndrome (DSS) and admitted to six hospitals in Thailand between January 2012 and December 2024. Patients with refractory shock requiring inotropes within the first hour, bleeding complications, or AKI prior to fluid resuscitation were excluded.
analysis_en.methods: AKI was defined according to the KDIGO criteria. Propensity score matching was performed to balance baseline covariates between dextran-40 recipients and comparators. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were conducted to identify factors associated with AKI.
analysis_en.main_results: Of 650 patients assessed, 604 were included in the cohort, and 592 were included in the final propensity score–matched cohort. Delayed administration (>60 minutes after fluid resuscitation initiation) and disease severity, particularly refractory shock and DHF grade IV, were independently associated with increased odds of AKI.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that delayed administration of dextran-40 and disease severity, rather than the administration itself, are key predictors of AKI risk. This finding highlights the importance of timely intervention in managing dengue shock syndrome.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform clinical practice by supporting the continued use of dextran-40 as colloid therapy in pediatric dengue shock syndrome while emphasizing the need for timely administration to reduce AKI risk.

papers.title_zh: 右旋糖酐给药与小儿登革热休克综合征中的急性肾损伤:多中心倾向评分匹配的 队列研究 研究
papers.source_body_en: Background: Acute kidney injury (AKI) complicates up to 10% of dengue virus infections, with the risk increasing with disease severity. Dextran-40, recommended as first-line colloid therapy for dengue shock syndrome (DSS) in Thailand's national guidelines, has theoretical nephrotoxic potential; however, evidence regarding its association with AKI in children with DSS remains limited. Methods: This multicenter observational cohort study included children under 15 years diagnosed with DSS and admitted to six hospitals in Thailand between January 2012 and December 2024. Patients with refractory shock requiring inotropes within the first hour, bleeding complications, or AKI prior to fluid resuscitation were excluded. AKI was defined according to the KDIGO criteria. Propensity score matching was performed to balance baseline covariates between dextran-40 recipients and comparators. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors associated with AKI. Results: Of 650 patients assessed, 604 were included in the cohort, and 592 were included in the final propensity score–matched cohort, with post matching absolute standardized mean differences 60 minutes after initiation of fluid resuscitation was independently associated with increased odds of AKI in both the primary and severity-adjusted models, a finding that persisted in the subgroup of patients receiving dextran-40 specifically for shock. A higher cumulative dextran-40 dose was associated with increased odds of AKI in the primary model, but this association was attenuated after adjustment for disease severity. Conclusion: Dextran-40 administration was not independently associated with AKI; instead, delayed administration (>60 minutes after fluid resuscitation initiation) and disease severity, particularly refractory shock and DHF grade IV, were the key potentially modifiable and non-modifiable predictors of AKI risk, respectively. These findings support continued use of dextran-40 as colloid therapy in pediatric DSS while emphasizing the importance of timely administration to minimize AKI risk.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:急性肾损伤 (AKI) 使高达 10% 的 登革病毒 感染变得复杂,且风险随着疾病严重程度的增加而增加。泰国国家指南推荐Dextran-40作为登革热休克综合征(DSS)的一线胶体疗法,理论上具有肾毒性潜力;然而,关于其与 DSS 儿童 AKI 相关的证据仍然有限。方法:这项多中心观察性 队列研究 研究纳入了 2012 年 1 月至 2024 年 12 月期间在泰国六家医院收治的 15 岁以下诊断为 DSS 的儿童。排除了在第一小时内需要正性肌力药物的难治性休克、出血并发症或液体复苏前 AKI 的患者。AKI 根据 KDIGO 标准定义。进行倾向评分匹配以平衡 dextran-40 接受者和比较者之间的基线协变量。进行单变量和多变量逻辑回归分析以确定与 AKI 相关的因素。结果:在接受评估的 650 名患者中,604 名患者被纳入 队列研究,592 名患者被纳入最终倾向评分匹配的 队列研究,开始液体复苏后 60 分钟的匹配后绝对标准化平均差与主要模型和严重程度调整模型中 AKI 几率的增加独立相关,这一发现在专门接受 dextran-40 治疗休克的患者亚组中持续存在。在主要模型中,较高的累积 dextran-40 剂量与 AKI 的几率增加相关,但在调整疾病严重程度后,这种相关性减弱。结论:Dextran-40 给药与 AKI 并不独立相关;相反,延迟给药(液体复苏开始后 >60 分钟)和疾病严重程度,特别是难治性休克和 DHF IV 级,分别是 AKI 风险的关键潜在可改变和不可改变的预测因素。这些发现支持在儿科 DSS 中继续使用 dextran-40 作为胶体疗法,同时强调及时给药以尽量减少 AKI 风险的重要性。

papers.title: Estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas: revisión sistemática Dengue prevention strategies in urban communities: a systematic review
papers.abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la efectividad de las estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas y su aplicabilidad al contexto ecuatoriano. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas con y sin metaanálisis, estudios en Ecuador, intervenciones comunitarias y una evaluación económica. Resultados: el control químico aislado redujo los índices entomológicos sin efecto demostrado sobre la transmisión. El manejo ambiental con participación comunitaria, las mallas en las viviendas y las cubiertas de recipientes mostraron los resultados más favorables. El almacenamiento de agua, la percepción del riesgo y la falta de servicios básicos condicionaron la prevención en Ecuador. Conclusión: la prevención del dengue urbano requiere estrategias integradas, comunitarias y sostenidas, con vigilancia epidemiológica y mejoras de los servicios básicos.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review aims to synthesize evidence on the effectiveness of dengue prevention strategies in urban communities and assess their applicability to the Ecuadorian context.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review was conducted using PubMed and SciELO databases from 2012 to 2025. The evidence includes 15 studies: systematic reviews with and without meta-analyses, studies conducted in Ecuador, community interventions, and an economic evaluation.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review found that integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, including environmental management, window screens, and covered water containers, showed the most favorable results in dengue prevention. However, chemical control alone reduced entomological indices without demonstrated impact on transmission.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that factors such as water storage practices, risk perception, and lack of basic services influenced prevention effectiveness in Ecuador. There is no explicit mention of conflicting findings or heterogeneity in the results.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review concludes that dengue prevention in urban areas requires integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, along with epidemiological surveillance and improvements in basic services.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates dengue prevention strategies in urban communities, focusing on their effectiveness and applicability in Ecuador. The evidence base includes 15 studies from PubMed and SciELO, spanning 2012 to 2025, encompassing systematic reviews, community interventions, and economic evaluations. Key findings indicate that integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, such as environmental management, window screens, and covered water containers, yielded the most favorable outcomes. However, chemical control alone reduced entomological indices without clear evidence of impact on transmission. The review emphasizes the need for strategies that incorporate epidemiological surveillance and improvements in basic services to effectively prevent dengue in urban settings. The study also notes that factors like water storage practices, risk perception, and lack of basic services influenced prevention success in Ecuador. The implications suggest a focus on community engagement and long-term, sustainable interventions to address dengue in urban populations.

papers.source_body_en: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la efectividad de las estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas y su aplicabilidad al contexto ecuatoriano. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas con y sin metaanálisis, estudios en Ecuador, intervenciones comunitarias y una evaluación económica. Resultados: el control químico aislado redujo los índices entomológicos sin efecto demostrado sobre la transmisión. El manejo ambiental con participación comunitaria, las mallas en las viviendas y las cubiertas de recipientes mostraron los resultados más favorables. El almacenamiento de agua, la percepción del riesgo y la falta de servicios básicos condicionaron la prevención en Ecuador. Conclusión: la prevención del dengue urbano requiere estrategias integradas, comunitarias y sostenidas, con vigilancia epidemiológica y mejoras de los servicios básicos.

papers.title: Mitochondrial Remodeling and Metabolic Reprogramming in the Dengue-Infected Liver: A Proposed Link Between Viral Tropism and Hepatic Steatosis
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) infection is frequently associated with biochemical evidence of liver injury, and hepatic steatosis has been reported in severe and fatal cases. However, direct evidence connecting hepatocyte infection to steatosis remains fragmented across cell lines, animal models, and autopsy studies. This review evaluates mitochondrial remodeling as a candidate link between hepatic infection and altered lipid handling. DENV proteins perturb mitochondrial dynamics, respiration, redox balance, and innate immune signaling, and impaired mitochondrial quality control has also been observed in infected cells. Changes in glucose and lipid metabolism have been reported across these models. Some hepatoma studies report increased fatty acid oxidation during productive infection, whereas other experimental conditions are associated with impaired mitochondrial function. A temporal transition between these responses has not been established. Inflammatory signaling from hepatic immune cells may further impair insulin signaling and promote liver injury, although a direct causal pathway to steatosis remains unproven. This review focuses on hepatic outcomes and distinguishes observations made in human liver tissue, in DENV-exposed hepatic models, in other DENV-infected cell types, and in non-dengue liver disease. For each proposed step we identify the endpoint that was measured and whether the evidence is descriptive, associative, or mechanistically tested.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染经常与肝损伤的生化证据相关,并且在严重和致命的病例中已有肝脂肪变性的报道。然而,在细胞系、动物模型和尸检研究中,将肝细胞感染与脂肪变性联系起来的直接证据仍然支离破碎。这篇综述评估了线粒体重塑作为肝脏感染和脂质处理改变之间的候选联系。DENV 蛋白扰乱线粒体动力学、呼吸、氧化还原平衡和先天免疫信号,并且在受感染的细胞中还观察到线粒体质量控制受损。这些模型中已经报道了葡萄糖和脂质代谢的变化。一些肝癌研究报告说,在生产性感染期间脂肪酸氧化增加,而其他实验条件则与线粒体功能受损有关。这些反应之间的时间过渡尚未确定。尽管脂肪变性的直接因果途径尚未得到证实,但肝脏免疫细胞的炎症信号传导可能会进一步损害胰岛素信号传导并促进肝损伤。本综述重点关注肝脏结果,并区分在人类肝脏组织、暴露于 DENV 的肝脏模型、其他感染 DENV 的细胞类型和非登革热肝病中进行的观察。对于每个提议的步骤,我们都会确定测量的终点以及证据是否是描述性的、关联性的或机械性测试的。

papers.title: CARTÃO DE ACOMPANHAMENTO DA DENGUE: PRÁTICAS INOVADORAS DE AÇÕES EM SAÚDE
papers.abstract: A Dengue, doença endêmica nos países que apresentam clima tropical e subtropical, especialmente nas áreas urbanas e suburbanas, é transmitida pela picada da fêmea do mosquito Aedes Aegypti. No Brasil, o vírus dessa patologia febril apresenta quatro sorotipos e no último ano foram notificados quase 1,5 milhão de casos no país. Com isso, o “Projeto Zelar” objetiva o desenvolvimento de medidas que possam garantir um melhor manejo dos pacientes infectados. O presente trabalho foi desenvolvido a partir de dados coletados na Atenção Primária e no Setor de Epidemiologia da cidade de Passos / MG, município em que o projeto foi aplicado, de modo que foi possível elencar os principais pontos deficitários a serem atenuados para que os pacientes possam ser adequadamente tratados. Para que fosse possível atingir este objetivo, foi realizado um evento que contou com diversos ouvintes da área da saúde e nele foram ofertadas palestras sobre a importância da notificação compulsória de um diagnóstico de Dengue, quais os sinais de alerta da doença e como deve ser feita a triagem e o manejo dos pacientes. Além disso, também foi desenvolvido o “Cartão de Manejo e Acompanhamento do Paciente com Suspeita de Dengue”, por meio do qual foram fornecidas orientações gerais aos pacientes como também uma área aonde é possível registros clínicos e laboratoriais do paciente para seu acompanhamento. Com tal projeto, foi possível concluir que os profissionais da saúde devem estar sempre em processo de aperfeiçoamento, para que dessa maneira os pacientes recebam as medidas necessárias de tratamento, evitando agravos.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenges of managing dengue cases in urban and suburban areas where the disease is endemic, particularly focusing on improving diagnostic and treatment practices.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in Passos / MG, Brazil, using data collected from Primary Health Care and the Epidemiology Sector, where the "Projeto Zelar" was implemented. It involved identifying key deficits in patient management to enhance treatment protocols.
analysis.methods: The study included a health event with multiple healthcare professionals, featuring lectures on the importance of mandatory dengue diagnosis notification, warning signs, and proper patient triage and management procedures. A "Cartão de Manejo e Acompanhamento" was also developed to guide patients and record clinical and laboratory data.
analysis.main_results: The project enabled the identification of critical areas needing improvement in the management of dengue patients, highlighting the necessity for better diagnostic practices and patient triage.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as evidence that healthcare professionals must continuously improve their practices to ensure effective patient management and prevent complications, which is a novel approach to enhancing dengue care in the region.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies for improving dengue surveillance and management, particularly in primary healthcare settings, by emphasizing the importance of standardized diagnostic and treatment protocols.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract data and does not provide detailed statistical or methodological analysis, limiting the strength of the evidence to moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study focuses on the management of dengue cases in Brazil, particularly in Passos / MG, where the "Projeto Zelar" was implemented. It highlights the need for improved diagnostic practices and patient triage to ensure effective treatment. The research emphasizes the importance of continuous professional development in healthcare to address deficits in dengue care. The study's findings suggest that better management protocols can prevent complications and improve patient outcomes. However, the evidence is based on abstract data and lacks detailed statistical analysis, which limits its strength to moderate. The results can inform public health strategies for enhancing dengue surveillance and management in primary healthcare settings.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在巴西帕索斯/MG 进行,使用了从初级卫生保健和实施“Projeto Zelar”的 流行病学 部门收集的数据。它涉及确定患者管理中的关键缺陷,以增强 治疗 协议。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenges of managing dengue cases in urban and suburban areas where the disease is endemic, particularly focusing on improving diagnostic and treatment practices.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in Passos / MG, Brazil, using data collected from Primary Health Care and the Epidemiology Sector, where the "Projeto Zelar" was implemented. It involved identifying key deficits in patient management to enhance treatment protocols.
analysis_en.methods: The study included a health event with multiple healthcare professionals, featuring lectures on the importance of mandatory dengue diagnosis notification, warning signs, and proper patient triage and management procedures. A "Cartão de Manejo e Acompanhamento" was also developed to guide patients and record clinical and laboratory data.
analysis_en.main_results: The project enabled the identification of critical areas needing improvement in the management of dengue patients, highlighting the necessity for better diagnostic practices and patient triage.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as evidence that healthcare professionals must continuously improve their practices to ensure effective patient management and prevent complications, which is a novel approach to enhancing dengue care in the region.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies for improving dengue surveillance and management, particularly in primary healthcare settings, by emphasizing the importance of standardized diagnostic and treatment protocols.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract data and does not provide detailed statistical or methodological analysis, limiting the strength of the evidence to moderate.

papers.title_zh: 登革热伴奏卡:PRÁTICAS INOVADORAS DE AÇÕES EM SAÚDE
papers.source_body_en: A Dengue, doença endêmica nos países que apresentam clima tropical e subtropical, especialmente nas áreas urbanas e suburbanas, é transmitida pela picada da fêmea do mosquito Aedes Aegypti. No Brasil, o vírus dessa patologia febril apresenta quatro sorotipos e no último ano foram notificados quase 1,5 milhão de casos no país. Com isso, o “Projeto Zelar” objetiva o desenvolvimento de medidas que possam garantir um melhor manejo dos pacientes infectados. O presente trabalho foi desenvolvido a partir de dados coletados na Atenção Primária e no Setor de Epidemiologia da cidade de Passos / MG, município em que o projeto foi aplicado, de modo que foi possível elencar os principais pontos deficitários a serem atenuados para que os pacientes possam ser adequadamente tratados. Para que fosse possível atingir este objetivo, foi realizado um evento que contou com diversos ouvintes da área da saúde e nele foram ofertadas palestras sobre a importância da notificação compulsória de um diagnóstico de Dengue, quais os sinais de alerta da doença e como deve ser feita a triagem e o manejo dos pacientes. Além disso, também foi desenvolvido o “Cartão de Manejo e Acompanhamento do Paciente com Suspeita de Dengue”, por meio do qual foram fornecidas orientações gerais aos pacientes como também uma área aonde é possível registros clínicos e laboratoriais do paciente para seu acompanhamento. Com tal projeto, foi possível concluir que os profissionais da saúde devem estar sempre em processo de aperfeiçoamento, para que dessa maneira os pacientes recebam as medidas necessárias de tratamento, evitando agravos.

papers.full_text: Abstract A high-performance two-dimensional (2D) photonic crystal slotted cavity biosensor is numerically designed and investigated for label-free detection of dengue-associated physiological alterations through refractive-index monitoring of separated blood constituents. The biosensor employs a silicon slab with a triangular lattice of air holes and a nanoscale slot cavity, enabling strong optical confinement and enhanced light–matter interaction. Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) simulations demonstrate an ultra-high-quality factor of approximately 20,000, a sensitivity of 1800 nm/RIU, a narrow resonance linewidth (FWHM ≈ 0.096–0.099 nm), and a figure of merit exceeding 18,000 RIU−1. The sensing performance is evaluated for characteristic refractive-index variations associated with separated hemoglobin, platelets, and plasma during dengue infection, yielding pronounced resonance wavelength shifts of + 63.00 nm, − 59.40 nm, and − 23.40 nm, respectively. The physical mechanism governing linear sensitivity is elucidated via first-order electromagnetic perturbation theory, confirming an exceptional linear response (R2 = 0.9996) across the refractive index range n = 1.330–1.400. In addition, blood fractionation procedures, optical dispersion near 2.0 μm, fabrication tolerances, temperature sensitivity, and integration into multi-channel optofluidic architectures are comprehensively analyzed. The proposed slotted photonic crystal platform provides a robust computational foundation for label-free optical monitoring of hematological variations associated with dengue pathology. papers.title_original: Numerical Simulation of a High-Performance 2D Photonic Crystal Slotted Cavity Biosensor for Refractive-Index-Based Detection of Dengue-Associated Blood Alterations

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a high-performance biosensor for label-free detection of dengue-associated physiological alterations through refractive-index monitoring of separated blood constituents.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A numerical simulation study was conducted to evaluate the sensing performance of a 2D photonic crystal slotted cavity biosensor for characteristic refractive-index variations associated with separated hemoglobin, platelets, and plasma during dengue infection.
analysis.methods: Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) simulations were used to analyze the biosensor's performance, including its sensitivity, quality factor, and resonance linewidth, while first-order electromagnetic perturbation theory was employed to elucidate the physical mechanism governing linear sensitivity.
analysis.main_results: The biosensor demonstrated a sensitivity of 1800 nm/RIU, a narrow resonance linewidth (FWHM ≈ 0.096–0.099 nm), and a figure of merit exceeding 18,000 RIU−1. Pronounced resonance wavelength shifts of +63.00 nm, −59.40 nm, and −23.40 nm were observed for hemoglobin, platelets, and plasma, respectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study provides a robust computational foundation for label-free optical monitoring of hematological variations associated with dengue pathology, highlighting the biosensor's exceptional sensitivity and linear response.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer a potential tool for non-invasive, real-time monitoring of dengue-associated blood alterations, which could enhance diagnostic accuracy and support early intervention strategies in dengue management.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to numerical simulations and does not include experimental validation, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate due to the reliance on computational models rather than empirical data.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a numerical simulation of a high-performance 2D photonic crystal slotted cavity biosensor designed for label-free detection of dengue-associated physiological changes through refractive-index monitoring of separated blood components. The biosensor's design incorporates a silicon slab with a triangular lattice of air holes and a nanoscale slot cavity, enabling strong optical confinement and enhanced light-matter interaction. FDTD simulations revealed a sensitivity of 1800 nm/RIU, a narrow resonance linewidth (FWHM ≈ 0.096–0.099 nm), and a figure of merit exceeding 18,000 RIU−1. Pronounced resonance wavelength shifts were observed for hemoglobin, platelets, and plasma during dengue infection, indicating the biosensor's potential for detecting hematological variations. The study's interpretation emphasizes its computational foundation for monitoring dengue-related blood alterations, which could improve diagnostic capabilities. However, the reliance on simulations without experimental validation limits the evidence strength to moderate, as the results may not fully generalize to real-world applications.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在开发一种高性能生物传感器,通过对分离的血液成分进行折射率监测,无标记地检测登革热相关的生理变化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 进行了数值模拟研究,以评估 2D 光子晶体槽腔生物传感器的传感性能,以检测登革热感染期间与分离的血红蛋白、血小板和血浆相关的特征折射率变化。
elements_zh.methods: 采用时域有限差分(FDTD)模拟来分析生物传感器的性能,包括其灵敏度、品质因数和共振线宽,同时采用一阶电磁摄动理论来阐明控制线性灵敏度的物理机制。
elements_zh.main_results: 该生物传感器表现出 1800 nm/RIU 的灵敏度、窄共振线宽(FWHM ≈ 0.096–0.099 nm)以及超过 18,000 RIU−1 的品质因数。血红蛋白、血小板和血浆分别观察到明显的共振波长偏移+63.00 nm、-59.40 nm 和-23.40 nm。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究为与登革热病理学相关的血液学变化的无标记光学监测提供了强大的计算基础,突出了生物传感器卓越的灵敏度和线性响应。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为非侵入性、实时监测与登革热相关的血液变化提供了潜在的工具,这可以提高诊断准确性并支持登革热管理的早期干预策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于数值模拟,不包括实验验证,这可能会影响结果的普遍性。由于依赖计算模型而不是经验数据,证据并不充分。

papers.abstract_zh: Similar content being viewed by others 数据可用性 在当前研究中未生成或分析任何数据集。https://doi.org/10.1515/ntrev-2025-0284 - 张燕宁、赵宇、吕瑞强(2015)光子晶体传感器综述。摘要 通过监测分离血液成分的折射率,设计并研究了一种高性能的二维(2D)光子晶体槽腔生物传感器,用于无标记检测登革热相关的生理变化。该生物传感器采用硅板和三角形空气孔阵列,结合纳米级槽腔,实现了强光学约束和增强的光-物质相互作用。有限差分时域(FDTD)模拟显示,该传感器具有约20,000的超高品质因子、1800 nm/RIU的灵敏度、窄的共振线宽(FWHM ≈ 0.096–0.099 nm)以及超过18,000 RIU−1的图示因子。通过分析登革热感染期间分离血红蛋白、血小板和血浆的特征折射率变化,评估了其传感性能,分别获得了显著的共振波长偏移+63.00 nm、−59.40 nm和−23.40 nm。通过一阶电磁扰动理论阐明了线性灵敏度的物理机制,证实了在折射率范围n = 1.330–1.400内具有卓越的线性响应(R2 = 0.9996)。此外,还全面分析了血液分馏程序、近2.0 μm的光学色散、制造公差、温度敏感性和多通道光流体架构的集成。所提出的槽状光子晶体平台为无标记光学监测血细胞变化提供了坚实的计算基础。

papers.full_text: 0% READ FULL TEXT INTRODUCTION Dengue is among the most common arthropod-borne viral diseases of humans. Approximately 390 million infections occur each year, of which about one-quarter result in clinical manifestations (Bhatt et al., 2013), and roughly half of the world's population now lives in at-risk areas. This risk is amplified by rapid urbanization, global travel and the expansion of Aedes mosquitoes driven by climate change (eClinicalMedicine, 2024; Lim et al., 2025; Yousuf et al., 2024). No effective antiviral therapy is currently available, and existing vaccines show limited efficacy and serotype-dependent safety concerns. Such limitations underscore the importance of validated viral targets that can support both broad protection and serotype-specific intervention (Goh et al., 2024; Lim et al., 2015). The Dengue Viruses (DENV-1-4) are positive-sense RNA Flaviviruses with a genome of ~10.7 kb encoding a single polyprotein that is processed into three structural (C, prM/M, E) and Seven Non-Structural (NS1-NS5) proteins (El Sahili and Lescar, 2017; Murugesan and Manoharan, 2020). Of these, NS5 is the largest and most conserved, and it harbours two enzymatic activities essential for viral replication: an N-terminal methyltransferase domain that also confers guanylyltransferase activity, and a C-terminal RNA-dependent RNA Polymerase (RdRp) domain responsible for de novo RNA synthesis (Ackermann and Padmanabhan, 2001; El Sahili and Lescar, 2017; Goh et al., 2024). NS5 contributes to genome replication, RNA capping and antagonism of innate immune responses, as well as to remodelling of host-cell architecture, underscoring its central role in the DENV life cycle (El Sahili and Lescar, 2017; Lim et al., 2015). Because it is both essential and druggable, the DENV NS5 MTase has been the focus of sustained sequence-based, structural and inhibitor-discovery efforts by our group and others (Alwabli and Qadri, 2021; Alwabli et al., 2019b, 2019d). The NS5 MTase domain is located at the N-terminus and comprises approximately 262-265 amino acids across the Flaviviruses; in DENV-1-4 it spans 262-263 residues (Zhou et al., 2007). It adopts a Rossmann-like fold that binds S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine (SAM) and GTP, and it acts sequentially as a methyltransferase for N7- and 2′-O-methylation of the 5′ cap of viral RNA (Egloff et al., 2002; Zhou et al., 2007). These reactions generate a type-1 cap structure (m7GpppA-mRNA) that protects against exonucleases, supports efficient translation and aids evasion of pattern-recognition receptors such as the IFIT proteins (Furuichi and Shatkin, 2000; Ramanathan et al., 2016). Biochemical and mutagenesis studies have defined conserved catalytic motifs, comprising a catalytic tetrad (Lys-Asp-Lys-Glu) and a SAM-binding “DxH” motif, together with residues that are critical for MTase activity and viral fitness and that also interact with RNA (Kokkinidis et al., 2020; Ribeiro et al., 2020; Zhou et al., 2007). Crystal structures of the DENV MTase alone, of full-length DENV NS5 and of complexes with capped-RNA fragments are available, revealing the spatial organization of the tandem MTase-RdRp and the conformations relevant to RNA binding and catalysis (Egloff et al., 2002; Yap et al., 2010; Yap et al., 2007). Although the overall sequence identity across the NS5 domain is high, even single-residue changes in solvent-exposed regions or interdomain interfaces may be sufficient to affect protein-protein interactions and to modify antibody binding or local dynamics (Cheng et al., 2024; Hannemann et al., 2013). Such changes in surface electrostatic and/or hydrophobic properties, or in loop conformation, may alter cofactor affinity, catalytic efficiency or immune recognition without any loss of the catalytic motifs (Du et al., 2021; Utto-Ortiz et al., 2021). To explain these features, we carried out a comparative structural and biophysical study of the NS5 MTase domain across all four DENV serotypes, building on our recent serotype-resolved analyses of the DENV-1 (Bukhari, 2026b), DENV-2 (Bukhari, 2026a), DENV-3 (Alwabli, 2026b) and DENV-4 (Alwabli, 2026a) NS5 MTase domains. We first mapped the N-terminal MTase region (~262-263 residues) of the NS5 polyprotein and aligned the four DENV sequences to identify conserved and hypervariable regions (Obi et al., 2025). We then generated Fab-antigen interface models for each serotype, dividing residues into four classes: direct contact, surface, near-interface and double Fab interface (Ripoll et al., 2021). In our energy and charge heatmaps, all four serotypes were most stable at physiological pH (6.0-8.0) and low ionic strength (≤0.05 M), indicating that electrostatic balance - and hence enzymatic activity - is maintained. Notably, within this window DENV-4 NS5 displayed several advantageous energetic properties, demonstrating intrinsic stability and suitability for structure-guided optimization of ligands and antibodies. By integrating sequence conservation, Fab-interface mapping, surface electrostatics and hydrophobicity, developability metrics and stability landscapes, we provide a single structural-biophysical perspective on the NS5 MTase and identify DENV-4 NS5 as a key scaffold for the rational design of antiviral drugs and antibodies against dengue virus. MATERIALS AND METHODS Sequence Retrieval and DENV Serotype Genomes Full-length genome sequences for DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4 were retrieved from the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) database, using the reference strains established for DENV-1-4 nucleic-acid testing standards (Nunez et al., 2016). The complete viral polyprotein (~3390 aa) was translated from each genome, and the structural (C, M/prM, E) and non-structural (NS1-NS5) proteins were sequentially annotated according to the canonical Flavivirus genome map (Chambers et al., 1990; Lindenbach and Rice, 2003). For each serotype, NS5 was delimited at its C-terminus using the UniProt/RefSeq annotation, and its N-terminal Methyltransferase (MTase) domain was assigned on the basis of the experimentally solved DENV NS5 structures (Egloff et al., 2002; Yap et al., 2010; Yap et al., 2007) and of our serotype-specific analyses of each domain. Prediction of Fab-Antigen Interface Residues Each NS5 MTase model was analysed with protein-protein interface-prediction algorithms trained on antibody-antigen complexes (interface-propensity scoring tools such as InterProSurf (Negi et al., 2007) and SPPIDER (Porollo and Meller, 2007). Active residues within high-probability contact patches were identified on the basis of solvent exposure, shape complementarity and interface propensities (Kringelum et al., 2013; Negi et al., 2007; Porollo and Meller, 2007). Electrostatic and Hydrophobic Surfaces Three-dimensional models of the NS5 MTase domains of the four DENV serotypes were built by comparative (homology) modelling using the available crystal structures of the dengue NS5 MTase as templates (Alwabli, 2025; Alwabli et al., 2019c; Ullah et al., 2023). Predictive-Model Scatter Plots Three developability predictors, based on biophysical descriptors derived from the DENV-1-4 MTase models, were used to estimate the risk of self-association (affinity-capture self-interaction nanoparticle spectroscopy, AC-SINS), non-specific interactions (Poly-Specificity Reagent, PSR) and composite stability/liability (META). Predicted scores were plotted on transformed or experiment-like axes against the clinical-stage biophysical reference distribution (Jain et al., 2017). Because a different serotype is highlighted in each projection, the resulting plots are descriptive comparisons rather than a single ranking. Energy and Charge Heatmaps Electrostatic energy and net-charge calculations were performed for the DENV-1-4 NS5 MTase domains to evaluate their electrostatic stability. Calculations were carried out across a range of pH values (2.0-8.0) and ionic strengths (0.005-0.3 M) using the Adaptive Poisson-Boltzmann Solver (APBS) (Konecny et al., 2012). Protonation states were determined using continuum pKa calculations, which estimate the pH at which protein groups gain or lose protons. Average energy and charge values were displayed as heatmaps with colour gradients denoting favourable or unfavourable electrostatics. This approach enabled comparison of electrostatic patterns between serotypes and identification of conditions under which all serotypes are electrostatically stable. RESULTS Overview of DENV Structural Components and the NS5 MTase Domain Figure 1 shows the structure of the dengue virus and highlights the differences among its four serotypes. The basic architecture of all serotypes comprises an envelope, a lipid membrane, a nucleocapsid and an RNA genome, with virions rendered differently to reveal serotype-specific characteristics. The polyprotein map depicts the structural proteins (Capsid, M, Envelope) and non-structural proteins (NS1, NS2A/NS2B, NS3, NS4A/NS4B and NS5) in relation to the viral genome. The N-terminal region of NS5 is a methyltransferase whose sequence differs slightly among serotypes: 262 amino acids for DENV-1 and DENV-3, and 263 amino acids for DENV-2 and DENV-4 (Figure 1), consistent with the domain boundaries reported in our serotype-specific studies. The figure also emphasizes the conserved position of NS5 and the alignment of the MTase sequences, with only small serotype-dependent differences. Predicted Fab-Antigen Interface Profiles Predicted Fab categories for DENV-1 to DENV-4 on NS5 are shown in Figure 2. All serotypes share a red contact region at the same location (interface score 1.78, arbitrary units), followed by blue surface residues (2.87), orange near-interface residues (3.0-3.4) and green chain-chain interface segments (3.88). Each serotype also shows a distinct “peak”, that is, the best-scoring position: Pro114 for DENV-1 and DENV-4, Tyr88 for DENV-2 and Ile49 for DENV-3 (Figure 2). Electrostatic and Hydrophobic Surface Profiles of DENV NS5 MTase The electrostatic and hydrophobic surface representations of the NS5 MTase domain from the four dengue serotypes are shown in Figure 3. Electrostatic-potential maps (blue, positive charge; red, negative charge; on a +75 to -75 mV scale) are presented in panels a, c, e and g. Each serotype displays blue, white and red patches that vary in the clustering and density of charged regions, producing distinct electrostatic patterns (Figures 3a, 3c, 3e, 3g). The corresponding hydrophobicity surfaces are shown in panels b, d, f and h, with hydrophobic areas in green and hydrophilic areas in purple. The green, white and purple patches are unique to each serotype, with variation in the distribution of hydrophobic and hydrophilic zones; green patches may be clustered or dispersed depending on the NS5 model (Figures 3b, 3d, 3f, 3h). When displayed side by side, the electrostatic (a, c, e, g) and hydrophobicity (b, d, f, h) maps are distinctive for each serotype. The consistent colour scales clearly indicate differences in the location and size of charged and hydrophobic regions, which give rise to different molecular profiles; the electrostatic (left) and hydrophobicity (right) maps are paired for each serotype to facilitate comparison. Developability Profiling of DENV Serotypes Figure 4 presents four scatter plots of predicted, transformed and experiment-like values of the NS5 MTase across developability models. In the AC-SINS panels (Figures 4A, 4B), the orange-highlighted DENV-1 and DENV-2 separate toward the upper right. The META panel (Figure 4C) shows DENV-3 highlighted at a high Group-X value in the lower right. In the PSR panel (Figure 4D), the orange-highlighted DENV-4 is separated from the other points, located higher and to the right. In each plot, orange denotes the single serotype highlighted for that model, so the four panels describe complementary projections rather than a common ranking. Stability Heatmaps of the NS5 MTase The heatmaps in Figure 5 display the electrostatic energy and net charge of the NS5 MTase domain for the four dengue serotypes across the pH and ionic-strength ranges examined. The energy heatmaps (Figures 5A, 5C, 5E, 5G) show a systematic decrease in electrostatic energy between the acidic region (pH 2.0-4.0) and the near-neutral region (pH 5.0-8.0). In each panel the colour shifts from red/yellow at low pH to green at higher pH, so that higher pH corresponds to lower (more favourable) energy and lower pH to higher, less favourable energy. Warm colours are most pronounced within the acidic region, where the reduced ionic screening at low ionic strength further accentuates the unfavourable electrostatic term; within the near-neutral window (pH 6.0-8.0), by contrast, the energy surface is uniformly low and reaches its minimum at low ionic strength (≤0.05 M). The corresponding charge heatmaps for each serotype (Figures 5B, 5D, 5F, 5H) are scaled from +0.20 to -0.20 e per residue, with blue denoting positive and red denoting negative net charge. Across the whole grid the domain carries a net positive charge, which is largest in the acidic region and decreases monotonically as the pH rises: the mean net charge falls from approximately +0.18 e per residue at pH 2.0 to approximately +0.04 e per residue at pH 8.0, corresponding to a shift from roughly +47 e to +11 e for a 263-residue domain. The deep blue of the acidic region therefore reflects the large positive charge carried by the domain when its acidic side chains are protonated, and the progressive lightening toward pH 8.0 reflects their stepwise deprotonation. The charge patterns are near-identical across the four serotypes and consistently describe a transition from a strongly positive to a substantially reduced, weakly positive net charge. DISCUSSION Together, the figures provide a clear picture of the overall conservation of the dengue virus NS5 Methyltransferase (MTase) across serotypes, alongside unique surface and developability characteristics that can be exploited for targeting. NS5 is among the most conserved and essential proteins of dengue virus. Its N-terminal MTase domain performs both the N7 and 2′-O methylation steps of RNA capping and is tightly coupled to the C-terminal polymerase domain (Byszewska et al., 2014; Egloff et al., 2002). This central role is reflected in the very similar overall architecture of the serotypes shown in Figure 1: all share the same genome organization, with NS5 at the C-terminal end of the polyprotein, and residues across the ~262-263-aa domain are well conserved. This is consistent with previous structural studies of the DENV NS5 MTase, in which specific substitutions modulate local interactions while the main catalytic motifs are preserved (Egloff et al., 2002; Norazharuddin and Lai, 2018). The predicted Fab-antigen interaction categories along NS5 are similar for all serotypes, each conveying a primary Fab-contact region together with Fab-exposed surface, near-interface and Fab chain-chain interface regions. This indicates a conserved epitope architecture within NS5. Figure 2 also identifies specific interface residues that are key serotype-specific determinants - Pro114 for DENV-1/4, Tyr88 for DENV-2 and Ile49 for DENV-3 - that form “hotspots” at these interfaces, in agreement with the serotype-specific interface and epitope features we mapped individually (Alwabli, 2026a, 2026b; Bukhari, 2026a, 2026b). Because antibody binding may be serotype-biased at these residues, they offer rational targets for the design of serotype-specific or serotype-broadening, epitope-focused antibodies or immunogens (Sadraeian et al., 2024). Although the electrostatic and hydrophobic patches are broadly similar between serotypes, their combination differs for each NS5 MTase, as evidenced by the surface maps in Figure 3. Because RNA binding, cofactor binding and antibody binding are all influenced by surface electrostatics and hydrophobicity, these patterns suggest that the local environment of the same catalytic site may differ between serotypes, affecting affinity and selectivity (Potisopon et al., 2014). The structural descriptors were used for developability-style measurements, with NS5-derived features serving as surrogates in AC-SINS-like, META-like and PSR-like spaces. In each plot, the highlighted serotype (orange) is plotted against many reference molecules. AC-SINS is a widely used assay for evaluating self-association and colloidal stability of antibodies during discovery; META is a composite of several biophysical readouts; and Poly-Specificity Reagent (PSR) assays, or related methods, report the propensity for non-specific interactions (Jain et al., 2017; Liu et al., 2014; Xu et al., 2013). analysis.main_results: The N-terminal MTase region of NS5 varied slightly in length among serotypes, with DENV-1 and DENV-3 having 262 amino acids and DENV-2 and DENV-4 having 263. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The figures illustrate the overall conservation of the NS5 MTase across DENV serotypes, alongside unique surface and developability characteristics that can be leveraged for targeted antiviral strategies, highlighting DENV-4 as a prioritized target.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the structural and biophysical features of the NS5 MTase domain that could inform the development of serotype-specific antiviral therapies and improve vaccine design by targeting conserved yet modifiable regions of the virus.

analysis.summary_en: This study focuses on the structural and biophysical profiling of the NS5 methyltransferase (MTase) domain across Dengue Virus (DENV) serotypes to identify potential antiviral targets. The research highlights the importance of NS5 in viral replication and immune evasion, noting that its sequence is highly conserved but with subtle variations among serotypes. By analyzing the MTase domain using predictive models and biophysical assays, the study identifies DENV-4 as a prioritized target due to its unique surface and developability characteristics. The findings suggest that targeting these features could support the development of serotype-specific antiviral therapies and improve vaccine design. However, the study's reliance on sequence-based models and lack of direct experimental validation limit the strength of the evidence, which is assessed as moderate.

elements_zh.methods: 使用蛋白质-蛋白质界面预测算法(例如 InterProSurf 和 SPIDER)对 NS5 MTase 模型进行分析,以预测 Fab-抗原界面残基。此外,生物物理描述符还用于通过 AC-SINS、PSR 和 META 等测定来估计自关联、非特异性相互作用和复合稳定性/可靠性。
elements_zh.main_results: NS5 N 端 MTase 区域的长度在不同血清型之间略有差异,其中 DENV-1 和 DENV-3 有 262 个氨基酸,DENV-2 和 DENV-4 有 263 个氨基酸。预测残基分为直接接触、表面、近界面和双(链-链)Fab 界面,界面得分表明预测参与的程度。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些图说明了 NS5 MTase 在 DENV 血清型中的整体保守性,以及可用于有针对性的 抗病毒药物 策略的独特表面和可开发特性,突出了 DENV-4 作为优先目标。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了对 NS5 MTase 结构域的结构和生物物理特征的深入了解,可以为血清型特异性 抗病毒药物 疗法的开发提供信息,并通过针对病毒的保守但可修改的区域来改进 疫苗 设计。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于基于序列和结构的模型,这些模型可能无法完全捕捉动态相互作用或功能后果。证据是中等的,因为它基于预测模型,并且不包括 抗病毒药物 靶向的直接实验验证。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to identify DENV-4 as a prioritized antiviral target by examining the structural and biophysical properties of the NS5 methyltransferase (MTase) domain across Dengue Virus (DENV) serotypes, given the limitations of current antiviral therapies and the importance of NS5 in viral replication and immune evasion.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved comparative structural and biophysical profiling of the NS5 MTase domain across DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4. Full-length genome sequences for these serotypes were retrieved from the NCBI database using reference strains established for DENV-1-4 nucleic-acid testing standards.
analysis_en.methods: The NS5 MTase models were analyzed using protein-protein interface-prediction algorithms such as InterProSurf and SPPIDER to predict Fab-antigen interface residues. Additionally, biophysical descriptors were used to estimate self-association, non-specific interactions, and composite stability/liability through assays like AC-SINS, PSR, and META.
analysis_en.main_results: The N-terminal MTase region of NS5 varied slightly in length among serotypes, with DENV-1 and DENV-3 having 262 amino acids and DENV-2 and DENV-4 having 263. Predicted residues were categorized into direct contact, surface, near-interface, and double (chain-chain) Fab interface, with interface scores indicating the level of predicted involvement.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The figures illustrate the overall conservation of the NS5 MTase across DENV serotypes, alongside unique surface and developability characteristics that can be leveraged for targeted antiviral strategies, highlighting DENV-4 as a prioritized target.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the structural and biophysical features of the NS5 MTase domain that could inform the development of serotype-specific antiviral therapies and improve vaccine design by targeting conserved yet modifiable regions of the virus.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on sequence-based and structural models, which may not fully capture dynamic interactions or functional consequences. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on predictive models and does not include direct experimental validation of antiviral targeting.

papers.source_body_en: Approximately 390 million infections occur each year, of which about one-quarter result in clinical manifestations (Bhatt et al., 2013), and roughly half of the world's population now lives in at-risk areas. To explain these features, we carried out a comparative structural and biophysical study of the NS5 MTase domain across all four DENV serotypes, building on our recent serotype-resolved analyses of the DENV-1 (Bukhari, 2026b), DENV-2 (Bukhari, 2026a), DENV-3 (Alwabli, 2026b) and DENV-4 (Alwabli, 2026a) NS5 MTase domains. MATERIALS AND METHODS Sequence Retrieval and DENV Serotype Genomes Full-length genome sequences for DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4 were retrieved from the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) database, using the reference strains established for DENV-1-4 nucleic-acid testing standards (Nunez et al., 2016). 0% READ FULL TEXT INTRODUCTION Dengue is among the most common arthropod-borne viral diseases of humans. This risk is amplified by rapid urbanization, global travel and the expansion of Aedes mosquitoes driven by climate change (eClinicalMedicine, 2024; Lim et al., 2025; Yousuf et al., 2024). No effective antiviral therapy is currently available, and existing vaccines show limited efficacy and serotype-dependent safety concerns. Such limitations underscore the importance of validated viral targets that can support both broad protection and serotype-specific intervention (Goh et al., 2024; Lim et al., 2015). papers.title: Upaya Pencegahan Demam Berdarah Dengue Melalui Edukasi Pembuatan Ovitrap di Padukuhan Wukirsari, Desa Baleharjo, Kabupaten Gunung Kidul
papers.abstract: Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) merupakan salah satu penyakit infeksi yang masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat di Indonesia dan negara tropis lainnya. Kepadatan penduduk, rendahnya kesadaran masyarakat terhadap kebersihan lingkungan, serta kondisi sanitasi yang kurang memadai menjadi faktor pendukung berkembangnya habitat nyamuk Aedes aegypti, khususnya di Kabupaten Gunung Kidul. Program pengabdian masyarakat dalam bentuk pelatihan pembuatan dan penggunaan ovitrap merupakan langkah strategis dan relevan. Kegiatan ini diharapkan dapat menumbuhkan kesadaran serta partisipasi aktif masyarakat dalam pencegahan DBD secara berkelanjutan. Pelaksanaan kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini dilaksanakan dengan pendekatan observasional dengan rancangan deskriptif non eksperimental. Penelitian ini melibatkan alat ukur berupa kuisioner pre-test dan pos-test yang diberikan sebelum dan sesudah pelaksanaan edukasi. Materi edukasi yang diberikan adalah seputar kejadian DBD dan juga pembuatan ovitrap ditunjang dengan video edukasi yang dikembangkan. Pemaparan materi dan pelatihan dilakukan dalam koordinasi dengan UPT Puskesmas Wonosari II, Gunungkidul, DIY. Hasil pre-test dan post-test dievaluasi secara statistik dengan menggunakan uji T berpasangan. Perangkat lunak yang digunakan adalah R versi 4.4.1 dan RStudio 2024.04.2 Build 764. Hasil menunjukkan rata-rata skor pemahaman masyarakat meningkat dari sekitar 52,18 pada pre-test menjadi 66,15 pada post-test, menunjukkan peningkatan sebesar 13,97 poin. Peningkatan nilai tersebut menggambarkan efektivitas metode penyuluhan yang diterapkan oleh tim pengabdi, yang memadukan ceramah interaktif, demonstrasi langsung, dan penayangan video edukasi dalam menjelaskan konsep DBD serta praktik pembuatan ovitrap. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat dalam upaya pencegahan DBD telah berhasil dilakukan melalui edukasi pembuatan ovitrap di Padukuhan Wukirsari, Baleharjo, Wonosari, Gunungkidul, DIY. Kegiatan ini juga berhasil meningkatkan pemahaman masyarakat setelah pemberian edukasi.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the ongoing public health issue of Dengue virus (DBD) in Indonesia, particularly in areas with high population density and poor sanitation, by implementing educational programs on the use of ovitrap to control the Aedes aegypti mosquito population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in Padukuhan Wukirsari, Desa Baleharjo, Kabupaten Gunung Kidul, involving a descriptive non-experimental design with pre-test and post-test evaluations.
analysis.methods: The methods included the use of educational materials such as pre-test and post-test questionnaires, interactive lectures, demonstrations, and video presentations to educate the community on DBD and the use of ovitrap.
analysis.main_results: The results showed a significant increase in community understanding from a pre-test average score of 52.18 to 66.15 on the post-test, indicating the effectiveness of the educational approach.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interpreted the findings as demonstrating the effectiveness of a community-based educational program in enhancing awareness and understanding of DBD and ovitrap usage.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that such educational programs can be effective in improving community awareness and potentially reducing the incidence of DBD.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the non-experimental design and the lack of a control group, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

analysis.summary_en: The study aimed to address Dengue virus (DBD) in Indonesia by educating the community on the use of ovitrap. A descriptive non-experimental design was used, showing a significant increase in community understanding post-education.

elements_en.methods: The methods included the use of educational materials such as pre-test and post-test questionnaires, interactive lectures, demonstrations, and video presentations to educate the community on DBD and the use of ovitrap.
elements_en.main_results: The results showed a significant increase in community understanding from a pre-test average score of 52.18 to 66.15 on the post-test, indicating the effectiveness of the educational approach.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interpreted the findings as demonstrating the effectiveness of a community-based educational program in enhancing awareness and understanding of DBD and ovitrap usage.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that such educational programs can be effective in improving community awareness and potentially reducing the incidence of DBD.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the non-experimental design and the lack of a control group, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过实施关于使用产卵器控制埃及伊蚊种群的教育计划,解决印度尼西亚持续存在的 登革病毒 (DBD) 公共卫生问题,特别是在人口密度高和卫生条件差的地区。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在 Padukuhan Wukirsari、Desa Baleharjo 和 Kabupaten Gunung Kidul 进行,涉及描述性非实验设计以及测试前和测试后评估。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法包括使用教育材料,如测试前和测试后问卷、互动讲座、演示和视频演示,向社区进行有关 DBD 和诱产蛋器使用的教育。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果显示,社区理解程度从测试前的平均分 52.18 分显着提高到测试后的 66.15 分,表明了教育方法的有效性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究将研究结果解释为证明了基于社区的教育计划在提高对 DBD 和产卵器使用的认识和理解方面的有效性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,此类教育计划可以有效提高社区意识,并有可能减少 DBD 的 发病率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括非实验设计和缺乏对照组,这可能会影响结果的普遍性。

papers.title_zh: 通过在Gunung Kidul县Baleharjo乡Wukirsari村开展卵形诱捕器制作教育来预防登革热
papers.source_body_en: Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) merupakan salah satu penyakit infeksi yang masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat di Indonesia dan negara tropis lainnya. Kepadatan penduduk, rendahnya kesadaran masyarakat terhadap kebersihan lingkungan, serta kondisi sanitasi yang kurang memadai menjadi faktor pendukung berkembangnya habitat nyamuk Aedes aegypti, khususnya di Kabupaten Gunung Kidul. Program pengabdian masyarakat dalam bentuk pelatihan pembuatan dan penggunaan ovitrap merupakan langkah strategis dan relevan. Kegiatan ini diharapkan dapat menumbuhkan kesadaran serta partisipasi aktif masyarakat dalam pencegahan DBD secara berkelanjutan. Pelaksanaan kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini dilaksanakan dengan pendekatan observasional dengan rancangan deskriptif non eksperimental. Penelitian ini melibatkan alat ukur berupa kuisioner pre-test dan pos-test yang diberikan sebelum dan sesudah pelaksanaan edukasi. Materi edukasi yang diberikan adalah seputar kejadian DBD dan juga pembuatan ovitrap ditunjang dengan video edukasi yang dikembangkan. Pemaparan materi dan pelatihan dilakukan dalam koordinasi dengan UPT Puskesmas Wonosari II, Gunungkidul, DIY. Hasil pre-test dan post-test dievaluasi secara statistik dengan menggunakan uji T berpasangan. Perangkat lunak yang digunakan adalah R versi 4.4.1 dan RStudio 2024.04.2 Build 764. Hasil menunjukkan rata-rata skor pemahaman masyarakat meningkat dari sekitar 52,18 pada pre-test menjadi 66,15 pada post-test, menunjukkan peningkatan sebesar 13,97 poin. Peningkatan nilai tersebut menggambarkan efektivitas metode penyuluhan yang diterapkan oleh tim pengabdi, yang memadukan ceramah interaktif, demonstrasi langsung, dan penayangan video edukasi dalam menjelaskan konsep DBD serta praktik pembuatan ovitrap. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat dalam upaya pencegahan DBD telah berhasil dilakukan melalui edukasi pembuatan ovitrap di Padukuhan Wukirsari, Baleharjo, Wonosari, Gunungkidul, DIY. Kegiatan ini juga berhasil meningkatkan pemahaman masyarakat setelah pemberian edukasi.

papers.title: The Relationship Between the Level of Family Knowledge of Inpatients and the Incidence of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever at Vita Insani Hospital, Pematangsiantar
papers.abstract: Dengue hemorrhagic fever is an infectious disease caused by the dengue fever virus which is transmitted by mosquitoes. It can be dangerous if not treated immediately because it can cause death. The incidence of dengue hemorrhagic fever at Vita Insani Hospital Pematangsiantar is still relatively high. Data obtained from hospitals from February – April, the incidence of dengue hemorrhagic fever reached 490 cases. This study aims to determine the relationship between the level of knowledge of inpatients' families and the incidence of dengue hemorrhagic fever at the Vita Insani Hospital, Pematangsiantar. This research uses a correlational method with a cross- sectional approach with a sampling technique using purposive sampling technique. The sample in this study consisted of 85 respondents. The research instrument used was a questionnaire developed from (Indonesian Ministry of Health, 2018) in the journal Lahagu et al., 2021. Data analysis techniques use univariate and bivariate analysis. Statistical research results using the chi-square test showed that there was a relationship between the level of knowledge of inpatients' families and the incidence of dengue hemorrhagic fever at Vita Insani Hospital, Pematangsiantar with a value of p = 0.003 (p > 0.05). And the results show that the level of family knowledge is dominated by 51 people (60%) and around 55 people (64%) have experienced dengue hemorrhagic fever.

elements_zh.main_results: 使用卡方检验的统计研究结果显示,Pematangsiantar Vita Insani 医院住院患者家属的登革热出血热知识水平与 发病率 之间存在相关性,p = 0.003 (p > 0.05)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为表明家庭知识水平与登革出血热 发病率 之间的关系,这是在医院家庭意识项目背景下的一项新颖观察。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为制定有针对性的家庭教育计划提供信息,以减少医院环境中登革出血热的 发病率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据受到横截面设计和小样本量的限制,这可能会影响结果的普遍性。证据强度中等。

papers.source_body_en: Dengue hemorrhagic fever is an infectious disease caused by the dengue fever virus which is transmitted by mosquitoes. It can be dangerous if not treated immediately because it can cause death. The incidence of dengue hemorrhagic fever at Vita Insani Hospital Pematangsiantar is still relatively high. Data obtained from hospitals from February – April, the incidence of dengue hemorrhagic fever reached 490 cases. This study aims to determine the relationship between the level of knowledge of inpatients' families and the incidence of dengue hemorrhagic fever at the Vita Insani Hospital, Pematangsiantar. This research uses a correlational method with a cross- sectional approach with a sampling technique using purposive sampling technique. The sample in this study consisted of 85 respondents. The research instrument used was a questionnaire developed from (Indonesian Ministry of Health, 2018) in the journal Lahagu et al., 2021. Data analysis techniques use univariate and bivariate analysis. Statistical research results using the chi-square test showed that there was a relationship between the level of knowledge of inpatients' families and the incidence of dengue hemorrhagic fever at Vita Insani Hospital, Pematangsiantar with a value of p = 0.003 (p > 0.05). And the results show that the level of family knowledge is dominated by 51 people (60%) and around 55 people (64%) have experienced dengue hemorrhagic fever.

papers.title: Prevenção da dengue em jogo
papers.abstract: A prevenção da dengue requer a participação da população na identificação e eliminação de situações que favorecem a reprodução do Aedes aegypti, tornando a educação em saúde um componente relevante das estratégias de enfrentamento das arboviroses. Recursos lúdicos podem contribuir para abordar essas informações de maneira interativa, favorecendo a participação do público e a relação entre conhecimentos sobre a doença e práticas cotidianas de prevenção. O objetivo deste trabalho é relatar uma experiência educativa voltada à prevenção da dengue, desenvolvida por meio de uma dinâmica baseada em jogo de associação durante o evento “Conhecendo a UNIPAMPA”, realizado em 11 de setembro de 2026, na Universidade Federal do Pampa (UNIPAMPA), Campus Uruguaiana. A ação integrou as atividades do Grupo 5 – Comunicação e Inovação do Programa de Educação pelo Trabalho para a Saúde (PET-Saúde) – Clima. Participaram estudantes dos anos finais do ensino fundamental e do ensino médio de escolas de Uruguaiana, distribuídos em diversas turmas ao longo do dia, sem contabilização do número total de participantes. Para a atividade, utilizou-se o “Dominó da Dengue”, composto por peças que estabelecem associações entre perguntas e respostas relacionadas à transmissão da doença, ao reconhecimento de sinais e sintomas e, principalmente, às medidas de prevenção. Ao longo da dinâmica, os participantes identificavam as respostas correspondentes às situações apresentadas e eram estimulados a justificar suas escolhas, possibilitando a discussão de conhecimentos prévios e o esclarecimento de dúvidas. Foram abordadas situações do cotidiano relacionadas à presença de água parada e aos cuidados com pneus, garrafas, calhas, caixas-d’água, vasos de plantas e quintais, além da importância da hidratação e da participação comunitária no enfrentamento da dengue. Observou-se dificuldade recorrente na identificação do mosquito transmissor: alguns estudantes respondiam apenas “mosquito” ou escolhiam uma resposta ao acaso. Apesar dessa dificuldade, de modo geral, os alunos conseguiam concluir o jogo com relativa facilidade. As contribuições espontâneas foram pontuais e incluíram relatos de pessoas próximas que tiveram dengue e da presença de garrafas com água parada em quintais. A experiência possibilitou trabalhar medidas preventivas a partir de situações concretas e estimular o reconhecimento da responsabilidade compartilhada no controle do Aedes aegypti. A dinâmica de associação favoreceu a participação e possibilitou momentos de diálogo durante a atividade, permitindo que o jogo funcionasse como mediador da discussão sobre comportamentos individuais e coletivos relacionados à prevenção. Conclui-se que a utilização de estratégias lúdicas em ações extensionistas pode favorecer a abordagem participativa da dengue, aproximando conhecimentos em saúde de práticas preventivas presentes no cotidiano da população.
papers.journal: Anais do VI Seminário (Des)Fazendo Saberes na Fronteira

Observou-se dificuldade recorrente na identificação do mosquito transmissor: alguns estudantes respondiam apenas “mosquito” ou escolhiam uma resposta ao acaso. Apesar dessa dificuldade, de modo geral, os alunos conseguiam concluir o jogo com relativa facilidade. As contribuições espontâneas foram pontuais e incluíram relatos de pessoas próximas que tiveram dengue e da presença de garrafas com água parada em quintais. A experiência possibilitou trabalhar medidas preventivas a partir de situações concretas e estimular o reconhecimento da responsabilidade compartilhada no controle do Aedes aegypti. A dinâmica de associação favoreceu a participação e possibilitou momentos de diálogo durante a atividade, permitindo que o jogo funcionasse como mediador da discussão sobre comportamentos individuais e coletivos relacionados à prevenção. Conclui-se que a utilização de estratégias lúdicas em ações extensionistas pode favorecer a abordagem participativa da dengue, aproximando conhecimentos em saúde de práticas preventivas presentes no cotidiano da população.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports on an educational initiative aimed at preventing dengue through an interactive game-based approach during the event 'Conhecendo a UNIPAMPA' on September 11, 2026, at the Federal University of Pampa (UNIPAMPA) in Uruguaiana. The game, called 'Dominó da Dengue', was designed to foster associations between questions and answers related to dengue transmission, symptoms, and prevention measures. The study involved students from the final years of elementary and high school, distributed across multiple classes without a reported total number of participants. The main results indicated that while students faced challenges in identifying the Aedes aegypti mosquito, they generally completed the game with relative ease. The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the potential of ludic strategies to promote participatory approaches in public health education, encouraging dialogue on individual and collective behaviors related to dengue prevention. The study highlights the importance of integrating practical knowledge into health education to enhance community engagement. However, the lack of a specified sample size and the absence of quantitative outcomes limit the strength of the evidence.

papers.title: Bridging surveillance gaps in dengue: a hierarchical model integrating mixed data sources for transmission estimation and vaccine targeting
papers.abstract: Estimating dengue force of infection (FOI) is essential for understanding transmission dynamics and targeting intervention programmes, yet surveillance data in endemic settings required for estimations are often incomplete, with varying formats. We developed a Bayesian hierarchical catalytic model that jointly fits age-stratified case data, aggregate case data, and seroprevalence surveys within a single framework, incorporating external covariates to improve parameter identifiability. Synthetic validation showed that covariates alone recovered accurate FOI point estimates even when most districts contributed only aggregate data, but did so with poorly calibrated uncertainty; anchoring the model with a single seroprevalence survey was necessary to bring credible interval coverage close to nominal. Applied to 128 districts across Java and Bali, Indonesia (2016-2024), the model revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity in FOI and reporting rates. Many districts in Java exceeded the WHO-suggested seroprevalence threshold for vaccine introduction, yet were classified as low-priority when using reported incidence as prioritisation criterion, particularly in areas with weak surveillance. Model-based seroprevalence estimation, integrating multiple data sources, offers a more consistent basis for identifying high-priority districts for vaccine introduction, and is less susceptible to surveillance bias than reported incidence.

papers.title_zh: 弥合登革热中的 监测 差距:集成混合数据源的分层模型,用于 传播 估计和 疫苗 定位
papers.source_body_en: Estimating dengue force of infection (FOI) is essential for understanding transmission dynamics and targeting intervention programmes, yet surveillance data in endemic settings required for estimations are often incomplete, with varying formats. We developed a Bayesian hierarchical catalytic model that jointly fits age-stratified case data, aggregate case data, and seroprevalence surveys within a single framework, incorporating external covariates to improve parameter identifiability. Synthetic validation showed that covariates alone recovered accurate FOI point estimates even when most districts contributed only aggregate data, but did so with poorly calibrated uncertainty; anchoring the model with a single seroprevalence survey was necessary to bring credible interval coverage close to nominal. Applied to 128 districts across Java and Bali, Indonesia (2016-2024), the model revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity in FOI and reporting rates. Many districts in Java exceeded the WHO-suggested seroprevalence threshold for vaccine introduction, yet were classified as low-priority when using reported incidence as prioritisation criterion, particularly in areas with weak surveillance. Model-based seroprevalence estimation, integrating multiple data sources, offers a more consistent basis for identifying high-priority districts for vaccine introduction, and is less susceptible to surveillance bias than reported incidence.
papers.abstract_zh: 估计登革热感染力 (FOI) 对于了解 传播 动态和制定干预计划至关重要,但估计所需的流行环境中的 监测 数据通常不完整,且格式各异。我们开发了一个贝叶斯分层催化模型,该模型在单一框架内联合拟合年龄分层病例数据、汇总病例数据和 血清流行率 调查,并结合外部协变量以提高参数可识别性。综合验证表明,即使大多数地区仅提供汇总数据,仅协变量也能恢复准确的 FOI 点估计,但这样做的不确定性校准不佳;有必要通过一次 血清流行率 调查来锚定模型,以使可信的区间覆盖范围接近名义值。该模型应用于印度尼西亚爪哇岛和巴厘岛的 128 个地区(2016-2024 年),揭示了 FOI 和报告率的显着空间异质性。爪哇的许多地区超出了世界卫生组织建议的 疫苗 引入阈值,但在使用报告的 发病率 作为优先标准时被归类为低优先级,特别是在 监测 较弱的地区。基于模型的 血清流行率 估计集成了多个数据源,为识别 疫苗 引入的高优先级地区提供了更一致的基础,并且比报告的 发病率 更不易受到 监测 偏差的影响。
